data.jd_text:
**Application Deadline:** 
 30 June 2026
 



**Department:** 
 Central Services, People
 



**Location:** 
 Dubai
   

  




**Description**
**A Career with Trivandi**
 Working for Trivandi means the opportunity to work on the world’s most iconic projects in a supportive, people\-first environment with colleagues who are passionate, collaborative and love what they do.
   

  

 Our culture is grounded in trust and fulfilment, with a shared passion for achieving excellence, whilst having fun. We’re dedicated to ensuring that every team member’s voice is heard and valued, enabling Trivandi to be shaped and grown by the people within it.
   

  

 Ultimately, Trivandi is a place where you’ll be excited to come to work at the start of each week.
   

  

 Together, we keep our shared values at the heart of everything we do:
   

  

**Passion** 
 : We love what we do and care passionately about achieving great outcomes with our partners.
   

  

**Trust \& Quality:** 
 We are trusted to consistently deliver to the highest international standards and professional ethics.
   

  

**OneTeam** 
 : We are a close\-knit team and know that our best work is done together. We care for each other, always putting people first, enabling us to deliver our best work.
   

  

**Always Evolving** 
 : We don't stand still. We strive to make each project better than the last, daring to challenge what's gone before, in our quest for innovation and improvement.
   

  

**About Trivandi**
 Trivandi provides advisory, design and delivery services across sport, events, live entertainment and venues.
   

  

 Founded in 2013 from the success of the London 2012 Games, we have grown to over 100 specialists across four global offices in London, Dubai, Riyadh and Brisbane, delivering over 300 projects in 29 countries.
   

  

 Our unique “One Team” approach brings together the right expertise at the right time, synchronising strategy, design, project management, and operations to simplify complexity and deliver actionable solutions that drive meaningful impact.
   

  

 We passionately share our knowledge to empower local teams, unlocking the full potential of each unique experience to inspire positive change and create lasting legacies.
   

  

 That’s what we mean by creating experiences, better.
   

  

  

**About the Role**
 We are looking for a motivated People Administrator \& PRO to join our People team to support the day\-to\-day People operations and government relations activities for the business in Dubai and KSA, with a strong focus on DMCC processes and compliance.
   

  

 The role is responsible for coordinating employee lifecycle administration, including visa and immigration activities, maintaining employee records, supporting payroll inputs, and acting as the key liaison with DMCC and relevant UAE government authorities.
   

  

 This role requires strong organisational skills, attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and a proactive approach to employee support and compliance management.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be highly energetic, professional and able to demonstrate integrity and discretion in all tasks. As this role involves handling sensitive personal and company data, you must be able to manage confidential information with the highest level of care and responsibility.
   

  

 To come on this journey with us, you’ll bring a great sense of humour, a positive and collaborative mindset, and the confidence to navigate a fast\-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment. You should be naturally resourceful, solutions\-driven, and comfortable taking initiative. Most importantly, you’ll enjoy a challenge and be excited by the opportunity to support and elevate the People function across all regions as we continue to grow.
   

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 At Trivandi all our roles are broad and flexible, but here’s a flavour of where you’ll focus your time:
   

  

**HR Administration** 
* Support day\-to\-day People administration activities across the employee lifecycle including onboarding, employment changes and offboarding.
* Prepare letters, certificates and other HR documentation.
* Maintain accurate employee records and HR databases ensuring all information is up to date and compliant.
* Coordinate onboarding processes for new employees including document collection, inductions and system access requests.
* Track probation periods, visa expiry dates, passport renewals and other key employee milestones.
* Support payroll administration by preparing monthly payroll inputs including leave, allowances, deductions and employee changes.
* Maintain annual leave and attendance records.
* Respond to employee queries relating to HR policies, benefits, visas and company procedures.
* Support the implementation and continuous improvement of HR processes and systems.
* Assist with recruitment coordination including interview scheduling, candidate communication and onboarding administration.
* Ensure all HR practices are compliant with UAE labour law and company policies.


**PRO \& Government Relations Responsibilities** 
* Act as the main point of contact for DMCC and relevant UAE government authorities.
* Manage and process employment visas, labour cards, Emirates IDs, medicals and residency permits.
* Coordinate visa applications, renewals, cancellations and status changes for employees
* Maintain accurate tracking of all visa and immigration activities and ensure renewals are completed in advance of expiry dates.
* Ensure compliance with all DMCC regulations and UAE immigration requirements.
* Coordinate document attestation and notarisation processes where required.
* Support WPS and labour\-related administrative requirements.
* Keep up to date with changes to UAE labour law, immigration regulations and DMCC requirements and communicate impacts to the business.
* Support the KSA People team with KSA Business Visa applications and renewals, monitoring expiry dates and turnaround times. Ensure all documentation is complete and correct before employees visit the visa processing centre.


**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
**Personal Skills and Experience**
 The key knowledge, experience, and qualifications we are looking for include:
 * 1–2 years of experience in Human Resources or People operations in Dubai, ideally within a professional services or fast\-paced environment.
* Strong administration skills developed within a professional setting.
* Experience with HRMS platforms or other relevant HR information system.
* Proficient in the use of IT and Microsoft programmes and iOS applications.
* Highly organised, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Desirable \- DMCC systems knowledge
* Desirable – KSA business visa and Iqama knowledge
* Strongly desirable \- Arabic speaker


**About You**
 The key competencies and behaviours we are looking for include:
 * Excellent team working skills with an open, friendly, and supportive style.
* Ability to effectively, accurately, and concisely present and communicate in both written and verbal forms and be empathetic across different audiences and cultural sensitivities.
* Proven attention to detail
* Able to handle shifting demands.
* Responsive and helpful
* Self\-motivated and resourceful
* Loyal, displaying the highest levels of integrity and commitment.
* Flexible and adaptable in a dynamic company


**Benefits**
 If you are successful in this application we will invest in you, support, and train you to be successful, opening up a world of opportunities.
   

  

 Trivandi is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity amongst our team. We aim to be truly representative of all sections of society, creating an environment where everyone feels respected and able to give of their best. We therefore warmly welcome applications from anyone who meets the criteria we’ve described.

data.jd_text:
**Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE (Hybrid)
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 Global PMO Lead
   

  

**About The Role**
 This role exists to help build and embed a fit\-for\-purpose PMO capability for the Emerging Markets (EM) business, enabling disciplined execution of innovation and portfolio priorities at pace and with quality.
   

  

 As Flora Food Group continues to scale consumer\-led innovation across regions, the Emerging Markets business requires stronger orchestration across Marketing, R\&D, Supply Chain, Finance and Operations. The PMO Manager will act as a foundational builder of this capability: setting up robust ways of working, driving executional discipline, and ensuring projects land on time, in full, and with clear accountability.
   

  

 This role is critical to reducing execution risk, improving speed\-to\-market, and freeing up functional leaders to focus on content and decision\-making rather than coordination.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Operating at the intersection of strategy and execution, you will help establish an Emerging Markets PMO operating/ framework model aligned to global P\&P / PMO standards, while tailored to local business realities.
   

  

 You will bring consistency, transparency and rigor to how innovation and portfolio initiatives are planned, governed and delivered, and act as the single point of truth for execution status, risks and delivery confidence across the EM innovation and portfolio agenda.
   

  

 You will act as the executional backbone for end\-to\-end project \& activity management, by owning the planning and orchestration of priority innovation and portfolio initiatives, ensuring cross\-functional teams’ ownership and accountability to deliver against clear timelines, milestones and decision gates.
   

  

 You will improve delivery confidence, resource visibility and decision quality across the EM portfolio by ensuring high\-quality data, discipline and follow\-through in portfolio \& project management systems. You will act as a role model for execution discipline, pragmatic problem\-solving and collaborative leadership; and you will help to build the EM PMO capability over time, including a small team, templates/tools, playbooks and best practices, as the EM hub scales.
   

  

**What This Role Is (and Is Not)**
 You will be
 **accountable for execution and orchestration** 
 , not for project content ownership. Project leadership and strategic direction will remain with the Marketing / Business leads; this role ensures the work lands.
   

  

 You are biased toward action, clarity and simplification — not to add bureaucracy.
   

  

**What Does It Take To Be Successful**
 You combine strong project management fundamentals with the confidence to operate in complex, cross\-functional FMCG environments. You are comfortable building structure where it does not yet exist, and you bring calm, clarity and momentum to ambiguous situations.
   

  

* 5–10\+ years’ experience in project, program or PMO roles within FMCG / CPG or similarly complex environments
* Experience acting as owner of PMO data quality, reporting cadence and execution dashboards in enterprise environments
* Strong systems thinker with the ability to design simple, scalable ways of working, with proven experience setting up or scaling PMO / project management structures
* Hands\-on experience managing end\-to\-end innovation, transformation or portfolio initiatives.
* Strong understanding of stage\-gate models, innovation lifecycles and launch readiness
* Confident facilitator and communicator with experience in influencing senior and cross\-functional stakeholders without direct authority
* Excellent planning, prioritization, execution discipline, high accountability mindset comfortable holding others to commitments and follow\-through for continuous improvement
* Values transparency, pragmatic, solution\-oriented, resilient under pressure and energised by building capability and enabling others to succeed
* Preferred, but not required: PMP, PRINCE2, Agile / SAFe certification.


**What’s next?**
**Flora Food Group** 
 is committed to culinary essentials for better food. We believe fewer, better ideas — executed with excellence — are what drive sustainable growth.
   

  

 This is a career\-defining opportunity to work with our high\-impact brands in a high\-energy, high\-accountability environment. If you recognise yourself in this profile, apply and be part of this exciting journey. Apply now at www.florafoodgroup.com.We prefer to receive your application before
 **25th June 2026** 
 .
   

  

 We understand your resume might not be up to date and recommend that you apply with what you have or your LinkedIn Profile. Flora Food Group is dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workplace, we understand that you might not meet all the requirements stated in the description, but we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the right candidate for this role or other roles.
   

  

*Flora Food Group is an employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and equal opportunities for all. We recruit based only on values, qualifications, performance, skills, behaviours, experience, and knowledge. We ensure job advertisements are free from unintentional bias.*
*No personal characteristics should be a barrier to joining Flora Food Group. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or other personal characteristics.*

In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!

Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented
 **Project Director** 
 to join our team! In this role you will get to lead medium to large\-sized projects and ensures on\-schedule completion within or below budget in accordance with contractual obligations. Responsible for the scope development, scope management, and commercial performance of the project to meet project goals and objectives. Plans and defines project goals and devises methods to accomplish them; develops in\-depth knowledge of client objectives, contract terms, and corporate policies. Ensures that the project meets or exceeds goals established in these plans.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
 Plans, directs, supervises, and controls the execution of all business, technical, fiscal, and administrative functions of the assigned project.
   

  

* Oversees establishment of Project Execution Plan, Health and Safety Plan, Quality Assurance/Quality Control Plan, and other documents as required.
* Establishes the program requirements for all areas of the project, and monitors the draft and final deliverables for adherence to these criteria.
* Assigns responsibility for executing project plans to key subordinates after careful assessment of how to utilize their qualifications and strengths.
* Negotiates changes to the scope of work with the client and key subcontractors.
* Markets and secures additional work with client.
* Responsible for following up on instructions and commitments associated with the project.
* Responsible for the development and distribution of a project summary to all members of the project team for reference.
* Provides input on performance reviews and development plans for subordinates.
* Mobilizes company resources, through liaison with support departments, other offices, or subsidiaries, to create project teams capable of completing effective, quality work.
* Discusses the qualifications required of the key project positions in specific detail with the profit center and department managers.
* Collaborates with the office facilities staff to address project space requirements.
* Works with other managers, project engineers, and discipline leads to develop budgets, schedules, and plans for the various elements of a project.
* Works with the key project individual to devise and execute actions plans to rectify potential cost overruns or delays, or to accommodate significant changes to the scope of work; advises the client and company management of any such changes.
* Responsible for maintaining current and timely change orders.
* Promotes technical and commercial excellence on the project through application of Quality Assurance processes.
* Monitors and reports to management on the progress of all project activity within the program, including significant milestones, and any conditions, which would affect project cost or schedule.
* Field responsibilities may include labor relations, local procurement, payroll operations, etc.
* Acts as the Company representative with the client and selected subcontractors during the program execution.
* May participate in negotiations with regulatory agencies and in public meetings in support of clients.
* Establishes weekly meeting to review project status and formulate action items.
* Develops succession plan for Project Manager and key roles in coordination with leadership and leads implementation.


**What Required Skills You'll Bring**
* Bachelor's Degree Engineering or related technical/business field
* 15\+ years related work experience and
* Previous project management experience on similar or related projects
* Broad general technical and business background
* Familiarity with the integration of engineering/technical aspects.
* Advanced leadership skills with ability to perform in a management capacity
* Excellent written and oral communications skills
* Thorough knowledge of industry practices and regulations.
* Advanced knowledge of current technology and how it can be effectively utilized on projects


**What Desired Skills You'll Bring**
* Advanced degree in relevant field
* Professional or Chartered registration.

**Head of Transformation (Project Lifecycle Management)** 




  





**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an experienced Head of Transformation to lead a large\-scale enterprise transformation programme across a complex project and real estate portfolio. This is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving end\-to\-end business transformation across project delivery, commercial operations, governance, financial management, handover, and operational readiness.
 



  





 The successful candidate will own the transformation vision, business case, value realisation, and adoption strategy, ensuring measurable business outcomes through the implementation of standardised processes, governance frameworks, and technology\-enabled ways of working.
 



 This role is focused on transforming how projects are delivered and managed across the organisation—not simply implementing systems or managing programme governance.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Define and lead the transformation vision, strategy, and business case across the project lifecycle.
* Drive measurable business outcomes including improved governance, compliance, cost control, schedule performance, transparency, and operational efficiency.
* Lead the design and implementation of future\-state operating models and standardised ways of working.
* Champion organisational change and user adoption across multiple business functions and stakeholder groups.
* Partner with executive leadership to secure alignment, influence decision\-making, and resolve cross\-functional challenges.
* Develop and manage a multi\-year transformation roadmap, balancing business priorities, value delivery, and organisational readiness.
* Oversee delivery through programme, platform, integration, and change management teams.
* Ensure successful coordination between business and technology functions, including enterprise platforms and integrated systems.
* Build and lead high\-performing transformation, product, and change teams capable of sustaining long\-term organisational capability.
* Manage external partners and vendors to ensure delivery against agreed timelines, budgets, and business outcomes.



  





**Required Experience** 



* 12–18\+ years of experience leading large\-scale enterprise transformation programmes.
* Proven track record delivering measurable business value through organisational transformation and change initiatives.
* Experience leading multi\-year, cross\-functional transformation programmes at enterprise scale.
* Strong change management and adoption leadership, with demonstrated success driving behavioural and process change.
* Ability to influence C\-suite stakeholders and navigate complex organisational environments.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience balancing priorities, risks, and business outcomes.
* Experience in at least one of the following: real estate, construction, infrastructure, or capital project environments
* Project lifecycle management and capital delivery processes
* Enterprise project management or project controls platforms (e.g., Primavera Unifier, Primavera P6, or similar solutions)
* Understanding of governance, controls, delegation of authority frameworks, audit requirements, and integrated ERP environments.
* Demonstrated ability to quickly understand new business domains and technologies.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree is mandatory.
* Experience within the GCC region, particularly the UAE.
* Exposure to real estate development, infrastructure, or large capital project portfolios.
* Knowledge of Oracle Primavera Unifier, Primavera P6, or equivalent project lifecycle management platforms.
* Professional certifications such as PMP, MSP, PRINCE2, or Prosci Change Management.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 This opportunity is ideal for a transformation leader who has successfully led enterprise\-wide change programmes and thrives in complex, fast\-paced environments. We are looking for someone who combines strategic vision with hands\-on execution, can influence senior stakeholders, and has a passion for driving sustainable organisational transformation and value creation.

data.jd_text:
The Commercial \& Engagement Division is responsible for generating sustainable financial returns on the commercial property portfolio through active asset management, property management, and strategic engagement initiatives. These initiatives include attracting local and international entities to set up headquarters; enhancing the City’s positioning as a hub for innovation, education, and sustainability; and integrating businesses, SMEs, and innovators into a cohesive ecosystem.
 



  





 The Head of Operational Excellence is responsible for driving organization\-wide performance improvement, operational efficiency, process optimization, and transformation initiatives. The role leads the design and implementation of best\-practice operating models, continuous improvement programmes, automation initiatives, and performance management frameworks to enhance productivity, reduce costs, improve customer experience, and support the organization's strategic objectives.
 



  





 The role acts as a strategic partner to the Commercial Leadership Team, ensuring operational excellence principles are embedded across all business functions and that performance improvements are measurable, sustainable, and scalable.
 



  





**The main responsibilities for this role include:** 



* Develop and execute the Operational Excellence strategy, ensuring alignment with corporate objectives at ECD, commercial priorities, and long\-term business goals.
* Lead strategic transformation initiatives and special projects that improve commercial teams’ performance, operational effectiveness, and value creation.

data.jd_text:
**Job Location:** 
 Dubai, UAE
   

  

 Whiteshield is a global policy advisory and AI economics firm known for our ability to respond to global challenges rapidly and incisively. We use the most advanced tools and technology and combine them with our team of leading international experts to engage decision\-makers in tackling society's most significant challenges. We are recognized for our rapid decision support, innovation, data science algorithms and deep policy expertise. We are specialists in "connecting the dots" between policy, business and technology.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced and driven
 **Digital Delivery Manager** 
 to join Whiteshield to become an integral part of our delivery organization. This role will be instrumental in establishing governance frameworks and driving excellence across our complex digital and policy initiatives. This Digital Delivery Manager should have very strong experience in project and program management, ideally with deep expertise in Agile methodologies and digital product delivery to complement our technical and policy teams.
   

  

 This is a role with a lot of responsibility and the potential to make a true impact \- on our delivery capability, within the business, and on government across the globe. We look for entrepreneurial people that want to make their mark on the world, and we empower and reward our staff accordingly. There is a lot of room for creativity and big ideas that shift the status quo. We are constantly delivering large new features and complex initiatives.
   

  

 You will report to our Principals and Partners working across all of our cross\-functional delivery teams, closely collaborating with product managers, developers, UI/UX designers, data scientists, business analysts, and QA teams.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 Entrepreneurial and ambitious, with your own perspective and ideas, and with an eagerness to contribute to the success of the organization's delivery excellence.
   

  

 Highly independent and self\-motivated, with strong leadership skills and a get\-things\-done attitude to deliver results.
   

  

 Passion for the public good and eagerness to make a societal impact with their work, ideally with a particular interest in economic development, workforce development, and education.
   

  

 Highly organized and eager to push the boundary on delivery excellence and really rethink traditional project management approaches.
   

  

 Eager to work in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment that challenges you to excel.
   

  

 Detail\-oriented with high standards for quality and governance.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**End\-to\-End Project Leadership:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end planning, execution, and closure of complex digital and policy projects from inception through delivery.
   

  

**PMO Governance:** 
 Establish and enforce PMO governance, delivery standards, and reporting frameworks across all projects to ensure consistency and quality.
   

  

**Cross\-Functional Coordination:** 
 Coordinate and drive cross\-functional delivery teams including product, data science, data engineering, AI and BI development to achieve project objectives.
   

  

**Stakeholder Interface:** 
 Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders, executive leadership, and technical teams to ensure alignment and transparency.
   

  

**Product Delivery Oversight:** 
 Govern the design, development, validation, and deployment of digital products to ensure they meet quality standards and business requirements.
   

  

**Analytics \& Reporting:** 
 Ensure effective visualization and consumption of insights through Live Jira dashboards and related analytics platforms for real\-time project visibility.
   

  

**Toolset Management:** 
 Manage project delivery using Jira, Confluence and Azure\-based toolsets, ensuring transparency, traceability, and control across all initiatives.
   

  

**Risk \& Issue Management:** 
 Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies to keep projects on track.
   

  

**Scope \& Schedule Control:** 
 Monitor and control scope, schedule, and benefits realization across concurrent initiatives to ensure successful outcomes.
   

  

**Quality Assurance:** 
 Ensure quality and consistency of deliverables through formal reviews and adherence to Whiteshield standards.
   

  

**Executive Reporting:** 
 Provide clear, concise, and regular status reporting to senior stakeholders and steering committees.
   

  

**Resource Optimization:** 
 Optimize resource planning, capacity management, and prioritization across multiple workstreams to maximize efficiency.
   

  

**Requirements**
* Exceptional analytical, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills
* Multiple years of experience in project/program management and PMO leadership, preferably in a dynamic, high\-growth and highly innovative environment
* Proven successful experience in delivering complex digital products and technology initiatives from scratch
* Proficiency with relevant tooling (such as Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, and analytics platforms)
* Professional certifications such as PMP, PMI\-ACP, PRINCE2, or Agile certifications (Scrum Master, SAFe, etc.)
* Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, and hybrid delivery methodologies with experience adapting frameworks to organizational needs
* Experience with data\-driven decision making and building dashboards/reporting frameworks for executive visibility
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to multitask and resilience to meet deadlines and manage stressful situations
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills and experience with stakeholder management at all levels


**Benefits**
**Inclusive by Design**
 At Whiteshield, we champion equal opportunities \- not just in principle, but in practice. We believe the best ideas grow in spaces where every voice is respected, and every background adds value. Our inclusive culture empowers all team members to bring their whole selves to work, knowing their perspectives are welcomed and their contributions matter.
   

  

**Celebrate the Climb**
 We don't just notice high performance \- we reward it. Whether it's through career advancement or peer recognition, we celebrate those who push boundaries and raise the bar. Your growth is our priority.
   

  

**Flexible, Human\-Centered Work**
 We understand that ambition and wellbeing go hand in hand. That's why we offer flexible working models and a culture that values balance, autonomy, and trust. Whether you're recharging or reaching new heights, we want you to thrive \- both inside and outside the office.
   

  

**Impact with Purpose**
 At Whiteshield, your work drives real change. From shaping national labour strategies to advising global climate policy, we work on challenges that matter. For professionals who want their career to stand for something, this is your platform to make it count.
   

  

**Global Mindset**
 Join an international network of economists, data scientists, policy advisors, and strategists \- all collaborating across borders with a shared mission. Expect sharp minds, open conversations, and a genuine team spirit.

 Art Dubai Group is a public\-private partnership with Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) founded in 2007, and has grown to become the most experienced cultural programming company in the Gulf.  **Head of Operations** 
 to lead Art Dubai Group's cross\-company functions and drive operational excellence across the organization, with end\-to\-end accountability for operational performance and team management.  Please share your CV via this job posting.

 a week.

Project Director – Roads \& Infrastructure
 



 Overview
 



 A leading main contractor in the UAE is looking to appoint an experienced Project Director to lead the successful delivery of major roads and infrastructure projects across the region.
 



 The business has an established presence within the infrastructure sector and is currently delivering a portfolio of large\-scale developments including highways, bridges, utilities, public realm, and civil infrastructure works. This role will suit a commercially and operationally driven leader with extensive experience managing complex infrastructure projects from mobilisation through to handover.
 



 The Role
 



 As Project Director, you will hold full responsibility for the overall delivery, commercial performance, programme management, and stakeholder coordination of major infrastructure projects. You will lead multidisciplinary teams, manage client relationships, and ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Lead the delivery of major roads and infrastructure projects across the UAE
* Manage full project lifecycle from pre\-construction through to completion and handover
* Oversee project planning, programme management, construction strategy, and execution
* Ensure projects are delivered in line with contractual, commercial, and operational objectives
* Lead and manage project teams including construction, engineering, commercial, planning, and HSE functions
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants, authorities, and subcontractors
* Drive project performance across cost, programme, quality, safety, and risk management
* Monitor commercial performance, budgets, cash flow, and forecasting alongside commercial teams
* Lead progress meetings and provide regular reporting to senior leadership and stakeholders
* Ensure compliance with local authority regulations, contract requirements, and company standards
* Support business development activities and contribute to future project opportunities
* Mentor and develop senior project staff within the business



 Project Focus
 



 This role is predominantly focused on:
 


* Roads and highway infrastructure
* Utilities and drainage networks
* Bridges and civil engineering works
* Public realm and infrastructure developments
* Large\-scale government and infrastructure projects



 Candidate Requirements
 



 To be considered for this role, candidates should have:
 


* Proven experience working as a Project Director or Senior Project Manager within a main contractor environment
* Strong background delivering major roads and infrastructure projects in the UAE
* Extensive knowledge of civil engineering construction methodologies and project delivery
* Experience managing large multidisciplinary teams on complex infrastructure developments
* Strong commercial awareness and contract management experience
* Excellent stakeholder management and leadership capabilities
* Ability to manage programme delivery within fast\-paced project environments
* Strong communication, reporting, and client\-facing skills
* UAE experience is essential
* Strong public speaking and presentation skills
* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering or related discipline
* 16–18 years’ experience within roads and infrastructure construction



 What's on Offer
 


* Opportunity to lead high\-profile infrastructure developments across the UAE
* Long\-term career progression within a well\-established main contractor
* Exposure to complex, large\-scale civil engineering projects
* Senior leadership role with significant project and operational responsibility
* Dynamic and collaborative working environment



 If you are an experienced infrastructure professional looking to lead major civil engineering projects within a leading contractor environment, this could be an excellent next step in your career.

A trusted partner for millions of customers, Ecolab is a global sustainability leader offering water, hygiene and infection prevention solutions and services that protect people and the resources vital to life. Building on more than a century of innovation, Ecolab has annual sales of $16 billion, employs approximately 48,000 associates and operates in more than 170 countries around the world. The Middle East and Africa Market is one of our highest\-potential growth markets, and we are investing to accelerate that growth through Enterprise AI, data, and digital innovation.
   

  

 As our
 **Enterprise Ai \- Business Engagement Leader** 
**– Middle East Africa** 
 , you will be at the centre of the MEA market leadership team and serve as the senior link between Ecolab’s
 **Enterprise AI** 
 organisation and the Divisions, Functions, and country leaders driving growth across the region. You will fuel the MEA growth agenda with technology and AI\-enabled business outcomes — accountable for the delivery of solutions, from idea to value capture.
   

  

**What’s In It For You**
* Lead the Enterprise AI agenda for one of Ecolab’s highest\-potential international markets
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of AI, data, and digital solutions that directly accelerate top\-line and margin growth across MEA
* Partner with senior Market, Division, and Function leaders as a trusted commercially aware technology advisor
* Shape technology strategy, investment prioritisation, and value capture inside a $16B global sustainability leader
* Influence Enterprise\-wide AI and digital strategy while owning local growth outcomes
* Build and develop a high\-performing team of business process analysts and digital talent across the region
* Competitive total rewards, comprehensive benefits, and global career mobility within Ecolab


**What You Will Do**
**Strategic Partnership \& Growth Alignment** 
 — Build strong partnering relationships with MEA business and function leaders to understand their growth ambitions, commercial priorities, and operational challenges. Align Ecolab’s Technology strategy with the MEA market growth strategy, leveraging technology, AI, and analytics to unlock new revenue, expand share, and improve customer outcomes. Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for the business divisions and functions.
   

  

**Solutions Accountability** 
 — Own the delivery of value stream solutions for MEA — from demand intake and business case, through design, build, deployment, adoption, and value realisation. Hold global delivery teams, partners, and local stakeholders to outcomes, schedule, cost, and quality; remove blockers; and ensure committed business value is captured and reported.
   

  

**IT Project Portfolio Management** 
 — Bring visibility and prioritisation to the portfolio of Enterprise AI and digital projects supporting MEA business and function activities. In line with global governance processes, establish project priorities, secure resource availability, and monitor progress to ensure timely and successful delivery. Manage stakeholder expectations and resolve issues and risks proactively.
   

  

**Digital \& AI Investment Management** 
 — Work with MEA business leaders to determine Enterprise AI and digital investment levels based on growth opportunity, organisational priorities, and budgetary considerations. Provide recommendations on technology investments, cost optimisation, and resource allocation to maximise commercial value and ROI.
   

  

**Business Relationship Management** 
 — Serve as the primary point of contact for MEA business and function leaders on Enterprise AI, data, and digital topics. Drive effective communication, manage expectations, and address systemic issues, escalations, and enhancement requests related to applications, infrastructure, and digital services.
   

  

**Service Delivery Assurance** 
 — Oversee Enterprise AI and Digital service and support processes for the MEA business. Proactively track service levels, drive process improvement, and act as the escalation point for service topics that impact the growth agenda.
   

  

**Demand Intake \& Prioritisation** 
 — Filter and prioritise MEA project requests before the PMO intake process starts. Verify budget exists in the business or Enterprise Ai plan, and confirm business resource readiness. Keep Enterprise AI resources focused on the highest\-value, growth\-aligned work.
   

  

**Governance, Security \& Architecture** 
 — Ensure 100% Security and Enterprise Architecture sign\-off on MEA projects. Drive adoption of standard, secure enterprise platforms that unlock data and AI opportunities at scale and protect the business.
   

  

**Talent \& Team Leadership** 
 — Lead, coach, and develop market\-aligned business process analysts and digital talent. Drive a strong Enterprise AI culture across the MEA team in line with the Ecolab leadership model, managing by influence across the broader Enterprise AI organisation.
   

  

**Position Details**
* Location: Middle East and Africa region (primary hub Dubai)
* Travel: Regional travel across Middle East and Africa; periodic international travel for Enterprise AI and Markets leadership engagements
* Reporting line: Solid\-line to the Global Markets Business Engagement Leader, with close alignment to the MEA Market Head as a member of the MEA market leadership team
* Work model: Full\-time, hybrid


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in a technical, business, or related field
* 10\+ years of relevant experience in IT, Digital, AI/Data, Business Analysis, Programme Management, or a similar leadership role
* Demonstrated accountability and track record for delivery of major technology or digital programmes in a multi\-country, matrixed environment
* Proven business and commercial acumen — experience of partnering with senior business and function leaders, building business cases, and translating technology strategy into measurable growth outcomes
* Experience managing third\-party technology service providers and global delivery partners against outcome\-based commitments
* Strong written and spoken English


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience operating across the Middle East and/or Africa region, including working with local regulatory, cultural, and commercial environments
* Experience leading AI, data, and analytics initiatives that have delivered measurable commercial growth
* Experience in a global manufacturing, B2B services, or industrial environment
* Familiarity with enterprise platforms such as SAP/ERP, CRM, data and analytics, cloud, and security technologies
* Knowledge of Ecolab’s industries — Institutional, Industrial, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Pest Elimination — is a plus
* Additional regional languages (Arabic, French) a plus
* Master’s degree or equivalent (MBA, MSc) a plus


**Key Skills \& Leadership Behaviours**
* Business and commercial acumen — understands P\&L, growth levers, customer economics, and how technology and AI investments translate into commercial outcomes
* Growth mindset — relentless focus on unlocking new revenue, market share, and productivity through Enterprise AI and digital
* Ownership — drives delivery from idea to adoption to value capture, with no hand\-off gaps
* Leadership presence to motivate and develop diverse, multi\-country teams
* Manage by influence — collaborates across global Enterprise AI groups to develop talent and drive results
* Focus and decisiveness — enables action and progress even when faced with ambiguity
* Executive communication — strong stakeholder management at C\-suite and Market leadership level


*Ecolab is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with a disability.*
**About Enterprise AI At Ecolab**
 Enterprise AI is the technology and intelligence engine behind Ecolab’s global growth — delivering the AI, data, platforms, and digital solutions that help our customers and our 48,000 associates operate cleaner, safer, and more sustainably in more than 170 countries. We combine the agility of an AI\-first organisation with the scale and stability of a Fortune 500 enterprise, partnering closely with every Ecolab Division, Market, and Function to turn data and technology into measurable commercial growth.
   

  

 Join us, and help shape what comes next — for Ecolab, for our customers, and for the planet.
   

  

**Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion \& Belonging**
 Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin,citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

* Coordinate with the free\-zone authority on all governance matters
* Run quarterly governance reviews with the CFO


**Objective 2 \- Lead regulatory affairs and authority relationships**
 Outcome: PFM operates with regulatory clarity in the UAE and can navigate questions from authorities quickly and credibly.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Own the regulatory map for PFM's activities in the UAE (free\-zone, federal, financial\-services adjacencies)
* Build and maintain relationships with regulators, free\-zone authorities, banks, and key service providers
* Track regulatory changes affecting PFM and translate them into business impact and action items
* Lead any direct regulator engagement or audit on PFM's behalf, in coordination with legal counsel
* Partner with internal and external legal counsel on the UAE legal landscape — contracts, employment law, FZCO governance, commercial agreements, and dispute resolution


**Objective 3 \- Manage UAE operations: banking, tax, audit, and admin**
 Outcome: All UAE\-side operational rails (banking, corporate tax, VAT, audit, visas, office, vendors) run smoothly with no surprises.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Manage banking relationships and resolve account\-, transaction\-, or compliance\-related issues
* Oversee UAE corporate tax (9%) and VAT registration, filings, and compliance with the Federal Tax Authority
* Lead the annual statutory audit cycle in coordination with the Finance function
* Sponsor visas for UAE\-based hires and manage related immigration, residency, and renewal workflows
* Own the UAE office presence (if applicable), vendor contracts, insurance, and local administration


**Objective 4 \- Partner with leadership on UAE strategic initiatives**
 Outcome: Leadership has a trusted UAE partner who can scope, scale, and de\-risk any new initiative anchored in the region.
   

  

 Typical tasks:
   

  

* Advise leadership on the regulatory and operational implications of new products, partnerships, or markets
* Lead UAE\-specific initiatives such as banking expansion, new entity structures, or regulatory licensing
* Represent PFM in select UAE industry forums and at high\-trust meetings with partners or authorities
* Surface risks and opportunities to the CFO and CEO with clear written analysis


**What We Look For**
**Must have**
* 7\+ years of operations, regulatory, or compliance leadership experience in the UAE
* Hands\-on familiarity with one or more UAE free zones (e.g., DMCC, IFZA, DIFC, ADGM, JAFZA)
* Strong working knowledge of UAE corporate tax, VAT, and Federal Tax Authority requirements
* Experience managing banking relationships and resolving compliance / KYC matters with UAE banks
* Track record of running statutory audits and filings end\-to\-end
* Demonstrated experience working with internal or external legal counsel on UAE\-specific matters — contracts, employment law, free\-zone governance, or commercial agreements
* Excellent English; comfortable operating in a remote\-first, async\-first environment


**Nice to have**
* Background in fintech, financial services, brokerage, or trading\-adjacent industries
* DIFC or ADGM\-specific licensing experience
* Working Arabic — useful for direct regulator and bank conversations
* Existing relationships with UAE regulators, free\-zone authorities, or top legal / audit firms
* Experience scaling a UAE entity through tax or regulatory transitions (e.g., corporate tax rollout)


**Compensation**
 $6,000\-$10,000 / month gross
   

  

**Reporting cadence**
 Reports to: Albert B., CFO.
   

  

 Direct reports: None at hire. May grow to include UAE\-based operational staff over time.
   

  

 Key cross\-functional partners: Finance, Leadership (Martin J., John R., Ashlee C.), HR, Legal counsel, external auditors and bankers.
   

  

 Upward reporting cadence: Weekly 1:1 with CFO; monthly written summary covering compliance, regulator interactions, and operational risks; quarterly strategic review with leadership.
   

  

**Location \& work setup**
* Location: UAE\-based (Dubai preferred), with the ability to be physically present at relevant authorities, banks, and the free\-zone office when needed
* Working hours: Flexible, with reasonable overlap with CET hours (4\+ hours of overlap)
* Employment type: Full\-time


**Benefits**
**Hiring stages**
 We keep our process simple, transparent, and respectful of your time. Here's what to expect:
   

  

* Application screening We carefully review all applications to identify candidates whose background aligns with the role's requirements. You'll receive a timely and transparent update on your application status
* Video intro \+ role fit questionnaire A short async step \- no scheduling required. You'll record a brief video introduction and complete a written questionnaire. This helps us understand who you are, your relevant background, and how your experience aligns with the role without either side committing to a live call upfront
* Discovery HR Interview A conversation with our HR team focused on company and culture match. We'll walk you through how PFM works, what remote ownership looks like in practice, and what success in this role looks like. You'll have plenty of space to ask questions and share your goals
* Real\-world task (paid) A short, scoped exercise based on a real PFM UAE operations or regulatory challenge. We compensate for your time because we believe that's the right way to do it. This stage is designed to give both sides a realistic view of the work before committing further
* Professional interview You will meet our CFO, Albert B., to focus on your UAE operations and regulatory expertise — entity governance, banking, tax, free\-zone matters, and how you approach complex regulatory situations. This is the decisive conversation on domain skills and role\-specific experience
* Peer \& values conversation A cross\-team interview evaluated against PFM's structured values scorecard. You'll meet a peer (Rana Eh.) and a bar raiser (Konstantinos K., Head of Data \& Analytics) from outside the immediate team
* Leadership interview (optional) A conversation with a peer from across the team focused on values, culture, and how you work best. You'll have plenty of space to ask questions and get a real feel for life at PFM


 If there's a strong mutual match, we start with an informal conversation to align on expectations, then follow up with a formal written offer. Full transparency throughout, and time for you to make an informed decision.
   

  

**Before applying take into account that:**
 ▸ If you don't meet every single qualification but believe you can excel in the role based on what it requires \- we encourage you to apply.
   

  

 ▸ We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
   

  

 ▸ Even if it's not listed as a formal requirement, we truly value candidates who have clear familiarity with the prop trading industry and us, our mission and what we do.
   

  

**Not the right fit for this role?**
 If this role isn't the right match but you have experience in trading operations, customer success, compliance, support, partnerships, or a related area \- we still want to hear from you. Join our Talent Pool and we'll reach out when a relevant role opens. Every submission is reviewed, and the pool is always the first place we look before opening a new search.

**Description**
 Amazon works hard to delight customers – from the second an order is placed online to the seamless coordination of that order behind the scenes, we strive to stay agile, \& fluid. Have you ever ordered a product on Amazon and when that box with the smile arrived you wondered how it got to you so fast?
   

  

 If so, the Amazon Now team is for you. We partner directly with product and software teams to develop the future of quick commerce.
   

  

 The Tech SME team acts as a catalyst for change by driving innovation at the operator level, prioritizing technology initiatives and supporting engineering design innovations. Tech SMEs strive to be experts in Amazon’s operation systems. They are accountable to delivering world class solutions through optimizing and reinventing the existing technology.
   

  

 The Tech SME is a functional expert on the software tools in given process areas and their application in the network. A successful manager in this organization has strong program management experience to define the process the team uses to deliver best in class tech to the field. This person looks for ways to automate human decision making by influencing Technology to build and update tools that reduce process complexity to deliver robust processes.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Subject Matter Expert (SME) supports, coordinates and facilitates implementation of new \& improved processes within the quick commerce operations. The SME works closely with the store operations, last mile delivery teams, and local \& global product teams. They will be the single point of contact for all tech related activities related with Supply Chain (SC), Under the roof (UTR) and On the road (OTR) and will be providing regular updates to senior leadership team.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead technology programs and initiatives for darkstore operations, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems
* Drive Under the Roof (UTR) and On the Road (OTR) operations programs at the darkstore level, optimizing inbound, warehouse, and last\-mile delivery processes
* Build low\-cost automations using AI tools such as KIRO, Quick, and related operations to drive efficiency and reduce manual processes
* Prepare \& lead the tech roadmap for improvement of hybrid warehouse management system (HWMS) for inbound and outbound processes
* Prepare \& lead the tech roadmap for enhancement of delivery service, working closely with the 3P partners \& DSP teams
* Collaborate with worldwide (WW) product and tech teams of HWMS/PRIMS and Last Mile to launch products in Quick commerce (QC) business
* Work closely with the tech organization to document and drive upcoming changes, leveraging tools such as business requirement documents (BRDs) to ensure seamless integration with the existing system.
* Provide regular, concise updates to Tech SME leadership on the progress of the system's development and its potential impact.
* Develop the culture of continuous improvement and Kaizen across tech \& operations to optimize processes and reduce SLAs
* Support new store launches, including but not limited to configurations, Quality Assurance (QA), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), etc., coordinating with multiple global product \& tech teams and work with external stakeholders to continuously reduce the time to launch a store
* Provide trainings to operations on new systems and processes
* Maintain strong relationship with the IN, NA, MENA, ROW tech teams working for QC business

* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience

The Senior Project Manager acts as the key interface between the client, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders to ensure that the client’s vision and brand standards are achieved.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





 Project Leadership \& Planning
 


* Lead project delivery activities in alignment with company objectives and brand values.
* Develop, manage, and monitor project programs, budgets, and risk registers.
* Coordinate feasibility studies, site due diligence, and design development.
* Ensure compliance with local authority regulations, health and safety requirements, and sustainability objectives.



  





 Design \& Consultant Management
 


* Support the development team manage multidisciplinary design teams (architectural, interior design, MEP, structural, etc.) to ensure timely and coordinated outputs.
* Support the review of design documentation to ensure alignment with project brief, budget, and operational requirements.

 Procurement \& Contract Administration
 


* Support tendering and appointment of consultants, contractors, and suppliers.
* Review and recommend procurement strategies suitable for luxury hospitality and residential developments.
* Administer contracts in coordination with commercial and legal teams, ensuring compliance and fair execution.



  





 Construction \& Site Management
 


* Monitor construction progress, quality standards, and adherence to design intent.
* Conduct regular site inspections and progress meetings.
* Manage contractor performance and ensure timely resolution of technical and contractual issues.



  





 Stakeholder \& Client Interface
 


* Act as the principal client representative for all project\-related matters.
* Prepare and deliver regular project reports, presentations, and dashboards to senior management.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, ensuring alignment with project vision, cost, and delivery targets.



  





 Handover \& Closeout
 


* Oversee testing, commissioning, snagging, and final handover processes.
* Ensure proper documentation, operation manuals, and as\-built drawings are delivered.
* Support transition to operations and post\-completion evaluations.



  





  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





 Education \& Certifications
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management (Master’s degree preferred).
* Professional accreditation such as PMP, RICS, MRICS, MCIOB, or equivalent is highly desirable.



  





 Experience
 


* Minimum 10–15 years of relevant experience, with at least 5 years in the UAE or GCC region.
* Proven track record of managing luxury hospitality and high\-end residential projects from inception to completion.
* Experience working within client or developer organizations preferred.
* Strong knowledge of FIDIC\-based contracts, local permitting processes, and regional construction practices.



  





 Skills \& Attributes
 


* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong financial acumen and ability to manage budgets and forecasts.
* High attention to detail with a commitment to delivering excellence.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with multicultural teams.

This role combines project delivery with hands\-on supervision of building systems, vendor management, and workplace services.  Lead end\-to\-end facilities projects: office fit\-outs, renovations, relocations, HVAC upgrades, electrical works, and space optimization. Define scope, budget, timelines, and quality standards. Manage contractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders from initiation to handover.

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary** 




 We are seeking a proactive and experienced Mid\-Level IT Project Manager in Sharjah to lead and coordinate IT and digital transformation projects. The ideal candidate will manage project execution, stakeholder communication, timelines, risks, vendors, and delivery quality while ensuring alignment with business objectives and client expectations.
 



 The role requires strong project coordination skills, hands\-on follow\-up, and the ability to work within multicultural environments and fast\-paced customer engagements.
 



  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Manage end\-to\-end delivery of IT projects from initiation to closure.
* Prepare and maintain project plans, schedules, RAID logs, and status reports.
* Coordinate internal teams, subcontractors, vendors, and client stakeholders.
* Monitor project scope, budget, timelines, and resource allocation.
* Conduct regular project meetings and prepare meeting minutes/action trackers.
* Identify project risks, issues, and dependencies and drive mitigation plans.
* Ensure compliance with project governance, processes, and quality standards.
* Support change request management and impact assessments.
* Track project deliverables and ensure timely execution.
* Communicate project progress and escalations to management and clients.
* Support procurement, technical coordination, UAT, testing, and handover activities.
* Ensure proper project documentation and reporting.



  





**Requirements:** 



* Experience managing medium\-scale IT infrastructure, software, systems integration, or smart technology projects.
* Familiarity with project management methodologies (Waterfall / Agile / Hybrid).
* Strong understanding of project lifecycle and stakeholder management.
* Excellent communication and reporting skills.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Experience working with government entities
* PMP or PRINCE2 certification.
* Vendor and subcontractor management experience.
* Familiarity with MS Project.
* Strong communication in English (Arabic is a plus)
* Flexiblility to work with multiple time zones in Europe and US
* Valid UAE driving license and access to a personal vehicle

data.jd_text:
**Job Description – Expert, Special Projects** 




**Function:** 
 Strategy and Transformation
 



  





**1\. Role Purpose** 




 The Expert – Special Projects plays a critical role within the Strategy and Transformation function, leading high\-impact, strategic initiatives that are central to the organization’s value creation agenda. These initiatives form a core and sustained part of the Strategy and Transformation function’s mandate and require strong ownership, intellectual leadership, and the ability to translate complex business challenges into practical, high\-value outcomes.
 



 Reporting to the Group Director – Strategy \& Transformation, this role offers the opportunity to work directly on Board\- and leadership\-sponsored initiatives, shaping key decisions and driving measurable impact across the organization. The incumbent is expected to independently structure and solve complex problems, develop robust analytical insights, and lead cross\-functional execution to deliver sustainable business results.
 



 Operating within a fast\-paced, high\-performance environment, the role provides exposure to a collaborative and results\-driven team focused on driving growth, transformation, and enterprise\-wide success. It is suited for experienced professionals who thrive in dynamic environments, bring strong commercial acumen, and are motivated to deliver tangible impact and long\-term value.
 



  





**2\. Key Accountabilities** 




**Special Projects Delivery** 



* Lead assigned special projects from concept to completion, including problem definition, scoping, planning, execution, and closure
* Translate high\-level leadership directives into structured initiatives with clear workplans, milestones, and measurable outcomes
* Define project approach, methodologies, and success metrics to ensure practical and implementable solutions



  





**Types of Projects Managed** 




 Initiatives focused on unlocking step\-change value across the business—including revenue growth, market expansion, profitability uplift, and structural cost transformation—through rigorous analysis, zero\-based problem solving, and decisive performance interventions and Board/leadership\-driven strategic deep\-dives.
 



**Analysis \& Value Creation** 



* Conduct detailed quantitative and qualitative analyses to identify opportunities for revenue growth, cost optimization, and performance improvement
* Perform financial analysis, including P\&L impact assessment, cost\-benefit analysis, and business case development
* Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and value\-driven recommendations



**Implementation** 



* Drive end\-to\-end implementation of initiatives, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to defined objectives
* Track progress, risks, and issues, and proactively resolve challenges to maintain delivery momentum
* Ensure recommendations are implemented with clear ownership, measurable outcomes, and sustainability



**Stakeholder Management** 



* Engage closely with cross\-functional stakeholders to gather inputs, validate assumptions, and align on solutions
* Influence and challenge stakeholders through fact\-based analysis and structured communication
* Coordinate across functions to ensure successful execution and sustained adoption of outcomes



**Reporting \& Executive Communication** 



* Prepare high\-quality executive presentations, business cases, and structured reports for senior leadership
* Present findings, recommendations, and progress updates to leadership forums
* Develop dashboards, trackers, and performance reports using tools such as Power BI and Excel



**Continuous Improvement** 



* Contribute to the development of tools, methodologies, and best practices for managing special projects
* Capture lessons learned and institutionalize successful approaches across the Transformation function



  





**3\. Skills Required** 




**Technical \& Professional Skills** 



* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capability, with ability to structure complex and ambiguous problems
* Solid financial analysis skills, including business case development, P\&L understanding, and value tracking
* Proven experience in project management and delivery of cross\-functional initiatives
* Advanced proficiency in:
* Excel (financial modelling, data analysis)
* Power BI (dashboarding, data visualization)
* PowerPoint (executive\-level presentations)



**Experience Requirements** 



* Approximately
 **10 years of relevant experience** 
 in strategy, transformation, consulting, or project\-driven roles
* **Preferred background in top\-tier or reputable consulting firms** 
 , or equivalent experience in transformation / strategy functions within large organizations
* Demonstrated experience in handling
 **ambiguous, high\-impact, leadership\-driven initiatives**



**Behavioural \& Leadership Skills** 



* Ability to operate independently in fast\-paced, high\-demand environments with multiple priorities
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across seniority levels
* Excellent communication skills—clear, structured, and concise
* High ownership, accountability, and results orientation
* Strong interpersonal skills with a collaborative working style



**Core Competencies** 



* Structured thinking and attention to detail
* Commercial and value\-driven mindset
* Execution discipline and delivery focus
* Adaptability and learning agility

data.title: Project Manager
data.raw_snippet:
**Duties And Responsibilities**
 Take responsibility and ownership for executing the project end\-to\-end and for delivery of project on time with good quality and profitability.
   

  

**Project Initiation**
* Outline project execution strategy and submit to management prior to project kick\-off
data.jd_text:
**Duties And Responsibilities**
 Take responsibility and ownership for executing the project end\-to\-end and for delivery of project on time with good quality and profitability.
   

  

**Project Initiation**
* Outline project execution strategy and submit to management prior to project kick\-off meeting
* Ensure preparation of detailed project schedule with appropriate milestones, based on contract.
* Ensure that drawings are obtained from design team. Review and approve drawings prior to submission to client and monitor and review all rework and resubmissions until final approval is obtained.
* Work with Finance and Management team to prepare ACE and get it approved.
* Define initial organization of project team, competencies required based on contract and project scope and work with HR to hire members for key positions immediately. Define detailed org chart subsequently and take steps to build an effective team with required skill set and mobilize the team.
* Evaluate available sub\-contractor options and get quote from suitable ones and submit to management. Participate in a meeting with other committee members ( BU Head, regional head, finance head etc) to finalize sub\-contractor.
* Ensure resource mobilization for the project at various stages, as required.
* Ensure that soil testing and initial site assessments are completed properly as per schedule.
* Ensure that procurement is on track and provide necessary support for the same.
* Review and finalize Project Quality Manual (PQM) and Health and safety Manual ( HSM)
* Establish relationship with all stakeholders including the client and CE and internal stakeholders including management team, supporting teams.


**Project Execution And Completion**
* Ensure resource deployment and mobilization as per project strategy and project requirements.
* Ensure material procurement and logistics are on track and site is ready to receive materials as per delivery schedule.
* Set up efficient systems and processes to ensure smooth interactions between various departments.
* Monitor and keep abreast of all site activities and ensure that all issues and concerns are addressed in a timely manner.
* Monitor progress periodically against schedule, quality standards and budget (ACE), as well as against contractual requirements, client requirements and company standards. Highlight critical points and propose corrective action plans.
* Ensure adherence of every function and process to PQM and HSM right through the project lifecycle. Monitor NCR and keep a check on LTI.
* Prepare risk assessment and mitigation plans.
* Organize weekly project review meetings with project team, site team and Engineering team (Head Quarter) to understand the design progress, actual project progress in terms of SPI, CPI, EVM etc. and provide appropriate action plans.
* Present project status updates to the management team during management review meetings
* Gather extensive knowledge on local people and communities in order to arrange social awareness programs for site teams.


**Team Management**
* Provide guidance and support to the various project teams to achieve their respective goals.
* Ensure that all teams are communicating with each other appropriately.
* Conduct weekly review meetings with site team.
* Ensure that site team and workmen are motivated and engaged and ensure that all their basic needs are met.
* Ensure that new joiners are inducted and on\-boarded effectively.


**Client/Consultant Management**
* Establish a good working relationship with the client and CE and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Represent the company’s interests while dealing with the client/CE.
* Ensure that progress reports are shared with client/CE as per agreed terms.
* Keep the client informed of any changes/developments/major deviations from contract required during execution and get required approvals.
* Ensure that all client approvals are obtained appropriately and without delay and all client/CE inspections are conducted as per contract. Address any variations contractually.
* Approve all communications to the client, from members of the project team.
* Attend review meetings, along with project \& execution team as required when arranged by client or CE.


**Sub\-contractor Management**
* Ensure mobilization of sub\-contractor’s resources as per project plan
* Ensure development and implementation of sub\-contractor’s work plan and reporting/review mechanism.
* Monitor quality and safety plan implementation by sub\-cotractors


**Reporting**
* Review periodic reports submitted by heads of departments and take necessary actions.
* Ensure the periodic submission of all review reports on EHS, Quality, Schedule and Cost related items to BU Head/ Head of operations(SS/TL) as per mutually agreed terms
* Ensure the periodic submission of all review reports on EHS, Quality and Schedule related items to Client/CE as per contract.


**Financial**
* Prepare and periodically review project related budgets.
* Monitor and control cost to ensure profitability of project is maintained.
* Ensure that sales targets are achieved and invoicing and collections are done on time.
* Develop strategy for Processing Claims and implement it with all relevant stakeholders including customers, suppliers, partners, insurances and other third parties.


**Statutory**
* Manage contracts effectively with internal and external stakeholders, CE and client.
* Ensure that work adheres to all statutory requirements and policies on safety, environment and community issues as per contract, company policies and law of land.
* Be the front end for bidding for all local legislative and administrative government authorities.


**Role Requirements**
**Education :** 
 BE Electrical
   

  

**Experience**
 Electrical Substation projects:
   

  

* Should have 15 to 20 years’ experience in Electrical/Civil/Mechanical aspects of SS Projects Experience in the project management of medium / large size EPC projects.
