data.jd_text:
**About Al Marwan Group** 




 Founded in 1978, Al Marwan Group is a diversified organization serving the construction, heavy machinery, Oil \& Gas, real estate, development, and hospitality sectors across the GCC. The Group operates through multiple business units and subsidiaries, delivering integrated solutions supported by strong operational expertise and a well\-established regional presence.
 



  





**Role Summary** 




 We are seeking an experienced
 **Project Manager** 
 to lead large\-scale roads and infrastructure projects across the UAE. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in delivering complex projects, including highways, bridges, tunnels, interchanges, earthworks, and utility networks. The role is responsible for overall project execution, commercial performance, stakeholder management, safety compliance, and on\-time project delivery.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Project Leadership \& Delivery** 



* Lead the planning, execution, and successful delivery of major roads and infrastructure projects, including highways, bridges, tunnels, interchanges, earthworks, and utility networks.
* Manage multidisciplinary teams to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
* Develop and monitor project schedules, resource plans, and performance targets, implementing corrective actions where necessary.



**Commercial \& Contract Management** 



* Oversee project financial performance, including budgeting, cost control, forecasting, procurement, and profitability.
* Administer contracts in accordance with FIDIC conditions, managing risks, claims, variations, and contractual obligations.
* Drive value engineering and operational efficiency initiatives throughout the project lifecycle.



**Stakeholder \& Authority Management** 



* Act as the primary liaison with clients, consultants, developers, and government authorities.
* Coordinate approvals, permits, NOCs, and project handovers with relevant UAE authorities.
* Lead project review meetings and provide regular progress updates to senior management and stakeholders.



**Quality, Safety \& Compliance** 



* Ensure full compliance with HSE regulations, project specifications, and quality standards.
* Promote a strong safety culture and oversee the implementation of QA/QC procedures across all project phases.
* Maintain adherence to UAE regulations, contractual requirements, and industry best practices.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




**Education** 



* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized university.
* PMP Certification or equivalent professional project management qualification is highly preferred.
* Professional membership or chartership (ICE, ASCE, PMI, or equivalent) is advantageous.



**Experience** 



* 15–20 years of experience in heavy civil engineering and infrastructure construction.
* Minimum 7–10 years of recent UAE experience with leading contracting companies.
* Proven track record as Lead Project Manager on infrastructure projects.
* Extensive experience in bridges, highways, tunnels, earthworks, deep utility networks, and complex infrastructure developments.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong technical expertise in infrastructure construction methodologies and engineering practices.
* Comprehensive knowledge of FIDIC contracts, claims management, cost control, and commercial administration.
* Proficiency in Primavera P6, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and ERP systems such as SAP or Oracle.
* Exceptional leadership, decision\-making, conflict resolution, and crisis management capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluent in English. Arabic language proficiency is an added advantage.
* Valid UAE Driving License.

data.title: Global Program Engineer Manager -  Digitalization
data.raw_snippet:
Join Our Team at Eaton: Empowering Tomorrow, Today!
   

  

 Dubai serves as a strategic hub for Eaton’s Middle East operations, bringing together commercial, engineering, manufacturing, and support teams within a globally connected business environment. Building on more than 40 years in the region
data.jd_text:
Join Our Team at Eaton: Empowering Tomorrow, Today!
   

  

 Dubai serves as a strategic hub for Eaton’s Middle East operations, bringing together commercial, engineering, manufacturing, and support teams within a globally connected business environment. Building on more than 40 years in the region, Eaton recently announced the development of a new sustainable campus in Dubai, reinforcing our long‑term investment in growth, collaboration, and capability building.
   

  

 Eaton's Global Data Center Segment is focused on helping data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future. With the rise of big data, edge computing and cloud, data centers are under pressure to be more high\-performing, sustainable and cost\-effective than ever, without compromising resilience or security. At the same time, new opportunities and revenue streams require faster speed\-to\-market. With our digital intelligence, world\-class cyber\-secure products and services, reliable, compatible solutions and engineering expertise, we help data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future.
   

  

 Within this segment, Eaton has an opening for
 **Global Program Engineer Manager \- Digitalization.** 
 This role is a strategic, globally scoped position responsible for defining, deploying, and governing Eaton’s post‑order execution framework, PMO standards, and digital operating model across the Global Data Center Segment.
   

  

 This role ensures consistent, predictable, and scalable execution of complex, multi‑region data center programs by establishing global governance, driving digital adoption, and enabling transparency across order execution, engineering, services, and regional delivery teams. The position serves as the single point of accountability for PMO governance and digitalization within the Global Data Center Segment and operates as a key partner to regional leaders, functional owners, and global program teams.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Global PMO Governance**
* Define and own the global PMO governance model for post‑order execution across all regions (Americas, EMEA, APAC).
* Establish standardized program lifecycle frameworks, phase gates, escalation paths, and decision rights aligned with Eaton’s matrixed operating model.
* Ensure governance rigor for large, complex, and multi‑site data center programs, including hyperscale and strategic customer engagements.
* Act as the central authority for program health reviews, executive escalations, and cross‑regional issue resolution.


**Digitalization \& Tool Enablement**
* Lead the digital transformation of post‑order execution, driving adoption of standardized tools, dashboards, and digital workflows.
* Define global requirements for program visibility, KPI reporting, risk management, and forecast accuracy.
* Partner with Digital, IT, and functional teams to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Enable real‑time transparency for leadership through data‑driven insights and standardized reporting.


**Execution Excellence \& Performance Management**
* Define and govern global KPIs covering schedule adherence, cost performance, change management, execution risk, and customer commitments.
* Drive consistency in program cadence, review rhythms, and performance metrics across regions.
* Identify systemic execution gaps and lead continuous improvement initiatives to improve speed, predictability, and customer outcomes.
* Support post‑mortems and lessons‑learned processes to institutionalize best practices globally.


**Cross** 
**‑** 
**Functional \& Regional Leadership**
* Operate as a trusted partner to Post Order, Engineering, Services, Supply Chain, Sales, and Regional Operations leaders.
* Influence without direct authority in a highly matrixed, global organization.
* Support organizational change management (OCM) for new governance models, tools, and ways of working.
* Serve as a connector between global strategy and regional execution realities.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business, Operations, or a related discipline from an accredited institution.
* \+12 years of experience in program management, PMO leadership, or execution governance within complex, global organizations.
* Experience using Salesforce in an enterprise or global environment to support strategic customers, complex program execution, and multi‑region reporting.


**Skills**
* Experience in data centers, mission‑critical infrastructure, power systems, or large‑scale capital projects.
* Strong background in digital PMO tools, dashboards, and execution analytics.
* Experience supporting or governing post‑order, delivery, or execution‑heavy environments.
* Familiarity with Agile, hybrid, or scaled program management methodologies in industrial or infrastructure contexts.
* Experience working in or with EMEA‑based global teams.


**Why Join Eaton**
* Competitive compensation and benefits, aligned with your experience and impact.
* Opportunity to work on challenging, high‑impact projects within a dynamic and collaborative team environment.
* Your aspirations matter – Eaton actively supports internal mobility and promotes from within whenever possible.
* Your growth matters – We invest in long‑term development through continuous learning, upskilling, and global programs via Eaton University.
* Your contributions matter – Reliability, safety, efficiency, and sustainability are at the heart of what we do, driving meaningful impact on people’s lives and the environment.
* Your wellbeing matters – Health, safety, and wellness are a priority. At Eaton, wellbeing goes beyond programs, empowering employees with the tools and environment to thrive.


**Living And Working In Dubai**
 Dubai is an internationally connected city that offers strong professional opportunities within a truly global environment. Living and working in Dubai means being part of a diverse, forward‑looking business community, supported by modern infrastructure, excellent connectivity, and a well‑established expatriate ecosystem.
   

  

 At Eaton, employees based in Dubai are part of a stable, well‑governed organization that brings together global teams, clear ways of working, and the flexibility needed to support both performance and long‑term career development.
   

  

 All positions may require participation in video and in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job\-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.
   

  

 We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

data.jd_text:
**Description**
 Amazon is looking for a motivated individual for the profile of ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence Systems) Program Manager for its AMET operations team. The candidate should enjoy getting their hands dirty, and looking around the corners for solutions with the aim of optimization of OTR operations in Amazon’s last mile delivery stations.
   

  

 As an ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence Systems) program manager, you will be the subject matter expert for UTR and OTR operations driving capacity enhancements and utilization improvements in both.
   

  

 You will be a subject matter expert on routing and sortation operations and accountable for RUBL60 and sort grid utilization metrics. You should be able to think big to solve complex problems with simple and practical solutions by developing a deep knowledge of the operation processes.
   

  

 This role calls for an individual who can own all aspects of how transportation impacts customer experience, shipper experience and operator experience; monitor metrics, determine, then drive any initiatives necessary to improve it. It requires an individual to showcase judgement and decision\-making skills to balance customer experience with financial impact. This position offers a broad exposure to various business, financial, and technical teams within Amazon.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a person who enjoys and excels at dealing with ambiguity and design and define products/programs with little information. He / She will have excellent written and verbal communication skills, the ability to create and sustain urgency, and a proven ability to lead cross\-functional projects including communication across all levels and teams in the organization: senior leaders, technical teams, finance, business, and operations leaders.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As UTR and OTR capacity SME, you will responsible for:
   

  

* Driving (accountable) RUBL60 and Sort Grid utilization metrics across MEATR region.
* Invent solutions to solve complex business problems.
* Provide corresponding tools to support Central Ops.
* Build mechanisms and monitor RUBL60 and Bag utilization metrics on a daily basis. Identify root causes and corrective/preventive actions for misses.
* Discuss trends and unusual behaviors of the RUBL60 and bag utilization metric.
* Provide sustainable solutions and effective guidance across the organization.
* Leverage route planning metrics to define, characterize areas of improvement.
* Collaborate with Tech/Science teams to enhance route planning systems.
* Aim to produce routes that are efficient and maximize the time utilization without impacting drivers' workload.
* Influence Route Planning teams to build models that generate fair, sustainable, and efficient delivery routes.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

 The Tech SME is a functional expert on the software tools in given process areas and their application in the network. A successful manager in this organization has strong program management experience to define the process the team uses to deliver best in class tech to the field. This person looks for ways to automate human decision making by influencing Technology to build and update tools that reduce process complexity to deliver robust processes.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Subject Matter Expert (SME) supports, coordinates and facilitates implementation of new \& improved processes within the quick commerce operations. The SME works closely with the store operations, last mile delivery teams, and local \& global product teams. They will be the single point of contact for all tech related activities related with Supply Chain (SC), Under the roof (UTR) and On the road (OTR) and will be providing regular updates to senior leadership team.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead technology programs and initiatives for darkstore operations, ensuring seamless integration with existing systems
* Drive Under the Roof (UTR) and On the Road (OTR) operations programs at the darkstore level, optimizing inbound, warehouse, and last\-mile delivery processes
* Build low\-cost automations using AI tools such as KIRO, Quick, and related operations to drive efficiency and reduce manual processes
* Prepare \& lead the tech roadmap for improvement of hybrid warehouse management system (HWMS) for inbound and outbound processes
* Prepare \& lead the tech roadmap for enhancement of delivery service, working closely with the 3P partners \& DSP teams
* Collaborate with worldwide (WW) product and tech teams of HWMS/PRIMS and Last Mile to launch products in Quick commerce (QC) business
* Work closely with the tech organization to document and drive upcoming changes, leveraging tools such as business requirement documents (BRDs) to ensure seamless integration with the existing system.
* Provide regular, concise updates to Tech SME leadership on the progress of the system's development and its potential impact.
* Develop the culture of continuous improvement and Kaizen across tech \& operations to optimize processes and reduce SLAs
* Support new store launches, including but not limited to configurations, Quality Assurance (QA), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), etc., coordinating with multiple global product \& tech teams and work with external stakeholders to continuously reduce the time to launch a store
* Provide trainings to operations on new systems and processes
* Maintain strong relationship with the IN, NA, MENA, ROW tech teams working for QC business


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

data.jd_text:
**About Us** 




 We are a fast\-growing FinTech company licensed by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA). Our mission is to provide innovative financial solutions that bridge technology and finance, ensuring transparency, efficiency, and customer\-centric services. We operate in a highly regulated environment and uphold the highest standards of compliance, governance, and operational excellence.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking a highly experienced and strategic Senior Executive Officer (SEO)/ Managing Director to lead our Dubai operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing the branch’s overall performance, ensuring compliance with DFSA regulations, managing key stakeholder relationships, and driving the company’s growth in the region.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Ensuring compliance with DFSA requirements.
* Develop and implement strategic plans to achieve business growth and profitability.
* Maintain strong relationships with regulators, financial institutions, partners, and clients.
* Oversee risk management, governance, and compliance frameworks.
* Ensure operational excellence, including internal controls, reporting, and staff management.
* Represent the company at industry forums, networking events, and regulatory discussions.
* Provide leadership, mentorship, and motivation to the team.
* Attract new banking partners and identify market opportunities.
* Build and lead a small sales / business development team (“hunters”).



  





**Requirements** 



* Proven track record in a senior leadership role (Financial services or FinTech will be an advantage).
* In\-depth knowledge of DFSA regulations.
* Strong experience in relationship management, operations, or business development in the financial, banking, or fintech sector.
* Understanding of compliance, regulatory frameworks, and partner\-bank relations
* Exceptional leadership, a mix of structured thinking, communication skills, and diplomacy \- amicable yet professional.
* Ability to take ownership, act independently, and grow companies to a new level.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Opportunity to lead and shape the growth of a DFSA\-licensed FinTech company.
* Competitive compensation package.
* Dynamic and innovative work environment.
* Exposure to a fast\-evolving financial technology sector.

data.jd_text:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together. The Company’s three core products are Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world; Lens Studio, an augmented reality platform that powers AR across Snapchat and other services; and its AR glasses, Spectacles.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Head of Public Policy, MEA to join Snap Inc. As a member of the EMEA Public Policy team, the role reports to the Senior Director Public Policy EMEA. You will be responsible for the public policy and government relations work across the MEA region, with a particular focus on UAE and Saudi Arabia, as well as Qatar and potentially further afield in Africa. Working from our office in Dubai, you will co\-design, and execute the implementation of the public policy plan for relevant markets. The Middle East and Africa are key growth regions for Snap and our relationships with the governments and other key public stakeholders are of the utmost importance. Ensuring that Snap’s distinctive voice is heard and accommodated in policy\-making circles will be a key priority.
   

  

 The Head of Public Policy is co\-responsible for development of positions on key local and regional policy issues impacting Snap and for developing effective strategies to achieve policy outcomes and mitigate risk. This person will work closely with the rest of the Global Public Policy team, wider Legal team, regional Sales teams, the Communications team, Platform Integrity and Product teams and, on occasion, senior business executives to ensure the public policy program supports business growth and protects the company’s interests.
   

  

 What you’ll do:
   

  

* Serve as the main day\-to\-day policy representative of Snap Inc in the Middle East and Africa. Further deepen relationships with relevant government officials, NGOs, trade associations, non\-governmental organizations, and other influential stakeholders.
* Work closely with the Senior Director EMEA of Public Policy, the EMEA Public Policy team, the SVP Global Policy \& Platform Operations and, on occasion, the senior executive organization.
* Being the Policy spokesperson of the company in the region in various fora, events etc.
* Be the first to act and respond to the appropriate public policy inquiries.
* Collaborate with Public Policy, Legal and Business teams to analyze legislative initiatives, advise on risks and opportunities and develop company policy positions and messaging
* Partner with the Communications team to help them appropriately respond to Policy\-related media inquiries, by providing the correct policy narrative that best represents Snap Inc.


 Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:
   

  

* A proven ability for shaping, and working with, government officials, NGOs, coalitions and other stakeholder groups.
* Good tech policy understanding and existing relationships within government and the wider stakeholder community in the region.
* Excellent communication and advocacy skills and sound political judgment.
* Forward thinking and proactive ability on legislative, regulatory and public policy issues. Ability to rapidly understand and master complex policy issues.
* Ability to work with Snap business to identify pertinent issues and orient the public policy team to meet priorities.
* Ability to work independently/ self\-starter in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment
* Demonstrated ability to work with a wide range of external groups and individuals, including those who are opponents or critics.
* Teammate with a positive attitude, motivation and a sense of humor
* Articulate and thoughtful.
* Able to adapt communication on complex issues for different audiences.
* A passion for Snapchat and creativity.


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Master's degree or advanced studies in law/economics/public affairs
* 10\+ years relevant experience in MENA public policy and public affairs
* Strong experience (4\+ years) on MENA tech policy, ideally working on platform regulations


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Working experience in Dubai or Riyadh
* Previous experience working with the Government or regulators or other Public institutions is a plus
* Full Arabic and English proficiency necessary


 If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.
   

  

 "Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4\+ days per week.
   

  

 At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.
   

  

 Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long\-term success!

 Senior role within the Real Estate Finance team with the purpose of originating and executing Real Estate Finance transactions for CIB clients of the Bank and to support the real estate transactions of wider REF team globally.  Work closely with all departments of the Bank to ensure deal opportunities are activated and communication is harmonised.
 



  





**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:** 




 The role encompasses, enhancing the bank's capabilities in the real estate finance covering all forms of RE finance structures in addition to identifying opportunities for equity origination and deal placement. This will involve:
 


* Meeting clients/sponsors.
* Originating, structuring and executing new deals along with the coverage \& credit team.
* Thoroughly review the existing CRE loan book and identify opportunities to secure existing loans business through a combination of refinance and restructuring.
* Build a platform for growth to support new business initiatives across the FAB footprint.
* Working with other market leaders on transactions and further enhancing FAB’s international profile.
* Taking the lead in pricing discussions with clients.
* Working on internal reporting, MIS requirements and support the Head of REF in strategic initiatives.

* Contribute to the preparation of the sub\-departmental budget and monitor the section’s cost ratio and make the Head of Real Estate Finance aware of performance gaps with suggestions to rectify and improve performance.

**Policies, Systems, Processes, \& Procedures:** 



* Implement departmental policies, systems, and procedure so that all relevant procedural/ legislative requirements are fulfilled while delivering a quality and cost\-effective service.



  





**MIS and Reports:** 




 Supervise and provide inputs in the preparation of timely and accurate sub\-departmental statements and reports (esp. the Underwriting \& Sales Report) to meet FAB’s and departmental requirements, policies, and standards.
 



  





**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE:** 




**Knowledge \& Experience:** 



* Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business or a related discipline.
* 10\+ years of experience in managing and facilitating real estate loans business in a banking environment.
* In\-depth knowledge of the Real Estate sector, and FAB’s products and business strategies.
* Deep understanding and working knowledge of international real estate debt markets and syndicated loan \& debt capital market.



**Skills:** 



* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to understand financing structures based on the current \& expected market conditions.
* Ability to multi\-task with strong credit, structuring and LMA documentation, expertise required.
* Strong negotiating skills and ability to exercise good judgment which balances needs of client, investors and FAB.
* Solid understanding of accounting and financial statements.
* Ability to work under pressure and adjust quickly to changing priorities.
* Ability to build and develop strategic relationships.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 Join the Global Corporate Bank at J.P. Morgan, where we manage relationships with large and mid\-cap corporations, financial institutions, and public sector organizations globally.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a Vice President in our Global Corporate Banking team, you will play a pivotal role in expanding our business in Nigeria and West Africa – with a strategic focus on both regionally headquartered corporate clients and financial institutions as well as West African subsidiaries of multinational corporations. Based in Lagos, you will be part of the Sub\-Saharan Africa (SSA) team and collaborate with global and regional coverage partners, including investment banking, product specialists, and headquarter relationship teams to deliver a comprehensive suite of corporate banking products and services.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Accountable for business development and client relationship management for a portfolio of both Nigerian and West African headquartered corporate clients, and subsidiaries of multinational corporations.
* Collaborate and partner with global, regional and cross\-functional teams – investment banking coverage, product (Payment, FX, Trade) partners, and HQ relationship bankers, and risk partners to originate new opportunities, develop client relationships, address client needs and maintain ongoing client satisfaction.
* Ability to contextualise local risks and opportunities in the market to offshore client coverage, risk and product partners.
* Conduct sales activities including strategy development, direct client calling, presentations etc.
* Serve as the first line of defence and promote an effective control environment by adhering to risk/control expectations, procedures, and processes (including Compliance, AML, KYC).
* Manage resources effectively, monitor expenses, and continually seek ways to increase efficiency and improve profitability.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Proven corporate banking experience in Nigeria/West Africa, with a track record of developing client relationships and winning new business.
* Experience in managing complex, multi\-product and multi\-country client relationships at a regional level.
* In\-depth knowledge of corporate banking and investment banking products, including bank loans, bonds, rates, FX, derivatives, structured products, payments/treasury services and trade finance.
* Expertise in risk management and experience in originating credit, and/or debt capital markets transactions.
* Strong commercial judgment, influencing skills and ability to manage cross\-cultural environments and inter\-department collaboration.
* Strong partnership, planning and organizational skills.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Industry and market knowledge.
* Creative, innovative team player and leader with strong quantitative, analytical and attention to detail skills.
* High productivity and ability to manage deliverables and a busy day\-to\-day schedule.
* Ability and willingness to travel regularly domestically and internationally.
* Fluency in English is essential, fluency in French is highly beneficial
* Recognised academic qualification of a minimum Bachelor level/equivalent


**Optional Additional Information**
* This role may require travel and flexibility in working hours to accommodate international engagements.


**ABOUT US**
 J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first\-class business in a first\-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do.  J.P. Morgan's Commercial \& Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. The Commercial \& Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

**About us**




  





 Join the UAE’s largest bank and one of the world’s largest and safest financial institutions. Be ready to make your mark a top company, in an exciting \& dynamic industry.

 To grow and manage large account portfolios and sensitive client relationships for assigned portfolio in the corporate banking segment; improve service quality levels and supervise the team’s day\-to\-day activities and client interactions to ensure that the team's objectives are constantly met and its revenue targets achieved, while maintaining client satisfaction and portfolio credit quality.

**Client and Market Analysis** 




  





 • Conduct financial analysis on clients and their respective geographies/ industries/ markets to identify potential opportunities and risks.
 



 Business Origination
 



 • Originate new business opportunities with target clients across banking products and in line with relevant policies.
 



 • Obtain support from relevant stakeholders and governance forums to close deals (e.g., credit, products, GT).
 



 • Develop Term Sheet, Information Memorandum, Mandate letter etc.

 • Expand Products Penetration Through Sector\-Focused Solutions

 • Maintain the credit quality of the client's relationships within the Portfolio to an acceptable level set by the
 



 • Bank's management.
 



 • Pitch, review, negotiate and conclude deals.
 



 • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers in other banks to originate business.
 



 • Up to date with the latest market, competitors, regulatory and industry and amend accordingly the account plans as when applicable.
 



 • Ability to handle sophisticated transactions and engage assigned team members.
 



 • Recommend policy amendments as when required to match with the latest business trends.
 



  





**Client Relationship Management** 




  





 • To achieve assigned financial and non\-financial objectives by meeting all borrowing \& non borrowing needs of customers with target segments (E.g., borrowers, transactors, depositors).
 



 • Prepare and Maintain Account Plans for all clients with support from relevant partners (e.g., products, international banking, Employee banking, Asset Management, etc.).
 



 • Support on the conduct of annual/periodic credit facility reviews in the existing portfolio in a timely manner and support on the recommendation of appropriate credit facilities in line with the banks credit. policy to maximize earnings while containing risks to an acceptable level and identifying candidates for downgrades/ upgrades.
 



 • Develop, Implement and maintain complete control aspects i.e., documentation, periodical client visits / call reports, stock inspections and formal credit checks / informal market feedback to monitor the assigned portfolio effectively.
 



 • Organize client meetings with relevant partners/ seniority to deepen FAB relationship within the portfolio.
 



 • Identify \& develop cross selling opportunities and increase cross\-sell ratio and returns with clients.
 



 • Support client on their day\-to\-day banking requirements with support from the team (as applicable).
 



 • Ensure customer satisfaction remains high and meets the targeted NPS score.
 



 • Keep abreast of market trends and manage a disciplined marketing process by identifying steps/strategies necessary to effectively initiate relationships with prospects.
 



 • Onboard new clients as and when required.
 



  





**Collaboration** 




  





 • Align with Corporate team as well as other partners to identify and convert opportunities.
 



 • Collaborate with other business divisions to drive cross\-BU collaboration. Develop proposition strategy, competition analysis, focused group approach, service delivery model, customer experience, internal \& external campaigns and alignment with other Products \& proposition including Risk policies, Payment \& Cash management, Trade products, collaboration with Retail banking including Private Banking, etc.
 



 • Align with International banking to support client in FAB network locations.
 



 • Support Unit/Divisional/Bank\-wide initiatives (as required or assigned).
 



  





**Operational** 




  





 • Follow all relevant policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.
 



 • Conduct periodic reviews of risks (credit, operational, compliance etc.) within the portfolio on a regular basis.
 



 • Drive day\-to\-day administrative and transactional activities for the team such as client calls, documentation follow up, pipeline updates, and any other activities in the unit/team to ensure continuity of work and delivery of effective/high quality output.
 



 • Ensure that internal processes for existing portfolio/ NTBs are in\-line with the Bank's policies \& procedures.
 



 • Manage and follow up on KYC and compliance requirements to ensure consistency with the Bank's KYC and AML policies and regulatory requirements.
 



 • Ensure all credit reviews are submitted on time and agreed conditions are met.
 



 • Ensure all clients' files \[documents] are maintained.
 



 • Maintain a satisfactory audit on the portfolio.
 



 • Adhere to process KPl's and, ORM, BCP \& Internal Audit requirements.
 



 • Prepare timely and accurate statements and reports to meet the unit's requirements, policies, and standards.
 



  





**Leadership** 




  





 • Act as Role Model for the entire Corporate Banking group and team
 



 • Lead, Mentor, Motivate, Develop and Coach team members to ensure career growth and short \& long term successors
 



 • Establish high\-performance culture and ensure high engagement levels.
 



 • Encourage ownership through rightful assignments to team members.
 



 • Achieve individual and team's financial performance targets.
 



 • Learning \& Development Attend appropriate on and off\-the\-job training programs and ensure development and skill upgradation of team members.
 



 • Involvement in team members new hirings.
 



  





**Qualifications**




  





**Minimum Qualification** 




  





 • Bachelor’s degree in finance or related discipline.
 



 • Master’s degree in business administration is preferred.
 



  





**Minimum Experience** 




 12\+ years of experience in Banking with at least 8\+ years in senior role of team management.
 



  





**Knowledge, Skills, and Attributes:** 




  





 • Deep Knowledge of Wholesale Banking or investment banking.
 



 • Understanding of FAB's product offering and business strategy.
 



 • Ability to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders to drive business.
 



 • Strong relationship management skills both internally and externally.
 



 • Sound communication skills (written and verbal).
 



 • Ability to analyse and research information.
 



 • Deep Financial and credit analysis ability with an aptitude to identify opportunities and close business deals.
 



 • Data analysis and financial modelling skills.
 



 • Ability to work under pressure and adjust quickly to changing priorities.
 



 • Proficient in MS Office (excel, word and Power\-point).

data.jd_text:
Dubai serves as a strategic hub for Eaton’s Middle East operations, bringing together commercial, engineering, manufacturing, and support teams within a globally connected business environment. Building on more than 40 years in the region, Eaton recently announced the development of a new sustainable campus in Dubai, reinforcing our long‑term investment in growth, collaboration, and capability building.
   

  

 Eaton's Global Data Center Segment is focused on helping data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future. With the rise of big data, edge computing and the cloud, data centers are under pressure to be more high\-performing, sustainable and cost\-effective than ever, without compromising resilience or security. At the same time, new opportunities and revenue streams require faster speed\-to\-market. With our digital intelligence, world\-class cyber\-secure products and services, reliable, compatible solutions and engineering expertise, we help data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future.
   

  

 Within this segment, Eaton has an opening for a
 **Technical Program Manager/Scrum Master – Global Data Center Segment.** 
 The primary function of this role is to act as an experienced servant leader and Agile coach for cross functional Datacenter teams within Eaton’s Global Data Center Segment team that is based in UAE. This role enables teams delivering Data Center solutions to operate effectively using Scrum, accelerating value delivery while maintaining Eaton’s high standards for safety, quality, compliance, and reliability. Operating in a global, matrixed environment, the Scrum Master partners closely with Research and Development, Product Owners, engineering, compliance, and business stakeholders to remove impediments, reinforce Agile discipline, and support Eaton’s broader Data Center growth strategy.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Scrum \& Agile Facilitation
   

  

* Serve as Scrum Master for one or more Data Center Teams, or solution teams, ensuring consistent application of Scrum events, roles, and artifacts in alignment with Eaton’s Scrum framework.
* Facilitate Sprint Planning, Daily Scrums, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives, fostering transparency, focus, and continuous improvement.
* Coach teams on Agile principles, self management, and cross functional collaboration.


 Impediment Removal \& Flow Optimization
   

  

* Proactively identify and remove delivery impediments, including dependencies across engineering, testing, UL compliance, manufacturing, and supply chain partners.
* Partner with leaders and stakeholders to escalate and resolve systemic issues impacting team flow and predictability.


 Product \& Stakeholder Partnership
   

  

* Support Product Owners in backlog refinement, prioritization, and alignment to Global Data Center Segment objectives, including safety, scalability, and reliability expectations.
* Act as a bridge between technical teams and global stakeholders, enabling clear communication and shared understanding of delivery commitments.


 Metrics \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Promote the use of Agile metrics (e.g., throughput, predictability, sprint goals) to enable data driven improvement without fostering a command and control culture.
* Reinforce Kaizen and continuous improvement practices aligned with Eaton’s Continuous Improvement System.


 Scaling \& Enterprise Agility
   

  

* Support coordination across multiple teams or workstreams contributing to Gray Space UL deliverables.
* Contribute to broader Agile maturity and ways of working improvements across the Global Data Center organization, consistent with Eaton’s global operating model


**Qualifications**
* Strong working knowledge of Scrum and Agile principles, with demonstrated ability to apply them pragmatically in enterprise settings.
* Experience working with the data center or IT industry at senior levels.
* Experience working with cross functional global teams, including engineering, compliance, and operations.
* Proven ability to influence without authority in a matrixed organization.
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from an accredited institution.


**Skills**
* Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe SM, or equivalent) preferred.
* Experience supporting data centers, power systems, electrical infrastructure, or regulated product development preferred.
* Familiarity with UL certification processes or safety‑critical product development.
* Experience operating within large, global enterprises.


**What We Offer You**
* Being part of a company that has been in business for more than 100 years, is well known in the industry, and has a major impact on the energy industry
* Annual mentoring program, Eaton University, a reward, and recognition system
* Ongoing Learning and Career Development Opportunities in a global company. Build your career and apply internally for our open positions worldwide
* Strong, agile and diverse team locally and globally
* Strong processes and state\-of\-the\-art systems and tools
* Detailed induction support and well\-structured onboarding
* Balance your work and life with a hybrid worktime model


 Dubai is an internationally connected city that offers strong professional opportunities within a truly global environment. Living and working in Dubai means being part of a diverse, forward‑looking business community, supported by modern infrastructure, excellent connectivity, and a well‑established expatriate ecosystem.
   

  

 At Eaton, employees based in Dubai are part of a stable, well‑governed organization that brings together global teams, clear ways of working, and the flexibility needed to support both performance and long‑term career development.

data.jd_text:
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Directs, coaches, supports, supervises, and evaluates (with the Sous Chef) all direct reports.
* Must have excellent food knowledge and a full understanding of culinary terms.
* Must be able to read, understand, follow, and prepare company recipes by maintaining the quality and consistency in taste according to the instructions provided by the corporate office.
* Must be proficient in completing tasks, work efficiently and productively.
* Must be able to work in any section of a kitchen.
* Coordinate and supervise all team members assigned to their section, assign and delegate tasks accordingly.
* Undertake recipe reviews daily. Maintain recipe folders in immaculate condition.
* Responsible for follow\-through on any request within the area of responsibility received from the direct supervisor or manager on duty; this may include show plates, food samples and random food tastings.
* Control production levels and recommend ideas for improvements and better cost controlling.
* Prepare daily electronic food requisitions needed for his section production and countercheck deliveries for its accuracy; Report any discrepancies to his immediate supervisor.
* Must be able to oversee any main section (Sauce, Entremetier, Fish, Roast, Outlet CDP, Tournant and Cold Kitchen) and its entire food production.
* Maintain and ensure that Public Health are followed according to company standards and expectation (referring to US, Anvisa, Shipsan, Canadian, Australian etc.) and always followed within his section.
* Ensures that the HACCP program is carried out correctly.
* Maintains their assigned area in preparation for announced or unannounced United States Public Health type inspection either done by the Food \& Beverage Director or the actual inspectors.
* Reports for duty at assigned times, follows their supervisor’s instructions, and ensures that personal appearance, uniform, and personal hygiene are in accordance with the company’s rules and regulations.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION** 



* A minimum of 5 years in an upscale hotel, resort, cruise ship or convention banqueting service and at least 2 years as Chef Tournant (shipboard experience preferred).
* A culinary school degree is required.
* Very strong management skills in a multicultural and dynamic environment.
* Very strong communication, problem solving, decision making, and interpersonal skills.
* Superior customer service, teambuilding, and conflict resolution skills.
* Knowledge of the principles and processes for providing personalized services including needs assessment techniques, quality service standards, alternative delivery systems, and guest satisfaction evaluation techniques.
* Strong planning, coaching, organizing, staffing, controlling, and evaluating skills.
* Intermediate computer software skills required.
* Possess a good understanding of basic accounting principles such as numbering flow, “Debits/Credits”, adjusting entries and corrections.
* Ability to write reports and business correspondence and to establish a good rapport with the ship’s Senior Officers and the corporate office.

**Overview**
 Manager – Planning \& Business Solutions for Energy \& Projects vertical supports the execution and delivery of AIT’s Energy \& Projects (E\&P) solutions strategy within the IMEA region. The role focuses on commercial execution, customer support, operational coordination, and product deployment, contributing to sustainable and profitable growth in line with regional and corporate objectives.
   

  

 The Manager partners closely with the Director – Energy \& Projects, regional leadership, and cross‑functional teams to support business development initiatives, ensure operational excellence, and maintain strong relationships with customers and service providers involved in complex Energy and Project logistics solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and coordinate end‑to‑end execution of Energy, Oil \& Gas, and Project Cargo movements across India \& Middle East region, ensuring safety, regulatory compliance, and on‑time delivery.
* Serve as the operational and technical subject‑matter expert for Energy \& Project cargo, including OOG, breakbulk, modules, skids, and engineered movements supporting upstream, midstream, and downstream projects.
* Manage routing, carrier selection, vessel planning, equipment configuration, permits, surveys, and method‑of‑transport execution in alignment with approved SOPs, HSE plans, and EPC requirements.
* Coordinate carriers, heavy‑haul and SPMT providers, ports, terminals, yards, and third‑party service providers to ensure capacity availability, service continuity, and effective risk mitigation in Oil \& Gas environments.
* Monitor shipment‑ and project‑level cost performance, supporting margin integrity and compliance with approved commercial frameworks and customer contractual requirements.
* Support tender execution for Energy \& Oil \& Gas projects through operational feasibility assessments, execution methodology reviews, and pricing inputs within defined authority limits.
* Collaborate with regional pricing and procurement teams to validate rates, equipment availability, and market conditions, sharing intelligence on carrier capacity and cost drivers within the Energy sector.
* Track operational KPIs related to safety, schedule adherence, cost control, and execution quality, implementing corrective actions for deviations.
* Act as a first‑level operational escalation point for complex, high‑risk, or cross‑border Energy \& Project shipments, including shutdowns, critical\-path cargo, and remote site deliveries.
* Ensure full compliance with HSE, DG, project QA/QC standards, and customer‑specific Oil \& Gas and Energy project requirements.
* Collaborate with regional leadership, sales, engineering, and operations teams to improve execution capability, standardization, and delivery performance across Energy \& Projects programs.


**Qualifications**
* A team player who works well with others – being respectful to our teammates is a Core Value!

* Growth mindset – being passionate about your craft, always looking for ways to improve yourself and the company, being open to change and doing things differently.
* Customer service focus – we serve a wide variety of customers, both internal and external, and building relationships is a part of our culture!


**Other Skills We Hope To See**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
* 8–12 years of experience in logistics, freight forwarding, or project cargo, within Energy or Industrial Projects.
* Experience supporting P\&L performance, pricing, or commercial activities.
* Exposure to Air, Ocean, and Project logistics operations.
* Experience working across multiple stakeholders and geographies preferred.
* Strong coordination, communication, and problem‑solving skills.
* Process‑oriented with attention to detail and compliance requirements.
* Demonstrate a great deal of initiative and a strong hands\-on mentality
* High customer and service orientation
* High ability to work under pressure in a matrix environment and willingness to travel
* Demonstrates sound judgment and the ability to operate effectively in complex, high‑risk environments.


**About AIT Worldwide**
 AIT Worldwide Logistics is a global freight forwarder that helps its customers grow by expanding access to markets all over the world where they can sell and/or procure raw materials, components, and finished goods. For more than 40 years, the America’s\-based supply chain solutions leader has relied on a consultative approach to build a global network and trusted partnerships in nearly every industry, including aerospace, automotive, consumer retail, food, government, healthcare, high\-tech, industrial and life sciences. Backed by scalable, user\-friendly technology, AIT’s flexible business model customizes door\-to\-door deliveries via sea, air, ground, and rail—on time and on budget. With expert teammates staffing more than 100 worldwide locations in Asia, Europe, India, and North America, AIT’s full\-service options also include customs clearance, warehouse management and white glove services. Learn more about AIT Worldwide Logistics, our culture and core values in action here .

**Job Purpose**
* The Plant Director is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership for the manufacturing facility, ensuring safe, efficient, and profitable operations. The role delivers manufacturing excellence aligned with business strategy, approved budgets, and customer requirements, while ensuring compliance with UAE regulatory authorities and international standards.
* The position drives performance across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and sustainability, champions continuous improvement and advanced manufacturing practices, and builds a high performing, future ready leadership team
* The Plant Director actively champions the adoption of modern manufacturing technologies, operational best practices, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, reliability, and competitiveness.
* The role works closely with cross‑ functional teams to ensure seamless execution, transparent communication, and sustained long‑ term value creation for the business.


**Job Dimensions**
* Number of Staff Supervised: Direct Reports: 8, Total: 340
* Reports to: Manufacturing Operations Director
* Direct Reports: Business Unit Managers, Maintenance Manager, Supply Chain Manager, Purchase Manager, Production Engineering Manager, Contracts Manager and Finance Manager
* Functional reports: IT Lead, Regional HR Manager, HSE Manager, Quality Manager


**Key Accountabilities**
 Strategy \& Operations
   

  

* Develop and execute the manufacturing and operations strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Deliver production targets with consistent On Time In Full (OTIF) performance and right first time quality.
* Set and deliver aggressive yet achievable facility goals aligned to long term company strategy.
* Ensure effective performance management and accountability across the Operations leadership team.
* Act as the primary interface with local regulatory authorities (e.g. JAFZA, DCD, Trakhees/EHS).


 Operational Excellence \& Efficiency
   

  

* Drive continuous improvement, lean manufacturing, and productivity enhancement initiatives.
* Optimise manufacturing processes, capacity, and asset utilisation in line with the Medium Term Plan.
* Implement flexible workforce models aligned with SOPs and demand variation.


 Quality \& HSE
   

  

* Ensure all products meet or exceed defined quality, customer, and regulatory requirements.
* Embed a strong quality culture and operational discipline across the plant.
* Ensure full compliance with Environmental, Health \& Safety standards


 Financial Performance
   

  

* Manage site profitability, cost control, and budget adherence.
* Lead S\&OP execution to balance demand, capacity, revenue, and customer commitments.
* Optimise inventory levels and drive inventory reduction initiatives.
* Drive material and conversion cost reductions in collaboration with Procurement and Supply Chain


 People \& Leadership
   

  

* Build, develop, and lead a high performing management team.
* Drive talent development, succession planning, and capability building across functions.
* Foster a collaborative, performance driven, and values based culture.


 Customer Focus \& Business Excellence
   

  

* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction through delivery, quality, and responsiveness.
* Promote cross functional collaboration across Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Projects, and Sales.
* Champion new technologies, digitalisation, and best in class manufacturing practices.


 New Product Introduction

 KPIs
   

  

* Safety performance and regulatory compliance
* OTIF delivery
* Budget vs. Actual
* Profitability and MPV
* Scrap, rework, and customer complaints
* Inventory turns and cost recovery
* Leadership capability and succession readiness

The position interfaces regularly with local regulatory and governing bodies in Dubai to ensure compliance, certification, and operational continuity, while balancing operational excellence, people development, and long term business sustainability

Partnering with clients in both public and private sectors, the company is known for its expertise in design\-build, peer review, and third\-party consultancy projects. GS is proud to have contributed to numerous landmark projects, maintaining a strong focus on quality, timely delivery, and fostering trusted relationships with international partners.
 



  





**Technical Director – Architectural \& Engineering Consultancy** 




**Location:** 
 Dubai, United Arab Emirates
 



**Reporting to:** 
 Managing Director / Executive Director
 



**Role Overview** 




 The Technical Director is the highest technical authority within the organization, responsible for leading multidisciplinary design and construction supervision functions across a diverse portfolio of projects. This role ensures technical excellence, regulatory compliance, and alignment between design intent and project execution throughout the full project lifecycle.
 



 Combining strategic leadership, client engagement, and financial oversight, the Technical Director drives performance, innovation, and quality across architectural and engineering teams while supporting business growth and operational efficiency.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Technical Leadership** 




 Act as the organization’s principal technical authority across all disciplines (architecture, structural, MEP, quantity survey).

 Provide expert technical input during concept, schematic, detailed design, tender and construction stages.
 



 Review and approve major technical deliverables and engineering solutions.
 



**Project Oversight \& Delivery** 




 Oversee the full project lifecycle from concept design through construction supervision and handover.
 



 Ensure alignment between design intent and on\-site execution.
 



 Lead multidisciplinary coordination to deliver integrated, efficient, and buildable solutions.
 



 Monitor project performance related to quality, timelines, and budgets.
 



 Identify and mitigate technical risks and implement corrective actions.
 



**Client \& Stakeholder Management** 




 Act as a senior technical advisor and key point of contact for clients.
 



 Support business development through technical input in proposals and presentations.
 



 Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, authorities, and stakeholders.
 



 Lead technical negotiations and resolve complex project issues.

 Lead, mentor, and develop multidisciplinary technical teams.
 



 Oversee recruitment, performance management, and succession planning.
 



 Promote knowledge sharing and technical excellence across departments.
 



**Financial \& Operational Oversight** 




 Contribute to business strategy and operational planning.
 



 Oversee project profitability, resource allocation, and cost control.

 Ensure efficient utilization of technical resources across projects.
 



**Compliance and Quality** 




 Ensure adherence to UAE regulations, authority requirements, and international standards.

 Drive innovation through adoption of new technologies, digital tools, and sustainable design practices.
 



 Stay updated on industry trends, codes, and emerging technologies.
 



  





  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture.
 



 Minimum 18–20 years of experience in architectural/engineering consultancy (pre and post tender stages).
 



 Proven experience in leading multidisciplinary teams.
 



 Strong knowledge of UAE codes, standards, and authority requirements (e.g., Dubai Municipality, DDA, etc.).
 



 Demonstrated experience in design management and construction supervision.

data.jd_text:
We are partnering with a leading international consumer organisation undergoing a significant phase of operational evolution and regional transformation across Europe, Middle East, Africa, and Asia.
 



  





 This appointment represents a strategically critical leadership hire, responsible for shaping and embedding a future\-ready operational model capable of supporting long\-term regional growth, scalability, efficiency, and commercial agility across diverse and evolving markets.
 



  





 Operating at Executive Committee level, the role will lead the transition and centralisation of key operational capabilities into Dubai, redefining how the organisation structures, governs, and executes operations across the region.
 



  





 This is not a traditional supply chain leadership position. It is a broad operational transformation mandate focused on organisational design, operating model evolution, infrastructure optimisation, and cross\-functional integration across complex international markets.
 



  





 The Opportunity
 



  





 The Director of Operational Transformation will be responsible for architecting and executing a large\-scale operational transformation agenda across MEA \& Asia.
 



 The successful individual will act as a strategic partner to regional and global leadership, driving the redesign of operational frameworks, improving organisational capability, enhancing supply network effectiveness, and establishing scalable infrastructure aligned with the organisation’s long\-term ambitions.
 



 The role requires a leader capable of balancing strategic vision with operational execution, while operating effectively across both mature and emerging markets.
 



 This individual will play a central role in influencing how the organisation evolves operationally over the coming years.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Strategic Operational Transformation
 


* Define and execute a regional operational transformation roadmap aligned with business growth objectives and long\-term organisational priorities
* Lead the redesign and optimisation of the regional operating model across operational functions
* Drive the transition and centralisation of operational capabilities into Dubai, ensuring effective governance, scalability, and regional alignment
* Partner closely with Executive Committee stakeholders to shape strategic operational priorities and long\-term capability development
* Evaluate current operational structures, identify inefficiencies, and implement future\-focused solutions to enhance agility and performance



 Operating Model \& Infrastructure Development
 


* Design scalable operational frameworks capable of supporting multi\-market growth across MEA \& Asia
* Establish governance structures, decision\-making frameworks, and operational standards across regional markets
* Develop integrated operational ecosystems connecting planning, logistics, procurement, distribution, customer operations, and commercial functions
* Support the evolution of regional hub structures, shared service capabilities, and centralised operational functions
* Lead organisational alignment initiatives to ensure operational structures support both regional and local market needs



 Supply Chain, Logistics \& Distribution Transformation
 


* Oversee the transformation and optimisation of regional supply chain and distribution networks
* Drive operational excellence initiatives across warehousing, transportation, inventory management, and fulfilment operations
* Evaluate and redesign logistics infrastructure and 3PL operating models to improve service levels, responsiveness, and cost efficiency
* Establish operational KPI frameworks to monitor service performance, operational efficiency, and network effectiveness
* Drive automation and digital enablement initiatives to improve operational visibility, planning capability, and execution consistency



 Procurement, Partnerships \& External Ecosystems
 


* Lead the development of strategic operational partnerships across logistics, distribution, manufacturing, and external service providers
* Oversee supplier and partner governance frameworks to ensure accountability, scalability, and performance delivery
* Support procurement transformation initiatives focused on cost optimisation, operational resilience, and strategic sourcing capability
* Negotiate and manage complex operational and commercial agreements with regional and global partners



 Transformation Delivery \& Change Leadership
 


* Lead complex, cross\-functional transformation programmes across multiple geographies and stakeholder groups
* Drive adoption of new operational processes, technologies, governance models, and organisational structures
* Foster a culture of operational excellence, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement
* Coach and develop regional operational leadership teams to strengthen organisational capability and succession planning
* Act as a visible transformation leader capable of influencing senior stakeholders across regional and global functions



  





 Candidate Profile
 



 The successful candidate will bring significant experience leading operational transformation, operating model redesign, and regional operational leadership within complex multinational environments.
 



 Candidates will typically come from leading FMCG, consumer goods, beauty, retail, or similarly sophisticated international organisations.
 



 Experience \& Background
 


* Proven experience leading large\-scale operational transformation initiatives across international markets
* Strong operational leadership background spanning supply chain, logistics, procurement, planning, distribution, and operational governance
* Demonstrated experience designing or evolving regional operating models and organisational structures
* Experience leading regional hub centralisation, shared services transformation, or cross\-border operational migration projects
* Strong understanding of operational infrastructure, supply network optimisation, and multi\-market operational complexity
* Experience operating within matrix organisations and engaging with Executive Committee or Board\-level stakeholders
* Strong commercial understanding with the ability to align operational strategy to broader business objectives



 Leadership Capabilities
 


* Strategic thinker with the ability to translate vision into executable operational frameworks
* Highly credible stakeholder manager with strong influencing and communication capabilities
* Commercially astute with a balanced understanding of growth, efficiency, and operational sustainability
* Comfortable operating in complex, evolving, and high\-growth environments
* Strong organisational leadership capability with experience developing high\-performing regional teams
* Resilient, adaptable, and capable of leading transformation through ambiguity and organisational change

**About the Role** 




 We are building trust infrastructure for device financing in emerging markets — where millions of customers finance smartphones but do not trust banks, services, or promises.
 



 Care\+ is not a warranty department.
 



  





 It is an ecosystem of trust around the device: replacement, refurbishment, anti\-fraud, service operations, and lifecycle management.
 



  





 We are looking for a Head of Care\+ Ecosystem — a founding\-level operational leader who will build and scale the entire after\-sales infrastructure across multiple countries.
 



  





 This role builds the department almost from zero — from 2 people to 8\+ senior team members during the first 18 months.
 



  





**What is Critically Important (must\-have experience)** 




 🔧
 **Device Certification** 




 — Practical experience in smartphone/consumer electronics certification in China
 



 — Real experience working with factories, certification labs, ODMs, and engineering teams
 



 — Understanding of factory documentation flow, typical bottlenecks, and “where things actually break.”
 



 — Experience with local device certification in Africa / SEA / LATAM countries
 



 — Understanding of local regulatory reality and launching devices in emerging markets
 



  





 📦
 **Spare Parts and Service Infrastructure** 




 — Deep understanding of spare parts movement and after\-sales logistics
 



 — Understanding of how spare parts actually move: factory → distributor → ASC → customer
 



 — Experience working with authorized service centers (ASC)
 



 — Understanding of SLA, replacement economics, refurbishment, and warranty operations
 



 — Understanding of local logistics reality in emerging markets, not only processes “on paper”
 



  





 🌍
 **Remote Management and Operational Audit** 




 — Proven experience in remote management of multi\-country service operations
 



 — Regular audits, inspections, and on\-site service center checks
 



 — Experience investigating:
 


* inventory leakage
* fake warranty claims
* fake parts
* grey market devices
* device swapping
* fake repairs



 — Ability to see the difference between reports and field reality
 



  





 👥
 **Hiring and Managing Local Managers** 




 — Experience hiring first\-level local Service / After\-Sales Managers
 



 — Ability to identify strong local operators “on the ground.”
 



 — Experience managing managers who work locally in\-country but functionally report to HQ
 



 — Experience building a controllable regional structure
 



 — Own network of service / after\-sales contacts in Africa or SEA is a major advantage
 



  





 📋
 **Standardization and Operational Discipline** 




 — Experience building standardized operational frameworks for multi\-country operations
 



 — Creation of SOPs, audit standards, escalation flows, and service protocols
 



 — Ability to establish consistent service quality across countries with different levels of market maturity
 



 — Ability to transform “manual management” into scalable operational infrastructure
 



 — Process discipline and reporting culture are non\-negotiable
 



  





**Strong Advantage** 




 — Experience working in the Dubai HQ of international companies
 



 — Experience working in: Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, Ghana, Uganda, Côte d’Ivoire, and other African countries
 



 — Experience in organizations such as Samsung, Transsion, Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo, realme, Huawei, HMD/Nokia
 



 — Understanding of how emerging markets operations really work outside corporate presentations
 



 — Experience in device financing / BNPL / smartphone financing ecosystems is a major advantage
 



  





**Basic Requirements** 




 — 8\+ years of experience in service / after\-sales / operations management
 



 — Multi\-country operations experience
 



 — Experience building and scaling teams
 



 — Strong analytical and operational mindset
 



 — English fluent (mandatory)
 



 — Willingness to travel: approximately 6–10 days/month during launch phase, with gradual reduction of travel load as operations scale

 — Building and managing the Care\+ ecosystem
 



 — Device certification in new markets
 



 — Development of service center network

 — Hiring, training, and functional management of local Service Managers
 



 — Anti\-fraud strategy and operational audit
 



 — Distributor and ASC relationship management
 



 — Building scalable operational infrastructure across multiple countries
 



  





**Compensation \& Growth** 




 — Senior\-level compensation structure discussed individually based on interview results
 



 — Includes fixed base, transparent KPI bonus structure, and long\-term participation opportunity
 



 — Transparent KPI mechanism
 



 — Grace period during the first 2 months
 



 — Dubai HQ leadership role
 



 — International multi\-country scope
 



 — Long\-term leadership growth opportunity within the ecosystem
 



  





**Career Path** 




 Year 1–2: Head of Care\+ Ecosystem
 



 Year 2–3: VP Care\+ Operations
 



 Year 3\+: COO\-track / senior ecosystem leadership

 We are looking for someone who:
 



 — understands the difference between reports and reality

Who We Are
   

  

 Fueled by passion, KAYALI was founded in 2018 by beauty mogul and fragrance fanatic, Mona Kattan. Translating to ‘my imagination' in Arabic, KAYALI provides a modern fragrance experience inspired by Mona's rich Middle Eastern heritage and the art of layering scents to help you create your mood; where sharing scents is a ritual and smelling good is both an act of goodwill and self\-love. Mona collaborates with some of the world's most renowned perfumers and sources the finest ingredients to create unique juices that are infinitely memorable, long\-lasting, and cruelty\-free. Each luxurious fragrance is an ode to true craftsmanship and tells a special story, from the addictive notes to the multi\-faceted jeweled bottles.
   

  

 Our Mission
   

  

 To make everyone feel like the diamond they are! To build a global community of fragrance lovers through the power of scent and by providing them with the most innovative \& luxurious fragrances, education and sharing our Middle Eastern fragrance rituals with the world.
   

  

**Summary**
 The Director of NPD \& Projects will own and lead the global product development project management function, ensuring seamless execution across all stages of the product development lifecycle, spanning concept creation, feasibility assessment, development, launch readiness, and post\-launch optimization. This leadership role will drive adoption of a standardized Stage\-Gate model across all innovation projects, driving speed\-to\-market, cross\-functional alignment, and operational excellence at scale.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
**Strategic Leadership \& NPD Excellence**
* Own and evolve KAYALI's Stage\-Gate product development framework, ensuring clear governance, decision\-making, and accountability across all phases of the lifecycle
* Define and govern stage gates, including entry/exit criteria, decision checkpoints, and escalation protocols
* Lead the development of the 24\-month global launch roadmap, ensuring alignment with brand, commercial, and supply strategies
* Drive continuous improvement of speed\-to\-market while balancing innovation, risk, and quality
* Act as the central point of accountability for on\-time, in\-full (OTIF) delivery of all launches globally


**Stage 0\-1: Concept \& Feasibility**

* Oversee feasibility assessment across formula, packaging, regulatory, and supply capabilities
* Validate business cases (cost, margin, timelines, scale viability) prior to gate approval
* Align cross\-functional stakeholders on risk, trade\-offs, and go/no\-go decisions early in the process


**Stage 2: Development \& Validation**
* Oversee end\-to\-end development across all projects, ensuring alignment on timelines, KPIs, and quality standards

* Drive disciplined milestone tracking, risk mitigation, and issue escalation across all active projects
* Build and maintain robust project timelines, ensuring proactive tracking, risk management, and milestone adherence

* Drive accountability for OTIF delivery across all launches


**Stage 4: Launch \& Post\-Launch Optimization**

* Champion a mindset of innovation, agility, and continuous improvement
* Drive post\-launch reviews to capture learnings and inform future pipeline decisions
* Identify opportunities for optimization, reformulation, or lifecycle extension
* Embed continuous improvement across tools, processes, and ways of working to elevate efficiency and scalability


**Cross\-Functional Orchestration**
* Act as the central connector across all functions, ensuring alignment, accountability, and transparency across each stage gate \[JD \-Direct...dits).docx \| Word]

* Ensure clear communication of risks, priorities, and decisions to senior leadership

* Integrate suppliers early in feasibility and development phases to de\-risk execution

**Risk Management \& Operational Excellence**
