data.jd_text:
**General Description**
 The position is responsible for supporting Chief Risk Officer / HEAD GRCI for all aspects of the risk delivery. The DGM is also responsible for supporting the CRO/HEAD GRCI in overseeing the daily operations and overall management of the Division. The DGM ensures that GRCI agendas are met efficiently, while maintaining high standards of performance, operational effectiveness and divisional growth in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI. The person will work closely with CRO/HEAD GRCI, implementing Enterprise Risk Management Framework focusing on Tier 1 \& 2 risk reporting i.e. Strategic, Operational, Projects \& Investment Risks. The person shall also assist the CRO / HEAD in other strategic initiatives. The person shall coordinate with other functional areas in the Company to ensure all risks in the Company are identified, measured, mitigated/managed, and monitored/reported. On top of that, the person shall ensure insurance adequacy and address all queries on all lines of insurances promptly.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Collaborate with the CRO/HEAD GRCI, to adapt and implement Group risk policies, frameworks, and operating models tailored to organizational needs.
* Assist the CRO/HEAD GRCI in preparing and managing matters reported to Risk, Sustainability and Governance (RSGC) Committee reporting. Responsibilities include drafting Agenda, tracking and addressing Matters Arising, preparing and reviewing reports such as Risk Management Report, Group Technology Reports, Sustainability Report and Other Agenda Papers (Hospital License, Anti\- Bribery Management System (ABMS), Business Continuity Management (BCM), Report from Medical Advisory Committee (GMACCG), Key Sentinel/Major Incidents quarterly reporting and other papers required by RSGC.
* Identify key risks and their indicators in risk reporting and monitoring, oversee the development and execution of mitigation plans.
* Lead the end to end risk management process for KPJ in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI which includes an analysis of the financial and non\-financial impact when risks occur.
* Lead the end\-to\-end risk management process in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI, including identifying, quantifying, mitigating, and monitoring Tier 1 and Tier 2 risks (strategic, operational, financial, compliance, project and investment risks).
* To partner with the Head of Group Services and Head of Business Units to ensure that all Risks (Tier 1 \& 2\) risks including investment, project risks, top risk and top emerging risks are being considered in their strategic or operational initiatives. This also includes ESG \& ABC risk identification and mitigation, implementation of appropriate risk management systems and loss event database are properly identified, quantified, managed and monitored.
* Partner and collaborate with other Line of Defence including Group Legal \& Advisory Services (GLAS), Group Clinical (GC), Internal Audit Services (IAS), Compliance \& Integrity Unit within GRCI and Group Sustainability Services (GSS) to to drive implementation of integrated risk management framework.
* Key activities include:
* Regularly updating and monitoring high\-risk medical malpractice active cases and sentinel events at hospitals that could result in viral or reputational damage.
* Coordinating with Internal Audit to synchronize audit plans and analyze findings for actionable insights.
* Collaborating with the Compliance and Integrity Unit to identify and address top risks and emerging ABC (Anti\-Bribery and Corruption) risks effectively.
* Ensuring the adoption and integration of appropriate risk management systems and maintaining a comprehensive loss event database for enhanced risk visibility and mitigation.
* To review and provide an independent assessment view on the key risks associated with projects \& investment undertaken with focus on Investment Risks.
* To review and challenge the proposals submitted by Hospitals or Subsidiaries on investment of new towers, renovations, major acquisition of assets and divestments by assessing their assumptions, investment costs, scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis, stress testing to evaluate the project resilience under various market conditions.
* Be the subject matter expert and change agent on ERM.
* Review the key risks associated with proposed major investments and projects (M\&As).
* Perform horizon scanning to identify emerging risks which may impact the organisation arising from changes in the external environment.
* Highlight emerging risks through flash report and emerging risk updates.
* Drive and champion risk initiatives/ innovation within the risk management function by integrating AI, machine learning and advanced analytics.
* leveraging analytics, machine learning and automation.
* Champion innovation within the risk management function by integrating AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics.
* Use advanced analytics and predictive modeling to anticipate risks, especially for high\-impact areas like market changes, operational disruptions, or cybersecurity.
* Create a real\-time, enterprise\-wide dashboard that consolidates all key risk metrics for better oversight and transparency.
* Develop and deliver outreach and engagement activities in support of embedding and strengthening risk management culture and awareness.
* Engage more deeply with middle management and front\-line staff to embed risk awareness and accountability at all levels of the organization.
* Delivering impactful risk management training.
* Recommend professional certifications and ERM training syllabus for skill enhancement among ERM professionals.
* Encourage your team to pursue certifications in advanced risk management, sustainability, or digital tools to improve their skillsets.
* Actively participate in risk forums and discussions with senior management to align risk strategies with business goal.
* Other business units/functions – Execute and deliver initiatives on a regular basis to identify unique/emerging risks and design risk management strategies to address the risks identified.
* Perform adhoc independent risk review and validation for any request on Group’s undertakings.
* Develop ERM risk reporting/dashboard, timely communicate/escalate risk events, issues, and compliance with risk policies and limits to key stakeholders in the Company and in the region; manage the Company’s quarterly risk reporting.
* Regularly review the Risk Management framework and the operating structure for identifying, assessing, managing and monitoring the risks.
* Execute the annual Risk Management processes with key business, stakeholders, update the risk assessment and ensure adequate measures are in place to mitigate the identified risks.
* Monitor the risk appetite, identifying key risk management strategies, assessing and profiling of the key risks affecting the achievement of the business plans at group, business division and at a department level.
* Develop, refine and review the Risk Register and evaluate the relevance of risks identified across business units in the Group.
* Assist Senior Management team in improving risk management / mitigating strategies and techniques, and carrying out follow up action plans and its effectiveness in mitigating / controlling risks.
* Review and evaluate the effectiveness of implementation of action plans for risk management \- provide assurance on whether the risk mitigation process is being driven effectively and efficiently, whilst also continuously monitoring of whether the risk register is being updated appropriately.
* Evaluate and draw attention to possible gaps in the risk register to the Senior Management and Head of Services \- follow\-up on the development of control environment to overcome deficiencies in the risk management / mitigating process.
* Collaborate working with relevant functions (e.g. Risk Management, Internal Audit, Finance and Legal) to build up and/or implement a risk control framework (i.e. compliance self\-assessment) and provide quality and solutions\-focused advice on risk and control issues relevant to the business division for informed decision\-making on compliance and ethics matters.
* Align ERM practices more closely with KPJ’s long\-term strategic objectives, Academic Health System, Center of Excellence, digital transformation and market expansion.
* Review and challenge the Annual Strategic Planning initiatives and monitor the execution of strategies closely.
* Collaborate closely with IT and cybersecurity teams to address the increasing threat of data breaches and cyberattacks.
* Direct engagement and review on insurance related queries on medical malpractise, general, directors \& liabilities and other lines of insurance coverage.
* Assess and review the adequacy of insurance coverage on an annual basis and present to relevant Committees for renewal.
* To systematically strategize to ensure effectiveness in handling incidents, ensuring a proactive and efficient approach to incident resolution at the Hospital and/or HQ to avoid escalation of incident into crisis.
* To continuously conduct coaching/guidance through on the job training and regular one to one session.
* Act as a key support to the CRO/HEAD GRCI in representing the GRCI in board meetings, committees, and industry forums
* Represent the CRO/HEAD in Management meetings, committees, or forums when required.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI to oversee the design and implementation of compliance programs that align with local and international regulations.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI in ensure effective monitoring of compliance risks, including anti\-money laundering (AML), anti\-bribery and corruption (ABC) and data privacy.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI to develop and promote a robust integrity framework, ensuring the organization adheres to ethical standards and best practices.
* In support of CRO/HEAD GRCI to oversee the implementation of whistleblowing mechanisms, ethics training programs, and conflict of interest management processes.
* Monitor and report on the effectiveness of integrity initiatives, ensuring alignment with organizational values in support of CRO/HEAD GRCI.


**Job Requirements**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting/Finance
* Chartered Accountant, Certified Risk Professional, Certified Integrity Officer (CeIO) would be an added advantage
* ▪Minimum 15 years relevant working experience with minimum 5 years at Management Level
* Professional Paper, Career stint in a Big 4 accounting firm, Healthcare industry experience
* Risk Management, Internal Audit, Legal, Compliance, Investment \& Finance

 There are currently 11 scrum teams around the world working on the MyDyson app, each with software engineers specialised in iOS development, Android development or mobile testing/automation, plus a scrum master and product owner. Our teams have the autonomy to manage their own work, each honing their ways of working through regular retrospectives and knowledge sharing. We all share a commitment to creating high\-quality code.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are on the lookout for a Senior Software Engineering Manager (Mobile App), Dubai. As the most senior member of the App team in Dubai, you would provide technical and strategic leadership across the app scrum teams located there. Vendor management, collaboration and a desire to improve are second nature to you. In addition, you value good software engineering and agile practices and have a proven track record in leading multiple agile teams delivering to a variety of stakeholders.
   

  

* Manage the app scrum teams in Dubai and foster a supportive and productive environment that leads to success. Oversee the Build\-Operate\-Transfer (BOT) of key staff within these teams.
* Work with the Software Engineering Managers in each of the App scrum teams to ensure there is consistency in our approach and robust support for all the teams to enable them to deliver the commitments they have made.
* Set a clear vision for the teams and crafting a strategic growth plan for the overall team to ensure comprehensive development and success across the organization.
* Partner your Senior Engineering Manager peers to ensure effective collaboration within the teams and make decisions that prioritize the team's best interests.
* Work with the SVP and Head of App to agree and deliver the broader App objectives and goals across the global app organisation.
* Identifying new technologies, tools and working practices to help continually improve standards. Familiarity with mobile apps of robot vacuum cleaners is a good to have.


**About you**
* Minimally 10 years of experience in Software/App development with 4 years of people management experience.
* Strong mobile engineering background as either an iOS or Android specialist, with the ability to guide and mentor developers across both platforms.
* If iOS‑focused: Deep proficiency in Swift, MVVM, RxSwift, SwiftUI, Combine.
* If Android‑focused: Strong expertise in Kotlin, with hands‑on experience in Volley, RxJava, and Dagger.
* Proven track record leading teams that build and ship large‑scale mobile applications, serving millions of users.
* Demonstrated experience working with Agile methodologies, driving delivery and continuous improvement across multidisciplinary teams.
* Comfortable managing and collaborating with distributed teams across multiple time zones; able to maintain alignment, communication, and delivery quality.
* Strong leadership capabilities, including talent development, technical decision‑making, and ensuring engineering best practices across the mobile domain.


**Benefits**
 Dyson monitors the market to ensure competitive salaries and bonuses. Beyond that, you’ll enjoy a transport allowance and comprehensive medical care and insurance. But financial benefits are just the start of a Dyson career. Professional growth, leadership development and new opportunities abound, driven by regular reviews and dynamic workshops. And with a vibrant culture, the latest devices and a relaxed dress code reflecting our engineering spirit, it’s an exciting team environment geared to fuelling and realising ambition.
   

  

 Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don’t think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other any other dimension of diversity.

**About j. awan \& partners** 




  





 At j. awan \& partners, we believe in “challenging the status quo every day”, delivering seamless excellence to our customers across the world. We challenge the status quo by making tailor\-made solutions to meet the specific requirements of our clients’ business interests and delivering our solutions to their needs with effective simplicity. We understand that time is precious and as
 



 such our tailor\-made solutions are simple to understand, simple to embed and simple to use.
 



  





 We are a fast\-growing international Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) Consultancy with our headquarters in the Dubai International Finance Centre (DIFC). We also have our own Technology company creating bespoke cutting\-edge RegTech solutions. Our business presence covers multiple jurisdictions with offices in the UAE, KSA, UK \& Ireland, Singapore, Porto, Pakistan, Qatar and South Africa. We provide Regulatory Governance, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Recruitment and Technology services to many clients including global, regional and local financial services institutions, governments and other industry partners.
 



  





**Mission / Purpose of the Role** 




  





 The Senior Manager – Compliance role will lead and oversee regulatory compliance and AML/CTF obligations across a portfolio of client mandates within the Region. The role ensures clients are fully aligned with regulatory expectations by implementing best\-in\-class compliance frameworks, conducting ongoing monitoring, and serving as the principal regulatory liaison. Reporting to the Director of Compliance, the role drives business growth by converting existing relationships into new opportunities and supporting the expansion of the compliance practice across our operating jurisdictions. **Develop and implement robust Compliance and AML frameworks and training programs.** 



* Policies aligned with regulatory requirements; regular AML and Compliance training conducted, resulting in improved compliance awareness among clients.



  





**Audit, monitor, and improve compliance processes.** 



* Regular compliance reviews completed; identified gaps addressed with corrective action; internal controls strengthened.



  





**Manage and expand the compliance client portfolio while supporting business growth across the Region.** 



* New business opportunities identified and supported. Strengthened client retention and satisfaction. Growth in brand visibility and market presence.



  





**Continuously improve compliance and AML/CTF systems.** 



* Implementation of new processes, tools, or automation; measurable reduction in compliance risks; adoption of industry best practices.



  





**Strengthen business development and client engagement.** 



* New client acquisitions; increased market share and revenue from compliance services; successful representation at industry events.



  





**Contribute to firm culture, brand, and people development.** 



* Positive internal and external stakeholder feedback. Support in recruitment and retention initiatives. Active mentorship and knowledge sharing within the team.



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




  





**Regulatory Compliance Delivery** 



* Provide ongoing compliance and AML support to clients.
* Draft, implement, and manage compliance and AML frameworks.
* Ensure adherence to local and international regulatory requirements.
* Compliance deliverables completed on time.
* Policies and procedures aligned with latest laws.
* No material compliance issues.



  





**Audit \& Monitoring** 



* Coordinate internal/external audits.
* Conduct compliance reviews and spot checks.
* Identify and remediate control weaknesses.
* Compliance reviews completed on schedule.
* Gaps addressed with corrective action.
* Strengthened internal controls.



  





**Training \& Awareness** 



* Deliver training on compliance, AML, and governance topics.
* Build client awareness of emerging regulations and risks.
* Client confirmation of effective and timely training delivery.
* Full client participation with positive feedback.
* Relevant regulatory updates delivered to clients.



  





**Business Development \& Brand Representation** 



* Support senior team in executing client mandates.
* Help with origination of new business.
* Represent the Firm at industry and promotional events.
* Positive feedback from senior team.
* New business opportunities identified and supported.
* Active participation in events.



  





**Leadership \& Communication** 



* Communicate compliance risks and obligations to senior management.
* Foster relationships with stakeholders, auditors, regulators, and clients.
* Represent consultancy professionally.
* Effective risk communication.
* Strong stakeholder relationships.
* Professional representation at all levels.



  





**Continuous Improvement** 



* Stay updated on regulatory developments.
* Refine compliance/AML systems, processes, and training.
* Implement best practices.
* Implementation of improved processes/tools.
* Measurable reduction in compliance risk.
* Adoption of industry best practices.



  





**Team \& Culture** 



* Promote j. awan \& partners’ culture and brand.
* Support talent attraction and retention.
* Coach and mentor junior team members.
* Positive internal engagement scores.
* Contribution to team development initiatives.
* Evidence of mentorship and knowledge sharing.



  





**Core Competencies** 



* Regulatory Expertise \& Strategic Mindset: Demonstrable experience engaging with regulatory authorities across the region, with the ability to design and implement compliance programs that mitigate risk and drive organisational effectiveness.
* Operational Excellence: Experienced in executing compliance and AML programs efficiently, ensuring high\-quality deliverables and adherence to deadlines across multiple client mandates.
* Analytical \& Problem\-Solving Skills: Exceptional capability to analyse complex regulatory issues, interpret requirements, and translate them into actionable, fit\-for\-purpose solutions.
* Integrity \& Accountability: Upholds the highest professional and ethical standards, maintains confidentiality, and demonstrates reliability and accountability in all activities.
* Stakeholder Management \& Cultural Agility: Skilled at building partnerships and influencing clients, regulators, and internal teams, with the adaptability to work effectively across diverse organisations and cultural contexts.



  





**Role\-Specific Competencies** 



* Compliance \& AML Expertise: Hands\-on experience designing, implementing, and overseeing regulatory compliance and AML frameworks within financial services, with proven ability to manage obligations across applicable regulatory regimes including but not limited to DFSA, ADGM, QFCRA, FCA, and CMA.
* KYC \& Regulatory Delivery: Proven KYC and due diligence capability including risk classification and SLA\-driven delivery, with the ability to translate evolving regulatory requirements into practical, fit\-for\-purpose policies and procedures.
* Organisation \& Execution: Strong ability to manage multiple compliance projects and competing deadlines simultaneously, working independently under pressure while maintaining accuracy and quality of delivery.
* Stakeholder \& Communication Skills: Exceptional oral and written communication skills for effective interaction with clients, regulators, and senior leadership, with strong interpersonal skills to build and maintain productive working relationships.



  





**Education**

**Experience** 



* Significant demonstrable experience in dealing with regulatory authorities within the Region.

* Direct experience in developing and implementing compliance programs is essential.
* Direct experience in creating and implementing regulatory compliance programs within a successful financial services organisation.



  





**Additional Requirements** 



* CAMS, CISI, or ICA qualifications preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus.

data.jd_text:
**MAIN OBJECTIVE OF ROLE**
 To maximize fleet value by optimizing Cost per Available Seat Kilometer (CASK), aircraft utilization, operational introduction and lifecycle performance across all operated fleets (737, 787\), by managing key fleet cost drivers such as modification programs, BFE agreements, maintenance contracts, and utilization efficiency through structured SLA and KPI analysis, and ensures effective governance of contractual performance guarantees and deliverables across operational agreements, while leading operational project execution with strong cost control, disciplined oversight, operational performance and delivery within agreed timelines.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Establishes processes for analyzing CASK at an aircraft level across all fleets, establishing a baseline cost per fleet.
* Evaluates changes to baseline costs resulting from modification programmes, system changes, network planning data and new contracts.
* Ensures that existing contracts for OEM, BFE \& Maintenance Services are performing in accordance with expectations, SLAs and performance guarantees.
* Establishes structured framework for contract management over the lifecycle in order to ensure compliance against scope, ensure that objectives are clearly understood and enforce contract adherence
* Identifies risks on the CASK, resulting from operational influences, engagement with stakeholders to ensure mitigation.
* Evaluates OEM \& 3rd Party changes and proposed changes to fleet and evaluate cost impact against financial expectation, ensuring that agreed business cases yield positive results.
* Provides strategic oversight for statistical analysis, data visualization, reports to stakeholders, make recommendations supported by data trends
* Oversees end\-to\-end ownership of operational fleet strategy across all fleet typesensuring alignment with network, operations, and commercial requirements
* Establishes definition and continuous optimization of fleet configuration strategies across all sub\-fleets to support efficiency and standardization
* Ensures full lifecycle cost management including acquisition, operations, modification, and retirement cost driversin liaison with relevant stakeholders.
* Oversees management of fleet configuration complexity and retrofit and reduction of sub\-fleet variation where commercially and operationally viable .
* Manages and oversight of CAPEX prioritization, benefits realization, and lifecycle value optimization across all major operational investments.
* Defines and translates fleet data into actionable decisions for strategy, investment, and operational optimization
* Consolidation of fleet governance forums, committees, and working groups into a single accountable structure
* Prioritizes and sequencing of fleet modification programs based on cost impact, operational disruption, and strategic value.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree (3\+ years)
* Bachelor’s Degree in Aviation Management, Finance or Engineering with a Master’s Degree preferable
* Fluent in English
* Extensive experience in airline operations, engineering, and fleet/technical programs, operational systems with exposure to both narrow\-body and wide\-body aircraft environments. Proven track record in delivering large\-scale CAPEX and strategic transformation projects, including aircraft induction, retrofit programs, and IT/system implementations. Strong background in governance of multi\-million\-dollar portfolios, with focus on cost optimization, lifecycle value, and performance of key operational contracts. Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional initiatives across COO, engineering, airport operations, and external partners to ensure disciplined, on\-time project delivery and business impact.

data.jd_text:
Our client is a leading FMCG manufacturer with a portfolio of well\-established brands operating across multiple channels and markets. As part of their continued growth strategy, they are seeking an experienced Commercial Director to lead the overall commercial agenda, drive sustainable revenue growth, and strengthen market leadership
 **.** 




  





  





 The Commercial Director will be responsible for developing and executing the commercial strategy across sales, key accounts, distributors, and strategic customer relationships. This is a pivotal role requiring a blend of strategic vision, commercial acumen, and operational excellence.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Develop and execute the company's commercial strategy in line with overall business objectives.
* Drive sustainable growth in revenue, market share, and profitability.
* Lead and develop high\-performing sales and commercial teams.
* Build and strengthen relationships with key customers, distributors, retailers, and strategic partners.
* Negotiate major commercial agreements and long\-term customer partnerships.
* Identify new business opportunities, routes to market, and growth channels.
* Ensure effective pricing, trade investment, promotional planning, and margin management.
* Collaborate closely with Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, Operations, and Product teams to deliver business objectives.
* Analyse market trends, customer insights, and competitive activity to inform commercial decisions.
* Lead budgeting, forecasting, and annual business planning processes.
* Establish clear performance metrics and drive a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
* Represent the business externally with customers, industry bodies, and key stakeholders.



  





 Candidate Profile
 


* Proven experience in a senior commercial leadership role such as Commercial Director, Sales Director, Business Director, or General Manager within FMCG, consumer goods, manufacturing, food \& beverage, building materials, or a related sector.
* Demonstrated success delivering significant revenue growth and commercial transformation.
* Strong experience managing key accounts, distributors, and multi\-channel sales environments.
* Excellent understanding of commercial strategy, pricing, profitability, and P\&L management.
* Experience leading and developing high\-performing teams.
* Strong negotiation, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strategic thinker with the ability to translate plans into measurable business outcomes.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related discipline. MBA advantageous.



  





 What We're Looking For
 



 We are seeking a commercially driven leader who combines strategic vision with strong execution capability. The successful candidate will be an inspiring people leader, a trusted business partner, and a highly credible commercial professional capable of delivering growth in a dynamic and competitive environment.
 



  





 This represents an excellent opportunity to join a successful organisation and play a key role in shaping its future growth and market position.

data.jd_text:
Shamal Holding is a diversified investment firm that cultivates the extraordinary. Born in Dubai, we curate a unique portfolio of extraordinary investments, experiences and assets to generate meaningful outcomes. The investments we make are strategically chosen and thoughtfully nurtured, mirroring Dubai’s ambition, spirit and energy. As a global investor, asset owner and developer we utilise our resources, know\-how and connections, to deliver long\-term value, wherever we operate.
   

  

 As Shamal Holding continues to grow, we’re in search of a
 **Director \- Contracts** 
 . In this role you will provide contractual and commercial support to the Development department within Shamal. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in both pre and post\-contract management across multiple project sectors within the UAE. The role requires strong negotiation skills, a broad knowledge of local regulations and the ability to manage contracts throughout the entire project lifecycle from inception to completion.
   

  

* Responsible for the management of all contractual activities within the Development team.
* Assist with tender/request for proposal process from pre\-qualification through to tender analysis and recommendation to Shamal Tender Committee.
* Lead contract negotiations to ensure terms and conditions align with Shamal’s objectives and company policies, and coordinate internally with Shamal Legal, Governance \& Compliance/Finance/Insurance teams to mitigate identified commercial risks.
* Drafting of contractual documentation including various forms of construction contract (lump sum, measured price, two\-stage), consultancy, settlement, novation, assignment agreements).
* Prepare high\-level commercial risk reports for non\-negotiable contracts and clear commercial instructions for bespoke contracts.
* Post\-contract assessment of contractor/consultant invoices/payment applications/recommendations, and entitlement to variations / extension of time and cost claims.
* Responsible for the management of post\-contract administration of contracts and monitor contractor/consultant compliance with contractual terms \& conditions and scope of services in collaboration with the relevant project teams.
* Review and provide feedback on sale \& purchase agreement governance documentation/master community declarations/building management statements.
* Preparation of project correspondence and contractual notices, including for breach, suspension and termination.
* Review and provide internal feedback on bank guarantees, taking\-over certificates and defects liability certificates.
* Ensure strict compliance with Development team delegation of authority, policies, procedures and templates, and identify potential improvements to maximise efficiency.
* Manage consultant/contractor dispute resolution and settlement matters in close coordination with the Legal team.
* Relevant Bachelor's degree in Quantity Surveying, engineering or similar.
* RICS/MRICS accreditation is a plus.
* A minimum of 12 years of relevant experience with at least 5 years in a managerial role within the UAE real estate Developer or construction sector.
* Strong understanding of local laws, regulations and industry practice in the UAE.
* Extensive experience in the FIDIC suite of contracts.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills with the ability to liaise effectively with internal teams, contractors, consultants and local authorities.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess risk, manage changes and proactively implement solutions.
* High attention to detail with strong organizational skills and the ability to simultaneously manage multiple projects.


**For more information about Shamal, please visit our LinkedIn page** 
 https//www.linkedin.com/company/shamalholding/
   

  

**Note**
 Due to a high influx of profiles, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

data.jd_text:
We are seeking a visionary and commercially minded Creative Director to lead the creative strategy and brand direction across our portfolio of luxury perfume and food \& beverage brands. The Creative Director will be responsible for shaping and elevating brand identity, customer experience, product storytelling, marketing campaigns, retail design, and visual communication to ensure a consistent and compelling brand presence across all customer touchpoints.
 



 This role requires a blend of creativity, strategic thinking, leadership, and commercial awareness to drive brand growth, customer engagement, and market differentiation.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 Creative Leadership \& Brand Strategy
 


* Define and lead the creative vision for all brands within the luxury perfume and F\&B portfolio.
* Develop and maintain strong brand identities, ensuring consistency across all channels and customer touchpoints.
* Drive innovative creative concepts that strengthen brand positioning and support business objectives.
* Ensure all creative outputs reflect the premium and luxury standards of the Group.



 Marketing \& Campaign Development
 


* Lead the conceptualization and execution of integrated marketing campaigns, product launches, seasonal activations, and promotional initiatives.
* Oversee creative direction for digital, social media, print, outdoor advertising, packaging, and in\-store communications.
* Collaborate closely with marketing teams to create impactful customer engagement strategies.
* Review and approve all creative assets before release.



 Product \& Packaging Innovation
 


* Direct the creative development of perfume packaging, gifting solutions, product presentation, and visual merchandising.
* Collaborate with product development teams to ensure product concepts align with brand positioning and market trends.
* Drive innovation in packaging design, customer experience, and brand storytelling.



 Retail Experience \& Visual Merchandising
 


* Lead creative direction for retail stores, kiosks, pop\-ups, and experiential activations.
* Ensure visual merchandising standards are consistently implemented across all locations.
* Partner with design and operations teams to enhance customer journeys and elevate brand experiences.
* Oversee store branding, signage, and retail design concepts.



 Content \& Storytelling
 


* Develop compelling brand narratives that resonate with target audiences across luxury fragrance and hospitality sectors.
* Direct creative content production including photography, videography, digital content, and social media campaigns.
* Ensure all content aligns with the brand's tone of voice and aesthetic standards.



 Team Leadership \& Stakeholder Management
 


* Build, mentor, and lead a high\-performing creative team, including designers, content creators, visual merchandisers, and external agencies.
* Foster a culture of creativity, innovation, and collaboration.
* Work closely with senior leadership, brand managers, operations, and marketing teams to align creative initiatives with business goals.
* Manage relationships with creative agencies, production houses, photographers, and other external partners.



 Trend Analysis \& Innovation
 


* Stay abreast of global luxury retail, fragrance, hospitality, design, and consumer trends.
* Identify emerging opportunities and translate market insights into creative strategies.
* Continuously challenge existing approaches to keep brands relevant, distinctive, and competitive.



 Qualifications \& Experience
 


* Bachelor's Degree in Design, Creative Arts, Marketing, Branding, Communications, or a related field.
* Minimum 10–15 years of creative leadership experience within luxury retail, fragrances, beauty, fashion, hospitality, or premium consumer brands.
* Proven track record of building and growing luxury brands through innovative creative direction.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating excellence in branding, campaigns, retail experiences, packaging, and content creation.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary creative teams and external agencies.



 Key Skills \& Competencies
 


* Creative vision and strategic thinking
* Luxury brand development and management
* Marketing campaign leadership
* Retail and customer experience design
* Visual storytelling and content creation
* Packaging and product design oversight
* Leadership and team development
* Commercial acumen
* Stakeholder management and presentation skills
* Strong understanding of digital and social media platforms



 Success Measures
 


* Strengthened brand equity and market positioning.
* Increased customer engagement and brand loyalty.
* Successful execution of product launches and marketing campaigns.
* Consistent luxury brand experience across all channels.
* Growth in brand awareness, footfall, and commercial performance.

data.jd_text:
VEON is a Nasdaq\-listed global digital operator that serves more than 150 million customers with connectivity and about 120 million monthly active users with digital services in some of the world’s most exciting frontier markets. Operating across 5 countries that are home to nearly 520 million people, in other words more than 6% of the world’s population, VEON transforms lives through technology\-driven services that empower individuals and drive economic growth.
   

  

 With VEON’s Digital Operator 1440 vision and strategy, VEON Group companies redefine the engagement that telecom operators have with their customers, providing the best digital experience to customers up to 1440 minutes in a day. We transform not only the daily experience of the final users, but also support the growth of enterprises and industries as a whole, using cutting\-edge technologies in AI, big\-data and cloud services to serve our business customers.
   

  

 This is all underpinned by a commitment to sustainability, ensuring VEON’s operations are run safely and ethically while fostering digital entrepreneurship and greater digital skills and literacy in the communities in which VEON operates. VEON’s values\-based approach works to strengthen trust by building a responsible and sustainable business that benefits customers, employees, communities, and shareholders.
   

  

 VEON’s international leadership team is drawn from experienced executives from around the world and has been led by CEO Kaan Terzioğlu since July 2021\.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Director M\&A will support the M\&A activity for VEON Group, focusing on key areas and potential digital verticals i.e. Fin\-Tech, Digital Banking, Entertainment, Health Tech and Ride Hailing etc. and lead end to end transactions for the Group.
   

  

 This will include the strategic analysis, identification and execution of a wide range of complex international transactions including acquisitions, divestitures, mergers and will take the lead on selective M\&A activity within the operating companies.
   

  

 This role, reporting directly to Chief Investment Officer VEON Group, will play a key role in reshaping VEON as it delivers its digital growth journey.
   

  

 The Director M\&A will be seen as a highly credible voice and representative of the company and as such be able to influence, persuade and shape perceptions and understanding of the VEON business, which in turn creates a relationships and an operating environment that allows the business to successfully achieve its strategic objectives and desired performance.
   

  

 The Director of M\&A will be part of a focused team that will develop and deliver a clear and comprehensive plan that will support the execution of the Group DO1440 and AI1440 strategy and the M\&A activity with equity investors. The Director M\&A will partner with both business leaders and functional leaders and all internal and external stakeholders to bring their plans to life.
   

  

 In contributing to the strategy and subsequently implementing it, The Director M\&A will harness the functional expertise that currently exists within the Group, empowering the function, providing leaders with a framework to operate both globally and locally in market.
   

  

 Organisational savviness, an international mindset and experience working in a multi\-jurisdictional emerging market matrix environment is essential.
   

  

 The Director of M\&A will demonstrate a deep understanding of the unique challenges the telecommunications and digital technology industries face and be able to quickly build mutually beneficial relationships with stakeholders, both external and internal.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Transaction Leadership \& Execution**
* Lead end\-to\-end M\&A transactions for VEON Group, including acquisitions, divestitures and mergers across complex international frontier markets.
* Take ownership of selective M\&A activity within operating companies, managing all phases from origination through to close.


**Strategic Analysis \& Opportunity Identification**
* Drive strategic analysis and identification of M\&A opportunities across key verticals including FinTech, Digital Banking and Entertainment, aligned with the Group's DO1440 digital growth strategy. Stakeholder Engagement \& Influence
* Serve as a highly credible representative of VEON, building and managing relationships with equity investors, external partners and internal stakeholders. Influence, persuade and shape perceptions of the VEON business to create an operating environment conducive to strategic success.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner with business and functional leaders across the Group and operating companies to bring M\&A plans to life.
* Leverage existing functional expertise to execute M\&A transactions effectively across both global and local market contexts.


**Strategic Planning \& Delivery**
* Contribute to and implement a clear, comprehensive M\&A plan that supports the execution of the Group's overarching strategy, working closely with the CIO and broader leadership team.


**Multi\-Jurisdictional Deal Management**
* Navigate and manage M\&A activity across multiple jurisdictions, coordinating legal, regulatory, financial and operational workstreams in a complex matrix environment.


**Critical Skills \& Experience**
**Technical \& Deal Expertise**
* Proven track record of executing complex, cross border M\&A transactions (acquisitions, divestitures, mergers) from origination to close
* Strong financial modelling, valuation, and due diligence capabilities
* Deep understanding of deal structuring across multiple asset classes and geographies (frontier markets)


**Industry Knowledge**
* Solid grasp of the telecommunications and digital technology sectors, including the unique commercial and regulatory challenges they present
* Familiarity with high\-growth verticals such as FinTech, Digital Banking and Digital Entertainment in emerging markets


**Strategic Thinking**
* Ability to translate corporate strategy into actionable M\&A priorities and executable transaction plans
* Commercially minded with the capacity to assess strategic fit, risk and value creation potential


**Stakeholder \& Relationship Management**
* Exceptional ability to build trust and mutually beneficial relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including equity investors and C\-suite leaders
* Strong influencing and negotiation skills, able to represent the company credibly at the highest levels


**Communication \& Leadership**
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills and the ability to simplify complexity for diverse audiences
* A natural collaborator who can lead cross\-functional and cross\-border teams without direct authority


**Organizational \& Cultural Agility**
* High degree of organizational savviness with experience thriving in multi\-jurisdictional, matrix environments
* International mindset with sensitivity to local market nuances across VEON's operating footprint


**Education \& Experience**
* 10\+ years of relevant experience in corporate finance, M\&A, consulting, or equivalent professional role in investment banks, private equity, big 4’s and having inhouse experience would be an added value.
* Bachelors / Master’s degree or equivalent in or related to finance from a leading university

data.jd_text:
Join Hamilton Lane, a global leader in private markets, as we scale to meet the demands of our growing client base. Here, you’ll work with ambitious, high‑performing teams built on integrity, candor and collaboration, backed by our market\-leading data and technology. We invest heavily in our people and our partners, giving you the platform to enrich lives, safeguard futures and grow your career.
   

  

**What We Do**
 As one of the largest private markets investment firms globally, we provide innovative solutions to institutional and private wealth investors around the world, specializing in flexibility and full\-spectrum access. We currently employ approximately 800 professionals operating in offices throughout North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and the Middle East, and have $1\.0 trillion in assets under management and supervision, composed of $146\.1 billion in discretionary assets and $871\.5 billion in non\-discretionary assets, as of December 31, 2025\.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As a member of the Client Solutions Team, you will assist in providing support to Hamilton Lane’s SMA/Advisory clients within the GCC based in the firms Dubai Office.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Be To**
* Work closely with senior Client Solutions individuals to support Hamilton Lane’s existing SMA/Advisory client base in the GCC. Key portfolio/client responsibilities include:
+ Assist and manage the development of Strategic Planning
+ Modelling Portfolio Construction and Pacing scenarios
+ Manage monthly client meetings and follow up items
+ Act as a conduit between our clients and broader Hamilton Lane organization
+ Navigate internal organizational dynamics, leveraging cross\-functional approach to support our clients
+ Learn and maintain a working knowledge of HL technology tools to aggregate and present information needed for client deliverables.
+ Assist in the creation and reviewing of presentation materials for SMA clients and prospects
+ Develop expertise in HL transaction offerings to support investment objectives for our clients and ability to speak broadly on the private markets
+ Presenting and meeting with HL SMA/Advisory clients on a regular basis – both remote and in\-person


**Must\-haves**
**Your background will include:**
* Bachelor’s Degree required and post graduate qualification preferred (i.e. CFA/MBA)
* Fluent in English
* 7\+ years’ experience in financial services, with an emphasis on private markets
* Familiarity with the GCC institutional LP landscape
* Good understanding of capital structures, different financial instruments and basic portfolio construction
* Strong quantitative/analytical skills (data analysis, numerical skills, problem solving etc.)
* Experience with Microsoft Office programs (Outlook, Word, Excel, Power Point)
* Strong work ethic, positive attitude, and a willingness to learn and receive feedback
* Desire to work as part of a team with a strong focus on client needs
* Excellent communication and listening abilities
* Organizational skills; ability to manage multiple projects effectively and on\-time
* Ability to exercise discretion and maintain confidentiality
* Resourcefulness; ability to navigate ambiguity


**Travel Requirements**
 10\-25% travel requirement
   

  

**Benefits**
 At Hamilton Lane, our benefits philosophy is simple: to provide our employees with a competitive suite of benefits and services to help navigate through the complexities and challenges of working, living, raising a family, and eventually retiring.
   

  

**To Do This, Hamilton Lane Offers The Following Benefits**
**Enhancing Your Physical and Emotional Health**
 Employees have access to healthcare coverage, mental health resources, health \& fitness reimbursement program, and Wellness Rewards Program.
   

  

**Developing Your Career**
 Tuition and certification reimbursement programs are available, along with continual education and development trainings for you to grow with Hamilton Lane.
   

  

**Supporting Your Family \& Community**
 For our communities, Hamilton Lane provides paid time off to volunteer and compensates for referring qualified candidates that join our team.
   

  

 For growing family, we offer an adoption reimbursement program, paid time off for new parents and newlyweds, and provide travel support for nursing parents.
   

  

**Safeguarding Your Financial Wellbeing**
 Hamilton Lane contributes to retirement programs and offers an employee stock purchasing plan.
   

  

 Hamilton Lane is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their race, religion, ancestry, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, or medical condition. As a registered investment adviser, employees of Hamilton Lane may be subject to certain limitations on political contribution and personal investment activities.
   

  

 Hamilton Lane is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. Please, no phone calls or emails. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at Hamilton Lane via\-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of Hamilton Lane. No fee shall be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Hamilton Lane as a result of the referral or through other means.

data.jd_text:
A leading global consultancy is seeking a Regional Finance Director to provide strategic direction and expert guidance for their regional finance unit based in Dubai. This pivotal role offers you the opportunity to shape the financial agenda across multiple countries, partnering closely with senior leaders to drive business growth and ensure robust financial management. You would ideally be based in the UAE with proven regional experience.
 



**What you'll do:** 




 As Regional Finance Director, you will be entrusted with overseeing all aspects of financial management across a diverse regional portfolio. Your day\-to\-day responsibilities will involve setting strategic direction for the finance unit, guiding teams through complex challenges, and ensuring high standards of accuracy in reporting. You will work collaboratively with senior leaders to deliver business plans while maintaining rigorous controls that safeguard assets. By establishing clear KPIs and analytics frameworks, you will monitor progress against objectives and provide actionable insights. Your expertise will be crucial in managing statutory audits, preparing detailed accounts for internal and external stakeholders, and supporting company\-wide initiatives such as bid document preparation or project risk reviews. You will also play an integral role in sustainability efforts by sharing responsibility for carbon emissions reduction during project delivery. Success in this role requires you to foster a high\-performing team culture that exceeds expectations while promoting health, safety, wellbeing, and inclusivity throughout the organisation.
 






* Lead the implementation of the regional finance strategy for a designated portfolio, ensuring strategic plans are executed effectively and operational delivery aligns with organisational priorities.
* Maintain an effective financial control environment that mitigates risks of fraud or error, protecting cash, systems, investments, and other assets across the regional portfolio.
* Establish analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) for monitoring the execution of the regional finance strategy, providing clear insights into progress and outcomes.
* Act as a finance business partner to the Managing Director for the region, supporting the execution of business plans and driving commercial success.
* Collaborate with the Chief Finance Officer as part of the finance leadership team, offering expertise and counsel on all strategic finance matters within the designated portfolio.
* Oversee comprehensive financial reporting adhering to international accounting standards (IFRS), managing statutory audits and ensuring accurate accounts across subsidiaries.
* Manage monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc management accounts and reporting requirements to meet statutory, fiduciary, country\-specific obligations.
* Review unallocated staff across the regional portfolio, proactively identifying risks or opportunities that may impact sector financial performance.
* Provide monthly reviews of pipeline prospects with senior business stakeholders, ensuring leads and target gaps are accurately reported for executive summaries.
* Issue regular debtors reports and accrued income reports, taking timely action on invoicing and collections while maintaining compliance with third\-party reporting obligations.







**What you bring:** 




 Your proven experience as Regional Finance Director will demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of financial leadership within complex environments. You bring advanced skills in managing multi\-country portfolios using international accounting standards alongside deep expertise in audit processes. Your full accountancy qualifications underpin your ability to deliver accurate reporting while maintaining rigorous controls. You excel at communicating effectively across all levels\-engaging C\-Suite executives as well as nurturing professional networks externally. Your capacity for analytical thinking enables you to identify risks proactively while leveraging opportunities for improvement. As an inspiring leader who builds cohesive teams focused on shared goals, you are adept at guiding both direct and indirect reports towards exceeding performance targets. Your digital literacy ensures seamless integration of technology into daily operations while your commitment to continuous learning supports ongoing professional development. With significant experience in consultancy or related sectors, you understand industry best practices intimately\-making you an invaluable asset capable of driving transformational change.
 






* Comprehensive expertise in financial leadership within industry settings, demonstrated by a track record of achievement leading large or complex finance units or sub\-functions.
* Advanced knowledge of international accounting standards (IFRS) with proven experience managing statutory audits and preparing accurate financial reports for multi\-country portfolios.
* Highly developed analytical skills combined with advanced budgetary expertise to oversee complex financial planning processes.
* Expertise in audit and risk management practices that ensure robust controls are maintained across all areas of responsibility.
* Full accountancy qualification such as ACA (Associate Chartered Accountant), ACCA (Association of Chartered Certified Accountants), CIMA (Chartered Institute of Management Accountants), or equivalent certification.
* Significant relevant experience in finance leadership roles at regional or multi\-country level within consultancy or similar industries.
* Advanced communication skills enabling effective engagement at C\-Suite level as well as building strong relationships with internal teams and external partners including auditors, bankers, insurance brokers, tax advisors, joint venture partners.
* Proven ability to manage direct reports (1\-4\) as well as indirect reports (over 8\), fostering collaborative teamwork that delivers high performance against KPIs \& OKDs.
* Digitally savvy with technical literacy including working proficiency in Oracle systems for efficient data analysis \& reporting.
* Strategic thinking capabilities paired with inspiring leadership qualities that build effective finance teams focused on delivering organisational objectives.







**What's next:** 




 If you are ready to take your career to new heights by joining a collaborative team dedicated to excellence in regional finance leadership, apply now!
 







 Apply today by clicking on the link provided.

 You will have broad exposure within the organization and work closely with Country, Division, and Functional management teams and liaise with partners in the Legal, Finance and Business Development teams. * Collaborate closely with regional and country management across EEMEA
* Participating in cross\-functional teams and liaising closely with various internal and external stakeholders, e.g., Product, Finance, Legal , Customers, consultants, etc.

* Strong drive and curiosity to learn, creativity, passion to achieve and excel
* Ability to manage projects and use project\-management skills for managing complex processes
* Strong team player who can operate effectively in a complex matrix
* Strong background in finance and analytics
* Excellent knowledge of Agentic Automation, Excel, and other Information Management tools
* Fluent in English


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 **Director — Technology Governance, Architecture, Budget, ITSM Standards \& PMO**

 PMO Managers, Project Governance Leads, Reporting \& Controls Analysts

**In scope delivery and handover domains, including, but not limited to:**
* City Business Applications
* City Platforms (integration/IoT/data)

* City Physical Security technology
* City ICT infrastructure and data centers including City IT/OT Security


**Key Responsibilities**
* Delivery \& Handover Governance Framework (City Technology)
* Implement and maintain Delivery \& Handover Governance standards for City Technology programs, including:
+ reporting templates and cadence
+ stage\-gate criteria
+ RAID log standards
+ dependency tracking rules
+ baseline control requirements (scope/schedule/cost)

* Ensure all delivery teams and vendors comply with governance controls
* Integrated Program Controls

* Stage Gates \& Assurance (Delivery\-to\-Run)

* Design completion readiness (as required by TDAs)
* Testing and commissioning evidence
* Documentation and as\-built readiness
* Operational readiness evidence for transition into technology support

**City Business Applications**
**City OT \& Smart Systems**
**City Physical Security Systems**
**City Platforms (Integration / IoT / Data)**
**City ICT Infrastructure and Data Centers including City IT/OT Security**
* Risk, Issues, and Dependency Governance (RAID)

**Key Interfaces**

* Delivery contractors
* OEMs providing commissioning and handover support
* Managed service providers supporting transition planning


**Success Measures (KPIs)**

* Delivery risk closure rate (RAID actions completed on time)
* Number of uncontrolled scope changes / late change requests
* Reduction in "handover defects" (missing documentation, missing runbooks, missing monitoring)
* Reduction in incidents caused by poor delivery transition within first 30 days of go\-live


**Operational Readiness \& Handover Governance**
* Define acceptance criteria for transition from Project to Operations

**Portfolio \& Financial Governance**
* Track total technology investment portfolio (CAPEX and transformation OPEX)
* Align with Finance for forecasting accuracy
* Monitor cost variance and earned value performance
* Maintain benefits realization tracking framework


**Stakeholder Management**
* Engage Directors across all City Technology tower
* Interface with Corporate PMO and Enterprise Architecture
* Present executive updates to Technology Steering Committee
* Coordinate with Procurement and Legal for contract governance alignment


**Requirements**
* 15\+ year\-experience in large\-scale ICT infrastructure, smart city, or complex technology Delivery \& Handover Governance / PMO / program controls roles
* Experience in complex multi\-domain environments, ideally including:
+ IT \+ OT programs
+ infrastructure and data centers
+ physical security technology delivery
+ smart city platforms and integration

* Strong knowledge of:
+ stage\-gate Delivery \& Handover Governance
+ RAID management
+ dependency management
+ reporting and executive governance packs

* Strong stakeholder management and escalation skills
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science or related field (Master's preferred)
* Experience managing IT \+ OT delivery environments preferred
* Strong experience in governance\-heavy or giga\-project environments
* PMP or equivalent certification required
* Agile/Scrum or SAFe certification preferred
* ITIL knowledge required
* Strong financial governance and executive reporting capability

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
 The Project Director is responsible for the overall leadership and delivery of large\-scale data centre projects in Saudi Arabia within a general contracting environment. The role has full accountability for project performance, including safety, programme, cost, quality, and commercial outcomes, ensuring compliance with Saudi regulations, local authority requirements, and contractual obligations. Working closely with clients, consultants, subcontractors and key stakeholders, the Project Director builds, develops and leads multidisciplinary teams to deliver mission\-critical data centre facilities to the highest standards, while managing local supply chains, Saudization requirements, and fast\-track project demands in the KSA market.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Leadership \& Delivery:**
* Provide end\-to\-end leadership for complex, mission\-critical data centre project from mobilisation through commissioning and handover.
* Take full responsibility for project performance, including programme, cost control, quality, safety, and risk management.
* Ensure compliance with contractual requirements, technical specifications, and regional regulations.
* Lead project governance, reporting, and decision\-making at senior and client levels.
* Appointment of individuals to key project positions.
* Work across company functional departments to engage support for on time delivery.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management:**
* Act as the primary senior point of contact for clients, consultants, subcontractors and key stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring confidence in delivery and responsiveness.
* Manage client expectations and lead negotiations on variations, claims, and commercial matters.


**Commercial \& Contractual Oversight:**
* Oversee commercial strategy in collaboration with commercial team.
* Ensure effective cost control, forecasting, and cash flow management.
* Review and approve major subcontract packages, procurement strategies, and commercial decisions.
* Manage risk, claims, and dispute avoidance/resolution.


**Team \& Resource Management:**
* Build, Lead, mentor, and develop project management, engineering, construction, and support teams.
* Ensure appropriate resourcing, capability, and succession planning for project delivery.
* Promote a strong culture of safety, accountability, and performance excellence.


**Programme, Quality \& Safety:**
* Ensure robust planning and programme controls are in place to meet critical data centre milestones.
* Drive best\-in\-class quality assurance and control processes aligned with data centre standards.
* Champion health, safety, and environmental excellence across all project activities.


**Pre\-Construction \& Business Support:**
* Support pre\-construction, tendering, and bid teams with construction methodology, programme input, and risk reviews.
* Contribute to value engineering, buildability reviews, and logistics planning.
* Support business development efforts related to data centre opportunities where required.


**Preferred Experience \& Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* 15\+ years’ experience in construction delivery, with significant experience as a Project Director or Senior Project Manager.
* Proven track record delivering large\-scale data centre projects within a General Contracting / Main Contractor environment.
* Middle East \& Saudi Arabia experience, including knowledge of local regulations and practices.
* Demonstrated experience managing large, multi\-disciplinary teams and major subcontractors.
* Strong commercial, contractual, and risk management expertise.


**Key Competencies**
* Executive\-level project leadership
* Data centre construction expertise (mission\-critical environments)
* Client and stakeholder management
* Commercial and contractual acumen
* Programme and risk management
* Decision\-making under pressure
* Safety and quality leadership


**Personal Attributes**
* Strong leadership presence and credibility at client and executive level.
* Highly organised, decisive, and results\-driven.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multi\-cultural teams.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast\-paced, high\-risk, mission\-critical environments.

data.jd_text:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.
   

  

 For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.
   

  

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***
 The Project Controls Manager will lead and manage all project controls functions across major railway and transportation infrastructure projects, ensuring effective planning, scheduling, cost control, reporting, risk management, change management, and performance monitoring. The role is critical to supporting successful project delivery in line with approved budgets, schedules, quality standards, and contractual obligations.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Lead and manage the overall project controls function, including planning, scheduling, cost control, risk, change management, progress measurement, and performance reporting.
* Establish and maintain project controls procedures, systems, tools, templates, and reporting protocols in line with PMC and client requirements.
* Manage and mentor the project controls team, ensuring effective delivery across planning, cost, reporting, and risk disciplines.
* Review and monitor contractor and consultant schedules to ensure alignment with project milestones, contractual requirements, and delivery strategy.
* Analyze schedule performance, identify delays and critical path impacts, and recommend mitigation, recovery, and time impact measures where required.
* Establish and oversee cost control processes, including budget tracking, forecasting, cash flow monitoring, variance analysis, and alignment of cost with physical progress.
* Prepare and consolidate dashboards, KPIs, and project controls reports for senior management and client stakeholders.
* Lead risk and change management processes, including risk registers, impact assessments, trend monitoring, variations, and support for claims and extension of time reviews.
* Coordinate with commercial, engineering, construction, and client teams to ensure alignment on project controls matters and contract compliance.
* Ensure effective use of project controls systems, data integrity, reporting quality, and continuous improvement in controls processes and governance.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* Minimum 20 years of experience in project controls, planning, cost, and performance management on major capital projects.
* Mandatory experience in railway or major transportation infrastructure projects.
* Strong GCC experience is required.
* Saudi Arabia experience is preferred.
* Proven experience working with PMC, client\-side, or major program management teams on large, complex projects.
* Demonstrated ability to manage project controls across multiple contracts and interfaces.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or related field is required.
* Master’s degree is preferred.
* PMP, PMI\-SP, AACE, RICS, or equivalent professional certification is desirable.
* Strong knowledge of project controls principles, scheduling techniques, cost control systems, and risk management practices.
* Proficiency in Primavera P6 and strong familiarity with cost and reporting tools.
* Strong understanding of EPC, design\-build, and FIDIC\-based contract environments.
* Ability to analyze complex data and provide strategic recommendations to project leadership.
* Strong leadership and team management capability.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a high\-profile, multicultural, and fast\-paced delivery environment.
* Strong report\-writing and presentation skills for senior executive audiences.


 Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

data.jd_text:
**Want to work with the most sought\-after minds and most talked\-about projects? Your experience of working on complex Advisory Projects in the Middle East might just make you our new Engagement Manager – Operations Advisory.**
**Here at Buro Happold, expect the exceptional.**
 From the projects you will work on to the clients we work with. From career\-defining opportunities to an inclusive and diverse practice where we all contribute to a more equitable world. From our reputation to our relationships. Wherever your Buro Happold career takes you, it’ll be anything but ordinary.
   

  

**Your next role**
 Buro Happold has a clear strategic plan, strong learning culture and entrepreneurial mindset that will allow you to thrive.
   

  

 You’ll be part of something bigger than us all where sustainability, equity, social and performance outcomes matter. All of Buro Happold is committed to doing the right thing, even when that’s the hardest thing. This is a genuine opportunity to make impact \- and leave real legacy.
   

  

**Your key duties**
 Saudi Arabia is entering a delivery‑led phase in which large portfolios of urban, social and economic infrastructure assets are moving into their operational phase, requiring robust operating models, governance, and performance management frameworks. Buro Happold is uniquely placed in this context, bringing decades of design and advisory experience on many of the Kingdom’s priority assets and programmes.
   

  

 In this role you will sit at the intersection of strategy, engineering and operations, helping clients to translate vision‑led masterplans and investment cases into practical, value‑for‑money operating solutions that work on the ground. You will play a visible part in shaping how major assets are operated, maintained and continually optimised to deliver desired outcomes over the long term.
   

  

 As Engagement Manager – Operations Advisory, you will lead multidisciplinary consulting engagements that help public and private clients in Saudi Arabia move from planning to delivery as major programmes and giga‑projects transition into their operational phase. Building on Buro Happold’s deep understanding of complex assets across sectors, you will shape and deliver integrated advisory projects that combine our capabilities in strategy development, asset management, engineering, digital solutions, and sustainability across the Built Environment to improve performance, resilience and commercial outcomes.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Transport Consultant to join our prestigious team in Dubai, UAE, to work on some of the world’s best and most complex projects.
   

  

**Client leadership and engagement management**
* Act as the primary day‑to‑day leader for Operations engagements, accountable for on‑time, on‑budget delivery and client satisfaction across multiple workstreams.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders (ministries, delivery entities, asset owners, operators, investors), serving as a strategic advisor on asset operations, service models and transformation roadmaps.
* Shape engagement scope, workplans, staffing and budgets, ensuring alignment with client priorities, contractual commitments and Buro Happold quality standards.


**Integrated Buro Happold offer development**
* Combine capabilities from Asset Consultancy, Advisory, Digital, Sustainability and core Engineering teams into coherent, repeatable Operations offerings tailored to KSA clients.
* Capture and codify methods, tools and case studies from live projects to create playbooks and accelerators for asset operations, performance improvement and transformation.
* Collaborate with regional and global leadership to refine the growth strategy for Strategy and Operations services, including priority sectors, geographies and key accounts.


**Business development and practice building**
* Originate and lead Operations opportunities with new and existing clients, including proposal leadership, pitch delivery and framework responses.
* Represent Buro Happold in market‑facing forums in KSA and the GCC, articulating our perspective on asset operations.
* Mentor and develop junior consultants and engineers, contributing to a high‑performing, diverse and collaborative regional advisory team.


**Operating Model design**
* Lead the development of operating models and implementation plans for portfolios of assets transitioning into operation, including roles and responsibilities, service delivery models and outsourcing/insourcing options.
* Define performance frameworks, KPIs and governance structures that link asset operations to wider programme objectives (e.g. Vision 2030, ESG, visitor experience, revenue and cost optimisation).
* Work with sector and technical specialists to input to commercial models that quantify lifecycle costs, whole‑life value and operational risk, informing investment and operating decisions.


**Your Skills And Experience**
* Significant experience (typically 8–12 years) in management consulting, strategy and operations, asset management or related advisory roles, ideally with exposure to large‑scale infrastructure, urban development or real estate portfolios.
* Strong track record leading complex consulting engagements or programmes, including responsibility for client relationships, delivery management, team leadership and commercial performance.
* Demonstrable experience in the KSA market, with understanding of public‑sector structures, delivery entities and the transition from capital delivery to asset operations.
