data.jd_text:
Own the backlog for a national platform, turning product vision and roadmap into a prioritized, build ready stream of work your squad ships sprint after sprint.
 



 RQMNA builds the sovereign platforms that turn national digital ambitions into services millions of citizens use every day.
 



  





 We are hiring a Senior Product Manager, on site in Muscat, to own the backlog and drive delivery for a major area of national platforms.
 



  





 What you'll do: Own the backlog, turn the roadmap into prioritized, build ready work, and steer your squad to ship it.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities:
 


* Own and prioritize the product backlog for one or more delivery squads, aligned to the product roadmap and vision
* Translate strategy and roadmap into clear epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria the team can build
* Be the team's daily voice of the product: answer questions, make trade off calls, and unblock decisions fast
* Order the backlog ruthlessly by value, and decide what is in and out of each sprint
* Accept or reject completed work against acceptance criteria, and own the definition of done with the team
* Run backlog refinement, sprint planning, and reviews alongside the Scrum Master and engineering
* Gather and manage requirements across government entities, and turn conflicting asks into one ordered backlog
* Track delivery against outcomes, and continuously reprioritize as you learn



  





 What makes you a fit:
 


* You have owned a real product backlog and driven a squad to ship working software, not just managed a tracker
* You write crisp user stories and acceptance criteria, and you slice work so teams can actually deliver it
* You prioritize by value, and you are comfortable saying no and deferring the rest
* You are decisive in the room, so the team gets fast, clear answers from you
* You partner well with engineering and design, and with the Product Manager who owns the roadmap above you
* You manage demanding stakeholders without letting the backlog become a wish list
* You hold a Bachelor's or higher in a relevant field; CSPO, PSPO, or SAFe POPM certifications are a plus
* Bonus points for government, regulated, or platform and multitenant products
* Fluent English required; Arabic is a valuable advantage



  





 If you turn vision into shipped software, sprint after sprint, own the backlog here. Apply.

data.jd_text:
Are you ready to turn AI strategy into measurable commercial outcomes that elevate how we reach and support patients across fast\-evolving markets? From a leadership seat in Dubai, you will connect senior regional priorities with cutting\-edge AI delivery to shape how our field, marketing, access and medical teams engage customers and make decisions at speed.
   

  

 In this role, you act as the embedded translator between regional business leaders and our AI organization, owning the lifecycle of high\-impact AI solutions—from idea to adoption to value realization. You will sit with regional leadership, partner closely with enterprise AI and technology teams, and lead the charge on AI programs that power next\-best engagement, dynamic insights and agentic platforms. How would you convert complex, cross\-market needs into scalable AI programs that deliver clear ROI and sustained business value?
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Customer Engagement: Lead the transformation of Interational go\-to\-market model across personal and non\-personal channels — commercial operations, salesforce excellence in partnership with the therapy areas, and digital and omnichannel — to improve effectiveness, drive personalization, and lift the impact of customer engagement.
* Strategy and Portfolio Ownership: Own the regional portfolio of AI commercial programs; create and sequence a clear roadmap aligned to business, medical, access and R\&D priorities; develop business cases and value narratives; embed reuse principles to scale what works.
* Use Case Translation: Engage senior stakeholders to surface unmet needs and decision points; translate them into well\-scoped AI use cases with clear problem statements, success metrics, data requirements, and risk tiering; align to strategic focus areas including AI30\.
* Delivery, Scale and Value Realization: Co\-lead solution delivery with enterprise AI teams; shape pilots, manage scaled deployments and local adoption; define and track KPIs and ROI; apply appropriate evidence frameworks; remediate or decommission where needed.
* Change Leadership and Ways of Working: Lead structured stakeholder engagement; embed AI into day\-to\-day operations, moving beyond one\-off pilots; identify process and role shifts and work with functional leaders to implement them; partner with learning teams to build AI literacy.
* Data, Governance and Compliance: Serve as regional point of contact to ensure AI\-ready data and compliance with enterprise standards and local regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, AI Act, SaMD); adhere to governance requirements including registry\-before\-scale, model/data cards, ongoing monitoring and human\-in\-the\-loop oversight.
* Partnerships and Ecosystem: Co\-develop programs with Commercial AI and Global Business Services; establish clear remits and hand\-offs across enterprise teams; build a delivery culture grounded in shared purpose, psychological safety and accountability.
* Integration with Enterprise AI: Act as the primary interface to capability teams across customer and patient engagement, data science and analytics, and platform engineering, ensuring clarity on ownership, priorities and transitions from build to run.
* Market Sensing and Foresight: Scan internal and external trends; track market and innovation shifts to anticipate opportunities and risks; spot and shape new enterprise initiatives; define leading indicators to monitor progress and pivot decisively.
* Near\-term to Broader Impact: In the first 90 days, assess demand, set the roadmap and launch priority pilots; in 6–12 months, scale adoption across markets, demonstrate ROI and codify reuse; over time, institutionalize AI\-enabled ways of working that accelerate growth and improve patient outcomes.


**Essential Skills / Experience**
* Minimum 10 years professional experience, with 5\-7 years focus on leading transformation programs in commercial pharma
* Demonstrated commercial and scientific domain experience reflecting a deep understanding of the needs of the business function and Region you are responsible for.
* Strong analytical and communication skills at all levels of the organization and the ability to operate successfully in highly matrixed organizations
* Effective interpersonal and relationship management skills with consultative approach and ability to interact and build trust
* Operational effectiveness, highly organized process with follow through
* Strong initiative to understand our core business goals and establish processes or programs to set direction, generate alignment and push forward
* Financial background and understanding of forecasts, budgets, financial activities and tools
* Resourceful, motivated, influential and proactive; able to prioritize in a fast\-growing organization
* Experience in strategic planning processes and tools and/or project management tools


**Desirable Skills / Experience**
* Graduate degree (MBA, Masters, MD or PhD preferred)
* Experience in leading and managing alliances or strategic partnerships
* Experience in translating business needs into a coordinated business proposal and plan for cross\-functional senior leadership team
* Ability to develop creative and simple solutions to complex problems


*You will be empowered with local ownership to shape how AI changes commercial impact across diverse markets, supported by leaders who invite bold ideas and open dialogue. Lead from Dubai to turn high\-potential AI into scaled impact—step into this role and build what’s next for patients, customers and growth!*

KEO is a creative enterprise, where innovation is a way of life. We are uniquely resourced with end\-to\-end services to take clients from inspiration – through conceptualization – to realization of planning, design or project delivery in the built and natural environments. For over 60 years we’ve led with vision, contributing to many of the world’s most ambitious projects, iconic places, remarkable experiences and prosperous communities.
 



  





 As a highly integrated and agile AEP/PMCM firm, KEO is recognized by ENR as one of the Top 225 International Design Firms and one of the Top 20 International PM/CM Firms. We are also ranked by World Architecture as the 51st largest global architecture firm and the \#1 Firm in the Middle East Region in their 2024 WA100 Survey.
 



  





 We invite you to join us. Why?
 



  





 When you join KEO, you’ll discover more than just a job – you’ll find a supportive environment that fosters your professional development through internal global mobility and career development and does so within a culture that supports company\-wide health and well\-being through on\-demand counselling services and regular workplace clinics. You will be invited to celebrate community events such as sports days, fun\-runs, in\-house sports teams and beach clean ups. In addition to your competitive package and benefits you will have access to a suite of policies that include hybrid working arrangements, individual athletic sponsorship, study assistance sponsorship, employee referral rewards.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




  





 Our newest opportunity is for a talented Cloud and Infrastructure Platforms Director to to join our award\-winning team based in Dubai, UAE.
 



  





 This critical leadership role is responsible for defining, delivering, and managing the organization’s enterprise cloud, infrastructure, and platform strategy across regional and international operations. The successful candidate will lead the modernization of IT infrastructure, cloud adoption, cybersecurity resilience, digital workplace technologies, and enterprise platform services to support a rapidly growing construction consultancy business.
 



  





 The role requires a highly experienced technology leader with a strong background in hybrid cloud environments, enterprise infrastructure operations, IT governance, cybersecurity, and large\-scale transformation initiatives within complex, multi\-site organizations.
 



  





 We envisage success in this role to include;
 



  





**Strategic \& Platform Leadership** 




  




* Define and execute KEO's cloud\-first, platform\-first infrastructure strategy, leading the evolution from traditional operations toward a modern platform engineering model that enables self\-service, automated, and product\-oriented infrastructure capabilities.
* Manage and continuously improve service reliability at enterprise scale, owning KEO's infrastructure performance and availability posture in alignment with digital transformation goals and business priorities.



  





**Cloud \& Platform Engineering** 




  




* Own and evolve KEO's Microsoft Azure environment, leading the design, deployment, and lifecycle management of IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS platforms through cloud\-native architectures, infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC), and platform engineering principles to ensure scalability, security, cost\-optimization, and developer agility.
* Oversee identity and access management via Microsoft Entra ID, enforcing MFA, RBAC, and least\-privilege principles, and manage KEO's zero\-trust network architecture ensuring access is granted only through verified identity, context, and policy.
* Maintain certified digital platforms \- including Microsoft SharePoint and Autodesk Construction Cloud \- to their respective security and governance standards.
* Drive cloud cost optimization initiatives \- including right\-sizing, reserved capacity management, and workload scheduling \- to maximize return on cloud investment.



  





**Cybersecurity \& Digital Trust** 




  




* Champion KEO's cybersecurity posture across all infrastructure and platform operations, overseeing Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM) for real\-time threat detection, automated response playbooks, and rapid incident management, alongside cloud security posture management (CSPM) for continuous assessment and remediation of misconfigurations and vulnerabilities.
* Ensure zero\-trust, least\-privilege, and access control governance principles are consistently applied and independently verified via EY audits, and lead KEO's phishing simulation programme to drive continuous improvements in security awareness.
* Maintain and continuously improve Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) programmes \- including automation of recovery workflows, regular testing, and audit\-readiness \- with appropriate escalation to IT leadership and executive oversight.



  





**Modern Service Management** 




  




* Lead a shift from traditional ITIL\-process orientation toward experience\-driven, outcome\-based service management, owning service reliability engineering practices including SLAs, SLOs, and error budgets across all platforms.
* Lead continuous service improvement cycles, platform lifecycle governance, and technology refresh programmes, ensuring all operations adhere to KEO's IT governance standards, security policies, regulatory requirements, and green IT sustainability commitments.



  





**Automation, DevOps \& SRE Mindset** 




  




* Champion an automation\-first culture, leading the implementation of infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipeline integration, self\-service cloud provisioning, and zero\-touch operations to eliminate manual processes at scale.
* Apply Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles \- including error budgets, reliability targets, and blameless post\-incident reviews \- to drive continuous improvement in platform deployment velocity, reliability, and recovery time.



  





**Data\-Driven \& AI\-Enabled Operations** 




  




* Lead the adoption of observability platforms and AIOps tooling to enable predictive performance monitoring, anomaly detection, and automated incident response, driving responsible AI adoption to enhance infrastructure efficiency, intelligent capacity planning, and proactive operations
* Use operational telemetry and data\-driven insights to inform platform investment decisions and continuous improvement initiatives, staying at the forefront of AI\-driven infrastructure operations and edge computing to evaluate and recommend adoption pathways aligned to KEO's strategy.



  





**Team Leadership \& People Development** 




  




* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing, geographically distributed infrastructure team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Set clear goals, provide regular feedback, and champion professional growth and certification of each team member.
* Build a psychologically safe team environment where automation innovation, constructive challenge, and knowledge sharing are actively encouraged.
* Promote cross\-functional collaboration with Digital Workplace, Enterprise Digital Solutions, and Technology Strategy teams to ensure “one IT” delivery



  





**Qualifications** 




  





 To be successful in this dynamic opportunity, we envision that your career journey to date will include 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT infrastructure, including a minimum of 3–5 years in a leadership capacity managing teams, cloud platforms, or enterprise infrastructure operations. You will hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or possess an equivalent combination of education and over 10 years of relevant professional experience.
 



  




* Proven, hands\-on experience managing Microsoft Azure cloud environments at enterprise scale, including hybrid cloud architecture, identity, and security services.
* Demonstrated experience leading a shift from traditional infrastructure management to modern platform engineering and DevOps\-aligned operations.
* Strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD for infrastructure, self\-service cloud provisioning, and zero\-touch operations.
* Experience applying Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, including error budgets, SLOs, and blameless post\-incident review practices.
* Proven cloud financial management (FinOps) experience: cost optimization, chargeback models, consumption governance, and cloud cost dashboards.
* Deep expertise in cybersecurity operations: Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM), zero\-trust architecture, cloud security posture management (CSPM), Entra ID / Azure AD, and endpoint security.
* Experience managing third\-party governance and audit review processes.
* Familiarity with AI\-driven infrastructure operations, edge computing architectures, and platform product models.
* Experience in the AEC (Architecture, Engineering, and Construction) or professional services sector is advantageous.
* Understanding of sustainable/green IT infrastructure principles and their application to cloud operations.



  





 KEO’s performance is founded upon integrity, results, innovation, safety and our people. We embrace diversity and recognise its’ contribution to client success wherever we work.
 



  





 We are excited to hear how you can partner with our award\-winning team and treat all expressions of interest confidentially.

TradePay, a Sanabil Studio company, is redefining how B2B commerce operates by enabling suppliers and distributors to offer flexible payment terms to business merchants through a seamless Stock\-Now\-Pay\-Later solution.
   

  

 Backed by Sanabil Studio, TradePay combines technology, financing infrastructure, and operational expertise to help businesses unlock working capital, improve cash flow, and scale more efficiently across industries.
   

  

**THE ROLE** 
 What you'll own here.
   

  

* Lead the development of AI\-enabled products across credit decisioning, fraud and risk monitoring, dynamic limit management, and inventory and cashflow intelligence.
* Translate complex, real\-world data into decision tools that improve accuracy, reduce loss rates, and responsibly expand access to finance.
* Drive a responsible AI approach, including model monitoring, drift detection, explainability, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows where required.
* Own the architecture and engineering roadmap from pilot through MVP to scale, ensuring systems are secure, scalable, and maintainable.
* Build and operate a modern data and ML platform covering ingestion, feature pipelines, training, serving, experimentation, and monitoring.
* Define AI work streams, milestones, and measurable outcomes; including approval lift, loss reduction, time\-to\-decision, and merchant growth impact.
* Establish technical standards across code quality, CI/CD, observability, reliability, and documentation.
* Make pragmatic build\-versus\-buy decisions across infrastructure, data providers, scoring components, KYC tooling, and payment rails.
* Hire, develop, and lead a high\-performing engineering and data team in Riyadh.
* Build strong security and privacy foundations that can withstand audits and support future licensing requirements.
* Partner closely with Risk, Operations, Finance, Legal/Compliance, and Partnerships teams.


**THE PROFILE** 
 You're probably a fit if…
   

  

* You have proven experience shipping AI/ML\-powered products into production; not just prototypes.
* You bring strong software engineering fundamentals alongside hands\-on experience in machine learning and data platforms.
* You have experience in fintech, lending, BNPL, payments, risk, fraud, or underwriting, and understand the importance of correctness in these environments.
* You have a track record of turning complex datasets into real\-world decision tools with measurable business impact.
* You have hired, mentored, and led teams in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments.
* You take full ownership of outcomes and maintain high standards for reliability, security, and scalable architecture.
* You communicate clearly with engineers, executives, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* You are based in Riyadh or open to relocation; this is an on\-site leadership role.
* Bonus: Experience with credit bureaus, alternative data, open banking signals, cloud\-native architectures at scale, regulated environments, or GCC fintech products.


**THE ENVIRONMENT** 
 : What working here actually looks like.
   

  

* Builder Role, Real Scope: You won’t be maintaining an existing system; you’ll define the architecture, build the team, and own outcomes from day one.
* AI at the Core: AI is central to how TradePay operates, from underwriting to risk monitoring and merchant intelligence, and you will lead that effort.
* Close to the Top: You will work directly with the CEO and leadership team in Riyadh, with fast feedback loops and real influence on company direction.


**What You Get From Us**
* Competitive pay: A package that reflects your seniority and the market.
* Meaningful equity: Real upside tied to the long\-term value you help create.
* Premium gear, day one: Fully set up and ready before your first day.
* Mentorship that matters: Learn from people who have built and scaled ventures.
* An accelerated curve: You’ll learn more here in 12 months than most roles offer in three years.

 There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.
   

  

**Deadline: June 18th, 2026**

 At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long\-term health. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

**Where does this role fit into the bigger picture?** 




 This role is critical to deepening industry participation in Dubai’s RDI ecosystem by designing corporate incentive offerings that attract private investment and accelerate research commercialization. This role focuses on transforming research into market\-ready solutions and deepening industry participation in RDI activities.
 



 The Director will collaborate with internal teams and external partners, including corporates and government entities, to drive alignment with corporate incentivization priorities and offerings.

 This role is key to attracting and mobilizing private\-sector investment into Dubai’s RDI ecosystem. By structuring corporate incentives, guiding commercialization pathways, and aligning company activity with strategic priorities, it accelerates innovation adoption, strengthens public\-private collaboration, and translates RDI into measurable economic impact.
 



  





  





  





**What Dubai Future Foundation offers?** 




 We will offer you a unique opportunity to work with people who are passionate about the future and establishing Dubai as one of the leading cities of the world. **Procurement Module Ownership** 



* Own Self\-Service Procurement, Purchasing, Sourcing, Supplier Portal, Supplier Qualification Management, and Procurement Contracts.
* Drive supplier onboarding, sourcing automation (RFx, auctions), and contract compliance.

**Human Capital Management (HCM) Module Ownership** 



* Own Core HR, Absence, Talent, Performance, Compensation, Payroll (or Payroll Interface to ADP/Mercans), and Workforce Management.
* Lead annual HR cycles in the system: merit, bonus, talent review, and performance calibration.
* Manage WPS payroll compliance, gratuity calculations, and Emiratization reporting.
* Deploy self\-service experiences (Redwood / Journeys) to improve employee and manager adoption.



**Delivery, Operations \& Integration** 



* Lead implementations, rollouts to new entities, and quarterly Oracle release uptake (impact assessment, regression, go/no\-go).
* Govern integrations through Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) with banks, MOHRE, tax authority, BI tools, and other enterprise systems.
* Ensure platform security: role design, SoD analysis, data privacy, and audit readiness.
* Own incident, problem, and change management for Fusion; drive a 99%\+ availability and target SLA adherence.

**People Leadership** 



* Build and develop a high\-performing team of functional consultants, technical developers, and integration engineers.
* Define competency frameworks, certification plans, and career paths for the Fusion practice.

***Competencies***



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or related discipline; Master's/MBA preferred.

* CPA / ACCA / CMA, CIPS, or SHRM/CIPD certifications are an advantage.



**Experience** 



* 15\+ years in enterprise applications, with at least 8 years on Oracle Cloud (Fusion) — covering minimum two of Finance, Procurement, HCM end\-to\-end.
* Track record of leading at least two full\-cycle Fusion implementations or major upgrades from EBS / PeopleSoft / JD Edwards / SAP to Oracle Cloud.
* Experience managing multi\-entity, multi\-currency, multi\-jurisdiction deployments (UAE / GCC preferred).
* Demonstrated leadership of teams of 15\+ across functional, technical, and partner resources.
* Industry background in real estate, construction, hospitality, or large diversified groups is a strong plus.



**Technical Competencies** 



* Deep functional knowledge of Oracle Fusion ERP, Procurement, and HCM data models and configuration.
* Hands\-on familiarity with OIC, FBDI, HDL, HCM Extracts, BI Publisher, OTBI, Fast Formulas, and REST APIs.
* Strong understanding of security model, role design, and SoD (Risk Management / Advanced Controls).

**Job Description**
**Company Overview**
 Working at GE Aerospace means you are bringing your unique perspective, innovative spirit, drive, and curiosity to a collaborative and diverse team working to advance aerospace for future generations. If you have ideas, we will listen. Join us and see your ideas take flight!
   

  

**Site Overview**
 For over 40 years, GE Aerospace has had a significant presence on the ground in the United Arab Emirates. In addition to career opportunities, our sites offer a culture focused on respect for people and giving back to the community through grants and philanthropic programming.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 Responsible for managing information technology for a few engine MRO facilities outside of the United States, including all IT infrastructure \& software applications necessary for shop operations. As the Site IT leader, you will be responsible for performance \& availability of IT infrastructure \& applications as well as partner with the business on digital improvements.
   

  

* Designs \& implements the roadmap to drive digital improvements across IT infrastructure \& application landscape.
* Influences LPBs and below on their decisions.
* Performs as part of the Shop leadership team representing information technology.
* Partners with the business to participate in lean/ process improvement initiatives \& enable business transformation leveraging digital tools.

* Familiar with the digital product catalog and how it fits in with site operations.
* Works on machine instrumentation initiatives to enable enhanced business operations.
* Proactively monitors network performance (WAN / LAN / WLAN) and escalate issues.
* Builds relationships with Central DT product teams for quicker resolution of networking and application issues.
* Initiates technology obsolescence and improvement projects.


**Required Qualifications**
 Expected minimum experience to demonstrate competency of 5 years
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Change Agent \- Proactively learns new tools and integrates new methods to drive improved outcomes. Identifies and assesses new technologies that can add value and capability to GE. Builds rapport with the team and gets buy\-in for ideas. Drives stakeholder understanding and acceptance of new ideas in their business. Participates in change programs by planning implementation activities with other change champions. Implements monitoring and feedback systems. Solicits ideas for improving primary business processes.
* Collaboration \- Establishes \& communicates team members' roles in relation to their function and data. Shares knowledge, power and credit, establishing trust, credibility, and goodwill. Coordinates role responsibilities with that of others to achieve mutual goals. Encourages groups to work together to resolve problems. Proactively coaches and/or mentors others to improve their contribution to the team. Fosters relationship building between team members and those outside the team. Works with others to achieve goals without regard to band/title. Identifies gaps in roles on teams, and is recognized for growing and distributing talent pools across the organization.
* Comfort in Ambiguity \- Identifies when additional information is needed from customer/manager/stake holder and asks relevant questions to obtain it. Delivers solution(s) where additional information may not be needed or available, while clearly stating any underlying assumptions. Communicates status. Evaluates data sets to determine possible value or steps to create value.
* Communication \- Adjusts information (e.g. level of complexity) and story to align with audience. Produces functional area information in sufficient detail for cross\-functional teams to utilize, using presentation and storytelling concepts. Informs stakeholders of customer issues, identifies potential problems or conflicts and resolves them when necessary. Explains the story of the rationale and benefit of their ideas. Uses relevant and appropriate presentation techniques. Responds to questions and dissent in a constructive manner. Acknowledges limitations of one’s own knowledge.
* Consulting \- Provides options and counsel. Drives dialogues that produce new perspectives and substantial innovation, enhancements and analysis of consequences. Consults on projects to fit systems or infrastructure, and project goals to their function, and vice versa. Provides risk\-assessed options in relation to process enhancement and professional expertise. Consults on data or data infrastructure development projects and identifies when necessary to modify the solution.
* Curiosity/Creativity \- Connects ideas and solutions from a broad array of sources (e.g., what other businesses are doing, brainstorming with others). Pilots new ideas and processes that have not been utilized before.
* Decision Making \& Risk Management \- Analyzes and interprets business strategy, policies, values, complex data patterns and relationships to make decisions regardless of incomplete and conflicting information and uncertain consequences. Makes benchmarked and researched recommendations with contingency plans in place for potential adverse consequences; takes responsibility for consequences of decision/risk. Lobbies business partners and subject matter experts for consensus in taking action that sets direction in at least one critical business function.
* Influence \- Ensures group understanding of issues and presents rationale to affect outcomes. Resolves conflicting opinions through consensus. Uses appropriate facilitation techniques to gain agreement or move others to action.
* Problem Solving \- Identifies future roadblocks and promotes data\-based problem solving. Assesses \& prioritizes problems in relation to organizational goals. Coordinates team's work and performance with broader organizational objectives and manages conflicts between them. Advises others in how to solve difficult problems.


 At GE Aerospace, we have a relentless dedication to the future of safe and more sustainable flight and believe in our talented people to make it happen. Here, you will have the opportunity to work on really cool things with really smart and collaborative people. Together, we will mobilize a new era of growth in aerospace and defense. **Job Summary**
 The role of CTM Saudi Arabia is pivotal in ensuring the continuous availability, high performance, and robust security of all applications within the production environment that support our business and operational functions. This position demands comprehensive oversight and maintenance of all local data centres and related infrastructure components, including servers, networking equipment, storage systems, external connectivity gateways, and telephony systems. You will play a crucial role in driving technological initiatives, coordinating with multiple teams to roll out new projects, resolve issues, and uphold infrastructure integrity.
   

  

 Furthermore, you will act as the vital link between business and operational stakeholders and the wider technology ecosystem, facilitating clear communication and strategic alignment. Managing the country\-specific technology budget forms a core responsibility, alongside enabling support for critical technology initiatives and risk management. This role requires proactive leadership in technology product implementations, ongoing system enhancements, and prompt resolution of problems and risks, thereby ensuring operational stability and compliance.
   

  

 You will work closely with vendors and external parties to maintain and upgrade local systems and infrastructure, organize and lead service review meetings with key technology stakeholders such as ITSC and PSS, and provide advisories on potential risks with formulated action plans to mitigate them. Leading service improvement initiatives that enhance system performance and stability is integral to the role.
   

  

 As the central point of contact during high severity incidents, you will ensure swift issue resolution, coordinating effectively with ITSC, PSS, and network teams. Comprehensive root cause analyses for such incidents will be executed with follow\-through on preventative measures to forestall recurrence. The role also includes reviewing and approving change requests from the business, ensuring each modification is conducted without compromising system stability. Active participation in PSCs, ICS forums, and risk management discussions will be expected to uphold compliance with technology policies and risk guidelines. Additionally, you will facilitate technology and system\-related audits, ensuring they are conducted smoothly and to a satisfactory standard.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy and Operations**
* Maintain and continuously improve the stability, capacity, and security of local IT systems and infrastructure, with a strong focus on managing obsolescence and implementing modernization strategies.
* Collaborate closely with application and infrastructure teams to proactively address issues related to instability or outdated technologies.
* Implement stringent controls over production changes to reduce incidents caused by change errors, enhancing change management governance.
* Ensure high availability, optimal performance, and airtight security of business\-critical applications within the production environment.
* Oversee comprehensive maintenance of in\-country data centres and all associated infrastructure elements including servers, network equipment, storage devices, gateways, and telephony systems.
* Coordinate with multiple internal teams on new technology rollouts, operational problem resolution, and continuous improvement projects.
* Represent technology interests and provide leadership presence in various forums, acting as the principal liaison between business operations and technical teams.
* Engage actively with teams such as TSM, PSS, TechOps, and ITSC for incident management and escalation to ensure prompt problem resolution.
* Drive root cause analysis efforts for all high severity incidents, ensuring timely implementation of corrective actions.
* Work to reduce recovery times for critical system incidents, enhancing overall operational resilience.
* Identify and pursue cloud transformation opportunities to modernize infrastructure and improve scalability and efficiency.
* Manage service level agreements with business and operational units to guarantee satisfactory service delivery.
* Respond to and resolve high severity incidents in partnership with cross\-functional teams, minimizing business impact.
* Provide frontline support to in\-country users, offering expert advice and practical solutions to operational technology challenges.
* Assess and approve critical system changes and enhancements, carefully balancing innovation with the need to maintain production stability.


 Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
   

  

 Standard Chartered
   

  

**Skills And Experience**
 This role requires a solid foundation in IT infrastructure and banking systems, ensuring a deep understanding of core technologies and industry\-specific requirements. Candidates should demonstrate a strong commitment to managing conduct and risk to uphold the company's standards and regulatory obligations. Effective people management skills are essential to lead teams and foster collaboration effectively.
   

  

 Time management skills are critical to balance multiple ongoing tasks, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines without compromising quality. Demonstrated capacity for strategic thinking combined with hands\-on technical expertise will enable the successful candidate to drive continuous improvements. In addition, the ability to communicate clearly and build strong networks across various organizational levels is imperative for success.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate will possess between 5 to 7 years of relevant technology experience, with substantial exposure to complex IT environments. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English \& Arabic.
   

  

 A high degree of analytical capability is required, including the ability to interpret data comprehensively, derive actionable insights, and proactively forecast necessary changes. Experience in managing multiple priorities and demonstrating adaptability to dynamic work environments is vital. A proven track record of accountability and problem\-solving in high\-pressure situations is expected.
   

  

 Additionally, candidates should exhibit sound skills in change management, project management methodologies, and financial oversight, including budgeting competencies. Academic qualifications preferably include a Master’s degree in a technology\-related field, supplemented by leadership development programs and project management certifications.
   

  

**About Standard Chartered**
 Standard Chartered is a global bank with a proud history spanning more than 170 years and a commitment to making a positive impact for our clients, communities, and colleagues worldwide. Our culture encourages challenge, innovation, and growth, valuing diversity of thought and experience to drive commerce and prosperity.
   

  

 At Standard Chartered, we uphold our purpose to be here for good by fostering an inclusive workplace where every individual is respected and supported to achieve their full potential. Our shared values of integrity, continuous improvement, and collaborative teamwork define how we operate and engage with our clients and each other.
   

  

 Joining our team means becoming a part of a dynamic, forward\-thinking environment where your unique talents are celebrated and where you can make meaningful contributions to a responsible and evolving financial institution.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Aligned with our commitment to Fair Pay and employee wellbeing, we offer a comprehensive and competitive package designed to support your overall mental, physical, financial, and social health.
   

  

* Robust core benefits including retirement savings schemes, comprehensive medical coverage, and life insurance, with options for voluntary and flexible benefits tailored to individual needs.
* Generous time\-off provisions inclusive of annual leave, extended parental/maternity leave (up to 20 weeks), sabbaticals (up to 12 months), and dedicated volunteering leave (3 days), along with a minimum combined total of 30 days for annual and public holidays.
* Flexible working arrangements that allow for a balance between office\-based and remote work, supporting diverse work styles and personal circumstances.
* Proactive wellness resources including access to Unmind, a digital mental health platform, resilience and human skills development programs, global Employee Assistance Programmes, mental health first aiders, and extensive self\-help toolkits.
* An environment committed to continuous professional development through varied learning opportunities, enabling you to reskill, upskill, and advance your career.
* A genuinely inclusive culture that values diversity and encourages every employee to thrive in an equitable supportive workplace.

**About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**The Mission**
 We believe the transformative potential of AI is significantly under\-realised in our region. To bridge this gap, we are incubating a new division within Careem dedicated to Enterprise AI Transformation.
   

  

 We are reimagining and building the future of work to simplify and improve how businesses function in the era of GenAI with WorkOS: a next\-generation ‘operating system’ designed to deploy, orchestrate, and improve AI agents across every customer and operational journey (and increasingly autonomously). This isn’t just automation; it’s about creating a hybrid workforce where self\-learning AI agents handle the heavy lifting, empowering our people to focus on the highest\-value, most creative work.
   

  

**The Team**
 This group operates as a startup within Careem with a distinct mandate: move fast, build boldly, and deliver production\-grade AI systems that fundamentally change how the region leverages technology.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are looking for an exceptional founding Backend Engineer to build the WorkOS platform. This is a role for a systems\-thinker who wants to work at the intersection of high\-scale distributed systems and AI orchestration. You will be responsible for building the "brain" of WorkOS, the engine that deploys and manages autonomous agents across the region’s most complex operational journeys at massive scale.
   

  

 As one of the first engineers in WorkOS, you will have a disproportionate impact on our technical foundation, culture, and the speed at which we move from 0 to 1\.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Architect and Build the WorkOS Engine: Design and build the scalable backend services and architectures required to orchestrate complex AI workflows and real\-time data streaming. Leverage novel technologies to build cutting\-edge capabilities.
* Set the Engineering Gold Standard: As a founding member, you will establish our backend best practices, from CI/CD and observability to security and system integrity, ensuring a high\-velocity but rigorous engineering culture.
* Solve for Distributed Complexity: Navigate the unique challenges of integrating AI agents into legacy enterprise stacks, ensuring low\-latency communication and robust data consistency.
* Database design: Build our data infrastructure, leveraging relational, schemaless, and vector stores to power the platform and create persistent brains for our Agents.
* Full\-Cycle Ownership: Own the lifecycle of the platform, from rapid prototyping of new agent capabilities to maintaining production\-grade systems at enterprise scale.
* Drive AI\-Accelerated Engineering: Constantly experiment with AI\-assisted development to move faster than traditional teams, while maintaining a bar for superb technical quality and craft.
* Lead Pioneer Deployments: While building the core platform, you will occasionally lead the charge on first\-of\-their\-kind implementations for strategic partners, ensuring our tech solves real\-world operational complexity.
* Operate with High Agency: In this lean, startup\-style environment, you will be responsible for outcomes over inputs, rolling your sleeves up to code and balancing investments in the long\-term technical roadmap with the need to ship value quickly.


**What You’ll Need**
* 8–12\+ years of professional backend engineering experience, with significant tenure acting as a Staff Engineer or Technical Lead for complex, high\-scale distributed systems.
* Mastery of Backend Systems: Deep expertise in languages like Python, Go, or Node.js, with a proven track record of architecting concurrency, microservices, and high\-throughput data pipelines.
* AI\-Native Infrastructure Depth: Hands\-on experience with LLM orchestration (LangChain, etc.), vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus), and RAG architectures at a production\-grade level.
* Systems\-Level Visionary: The ability to design "platform\-first", thinking in terms of APIs, modularity, and extensibility so that the WorkOS core can support infinite customer use cases.
* Obsession with Performance: A specialist's focus on latency and system observability; you believe that AI interactions must feel "instant" and "bulletproof" to be valuable.
* Startup\-level Autonomy: Comfortable navigating a "0\-to\-1" environment where you define the technical roadmap and ship high\-quality code without a playbook.
* Willingness to work on\-site full time in UAE, to foster the high\-intensity collaboration required for this incubation phase.
* Experience with enterprise software transformation or legacy system integration is a significant plus.


**What You’ll Receive**
* A Blank Canvas and Live Ammunition: The rare opportunity to build a "0\-to\-1" product while immediately deploying it into the real\-world operations of a regional giant. No "sandbox" projects here, you’ll be shipping code that moves people and goods on day one. This is a huge opportunity to create impact in our region.
* Architecting the Engine: We’re a lean, impact\-obsessed team operating with total autonomy. You’ll be free from corporate bureaucracy and legacy baggage, focused entirely on building the core orchestration layer and agentic frameworks that will serve as the "brain" of the region’s enterprises.
* Direct Collaboration with Leadership: Direct engagement with Careem and enterprise client leadership, in addition to working side\-by\-side with the WorkOS founding team including Magnus Olsson (Careem’s original Co\-founder).
* Competitive Compensation: Including direct equity in this new division. Our philosophy is meritocratic: we want you to own a meaningful stake in the value you create.


**What We’ll Provide You**
 We offer colleagues the opportunity to drive impact in the region while they learn and grow. As a full time Careem colleague, you will be able to:
   

  

* Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.
* Put your passion to work in a purposeful organisation dedicated to creating impact in a region with a lot of untapped potential.
* Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
* Work remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.
* Access to healthcare benefits and fitness reimbursements for health activities including gym, health club, and training classes.

**Responsibilities**
 As an experienced engineer, with a strong appreciation of process design and an interest in the holistic aspects of Greenfield and Brownfield projects, you will grow your career through taking Commercial and Client Stakeholder management responsibility for delivering across the pre\-FEED phases of project implementation (pre\-feasibility, concept, feasibility, pre\-FEED etc).
   

  

 Focusing on predictable project delivery against key internal and external metrics of cost, schedule and quality you will steer your project team to develop the technoeconomic solution that guides your client to successfully achieve the next stage in their decision gate process.
   

  

 You will interface with a multi\-disciplinary team of highly capable Subject Matter Experts and Consultants to deliver best in class solutions that will ensure high customer satisfaction. This will lead to opportunities for further advancement of your career in multiple directions.
   

  

 This is a fantastic role for a leadership focused process engineer with a real passion for developing their own leadership style and project management capabilities while making a difference in both Energy Security and Energy Transition.
   

  

**The Key Objectives For This Role Are**
* Develop and manage strong customer relationships that ensure Wood is the Client’s contractor of choice for early phase studies

* Manage and lead the project team to achieve the health, safety, environmental, schedule, cost and quality requirements of the study. Ensure that Wood’s and Client’s Health and Safety, Environmental and Quality Management Procedures are followed

**It’s a future for all of us.** 
 We aspire to shape a better tomorrow by unlocking solutions that address the biggest challenges facing our clients and our society.

data.jd_text:
**Purpose / Mission:**
 Serve as the owner's area manager for the Utilities area on the 2\.5 Mtpa green Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) / Hot Briquetted Iron (HBI) project in Duqm, Oman. Carry technical and commercial accountability for the Utilities area, encompassing air separation (ASU; nitrogen and oxygen production), water treatment and management (raw water, demineralised water, cooling water, fire water), wastewater management and zero liquid discharge (ZLD), compressed air and instrument air, plant air, gas distribution (nitrogen, oxygen, hydrogen, natural gas as applicable), and the utilities\-process interface with DRI and BoP areas. Dual\-role overlay as Lead Process Engineer for utilities scope; DRI process authority sits separately with a dedicated DRI Process Engineer post\-FID. Lead the Utilities scope from pre\-FID through FEED, EPC tender, construction, commissioning and ramp\-up.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
 Own technical and commercial accountability for the Utilities area, including scope definition, OEM selection, contract negotiation, claims management, schedule and cost ownership for the area.
   

  

 Lead the owner's engineering definition of the air separation unit and gas distribution system serving the plant.
   

  

 Lead the owner's engineering of the plant water systems including raw water intake or supply, demineralised water production, cooling water systems, fire water, and the integrated water balance.
   

  

 Own the design and delivery of the wastewater management and zero liquid discharge (ZLD) strategy, with particular attention to the water\-constrained Duqm site and applicable Omani regulatory requirements.
   

  

 Lead the owner's engineering of compressed air, instrument air, plant air and gas distribution systems including nitrogen and oxygen distribution to point\-of\-use.
   

  

 Provide cross\-area utilities discipline authority including review and assurance of utility interfaces with the DRI, BoP, Materials Handling and HV areas.
   

  

 Provide Utilities area input to specifications, tender documentation, technical evaluations and award recommendations for the utility EPC and equipment packages, including interfaces with major utilities OEMs and licensors (Air Liquide, Linde, Air Products and equivalents).
   

  

 Review and approve utilities engineering deliverables from the Owner's Engineer and EPC contractors.
   

  

 Lead Utilities area input to HAZID, HAZOP, SIL assessment, LOPA and related process safety studies.
   

  

 Support cost estimate development for utilities scope to FID\-level accuracy.
   

  

 Provide Utilities area technical and commercial leadership during construction, pre\-commissioning, commissioning and performance testing.
   

  

 Cross\-area coordination: the plant\-wide cable and pipe bridge system spans the BoP, Materials Handling and Logistics, Utilities and High Voltage areas. Civil and structural design ownership sits with the BoP Area Manager; routing, occupancy and interface management is a joint responsibility of the BoP, MH\&L, Utilities and HV Area Managers. The four Area Managers will agree corridor strategy, support spacing, occupancy planning and revision control as a co\-ordinated workstream.
   

  

 Contribute to the development and mentoring of process and utilities engineering resources as the in\-country team grows from pre\-FID into execution.
   

  

**Requirements / Skills / Experience:**
 Minimum 15 years' experience in heavy industrial process plant utilities engineering, with a clear strength in process discipline depth across multiple utilities including at least three of: air separation, water treatment systems, wastewater and ZLD, compressed air and gas distribution, and steam systems where applicable.
   

  

 Strong preference for direct experience on integrated steel, ironmaking, petrochemical, fertilizer, refinery, mining or analogous heavy industrial greenfield projects.
   

  

 Direct experience interfacing with major utilities OEMs and licensors (Air Liquide, Linde, Air Products for ASU, and equivalents for water treatment) is a strong advantage.
   

  

 Experience across the full project lifecycle: FEED, detailed design, procurement, construction supervision, commissioning and ramp\-up.
   

  

 Demonstrated commercial muscle on top of technical authority: experience owning a utilities package end\-to\-end from scope definition through OEM selection, contract execution, claims management and closeout.
   

  

 Direct experience with ZLD or advanced wastewater systems is a strong advantage for the water\-constrained Duqm site.
   

  

 Experience with cooling water systems including seawater cooling is a strong advantage.
   

  

 Demonstrated familiarity with international process and utilities design codes (ASME, API, ISA, IEC) and applicable Omani regulatory requirements.
   

  

 Demonstrated leadership in process safety, including accountability for HAZOP, SIL and process hazard analysis outcomes.
   

  

**Prior GCC Or Extreme\-environment Project Experience Preferred.**
 Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior technical and commercial authority in a lean owner team environment.
   

  

 Strong communication, technical writing and review skills.
   

  

**Required Education / Qualification / Training:**
 Bachelor's degree in Chemical, Process, Mechanical or related engineering discipline (required). Master's degree in Process or Chemical Engineering (preferred). Chartered Engineer, Professional Engineer or equivalent internationally recognized professional status (preferred). Member of a recognized professional engineering institution (e.g. IChemE, AIChE, IMechE) (preferred).
   

  

**Required Language Proficiency:**
 English \- Fluent
   

  

 Arabic \- Nice to have
